recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the closest thing in the literature to a direct test of ARC-052's clause (2) IN THE AVERSIVE DOMAIN, and it carries a pupillometric index of noradrenergic gain that speaks to the neuromodulatory clause as well. Held at 0.72 rather than higher because n=31 with the key individual-difference correlations at r=-0.42 (p=0.02) and r=-0.51 (p=0.005) is a modest evidential base for the moderation result, and because pupil diameter is an indirect proxy for locus coeruleus activity, which the authors themselves flag.
failure_signatures: Volatility-driven precision adjustment is not a fixed property of the architecture but an individual-difference variable: high trait anxiety was associated with a reduced change in learning rate between stable and volatile blocks (r(28)=-0.42, p=0.02), i.e. a system can have the volatility machinery and still fail to use it.

The pupil (noradrenergic) response to volatility was itself blunted in high-anxiety individuals (r(26)=-0.51, p=0.005), so a neuromodulatory precision gain can decouple from the volatility signal it is supposed to transmit -- a wiring in which 5-HT/NE multiplicatively scales precision inherits this as a failure mode, not merely as a tuning knob.

The authors could not establish that the deficit is specific to aversive learning: a reward version showed no anxiety effect, but the task-by-anxiety difference was not itself statistically significant, so harm-specific precision control is suggested rather than shown.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct engineering evidence that the exact mechanism ARC-052's notes specify -- an encoder emitting (mu, log_sigma) with downstream terms weighted by exp(-log_sigma) -- trains stably and improves performance on real tasks. That is genuine support for feasibility. It is recorded as MIXED rather than supports because the same paper establishes that a likelihood-trained variance head captures ALEATORIC uncertainty, which by construction does not shrink as the model improves; ARC-052 clause (1) asks precision to RISE with forward model accuracy, which is epistemic. Taken at face value the proposed implementation does not compute the quantity the claim requires.
failure_signatures: A network free to predict its own variance can reduce its loss by inflating sigma on difficult inputs instead of improving its mean prediction -- the paper names this 'learned loss attenuation' and presents it as a robustness feature, but for ARC-052 it is a route by which a harm encoder learns to mark the most informative threat inputs as low-precision and so removes them from E3's influence.

Aleatoric uncertainty learned from a regression likelihood does not decrease with more data or a better model; epistemic uncertainty does. ARC-052 clause (1) ties z_harm_s precision to FORWARD MODEL ACCURACY, an epistemic quantity, so a single log_sigma head trained by NLL cannot implement clause (1) as written.

In this framework the variance head is trained against a supervised target. z_harm_s and z_harm_a have no ground-truth latent to regress against, so the NLL objective that makes log_sigma meaningful here has no direct analogue in REE and would have to be attached to a proxy (E2 prediction error), changing what the learned sigma means.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Structurally the closest analogue in the pull to what ARC-052 actually proposes: two parallel streams, each carrying an online estimate of its own reliability derived from the dispersion of its prediction errors, with the relative reliability setting how much each stream influences downstream control -- and a neural implementation via modulated connectivity rather than a summed signal. Mapping fidelity is high on architecture. Discounted for domain (instrumental reward learning, not harm) and because arbitration here is between two CONTROL SYSTEMS, whereas ARC-052 weights two LATENT STREAMS feeding one controller.
failure_signatures: Reliability was estimated from the dispersion of each system's prediction errors, which means a stream that is confidently WRONG in a stable way registers as reliable; a precision head trained the same way inherits this, and for z_harm_s a systematically biased but low-variance forward model would be granted high influence over attribution.

The arbitrator acted by modulating CONNECTIVITY to the model-free valuation system rather than by rescaling a signal at the point of combination, so 'weight by exp(-log_sigma) at the E3 input' is one of at least two implementations and not the one this paper supports.

Arbitration was asymmetric -- the mechanism worked by suppressing model-free control when model-based reliability was high, not by symmetric precision-weighting of two peers, which is the shape ARC-052 currently assumes.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The foundational formalisation of neuromodulator-carried uncertainty signals that set inferential gains, and the direct ancestor of the framework ARC-052's notes invoke. It is theory synthesising others' physiological, pharmacological and behavioural data rather than new measurement, so source_quality is capped below an empirical paper of equal standing. Mapping fidelity is good for the architectural shape (modulator-set precision gains) but imperfect on the specific modulators: the paper assigns the roles to acetylcholine and norepinephrine, while ARC-052 names serotonin and norepinephrine.
failure_signatures: The two uncertainty signals are described as 'part-antagonistic, part-synergistic', so a naive implementation that multiplies independent modulator gains onto a single precision term will mis-model their interaction.

The framework distinguishes EXPECTED uncertainty (known unreliability of a cue within a context) from UNEXPECTED uncertainty (a context switch). ARC-052's two precision clauses map onto these differently -- forward-model accuracy is expected uncertainty, accumulation volatility is closer to unexpected uncertainty -- so a single shared precision-gain pathway for both harm streams would conflate two quantities this literature says are separately represented.
ARC-052 names serotonin as a precision-gain modulator; this framework does not assign serotonin a role, and the pull found no paper that grounds the serotonergic half of the claim.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily replicated demonstration that the weight placed on an accumulated estimate is set by inferred environmental volatility, with a neural correlate (ACC) that predicts the per-subject learning rate. Source quality is very high. Confidence is held below 0.8 because the domain is reward, not harm, and because the paper establishes a volatility-dependent LEARNING RATE rather than a precision term read out by a downstream consumer -- ARC-052's structural commitment (a precision scalar emitted alongside the latent, consumed by E3) is one inferential step beyond what was measured.
failure_signatures: The volatility-to-learning-rate relation was estimated at the level of a scalar value estimate; it does not establish that a high-dimensional latent (z_harm_a) admits a single well-behaved precision scalar rather than needing a per-dimension one.

Subjects tracked volatility near-optimally only after substantial task exposure; a volatility estimator wired into z_harm_a precision inherits a warm-up period during which its own estimate is unreliable, and nothing in this paper says what a system should do with the accumulator meanwhile.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical computational demonstration that an intrinsic curiosity signal ALONE -- with no extrinsic reward gradient -- produces directed, goal-approaching navigation (systematic level-traversal in Super Mario, room-to-room navigation in VizDoom). That is the ARC-057 emergence principle in its purest computational form: directed approach as an emergent property of an information-seeking drive rather than a commanded value field. Held at 0.6 because ICM curiosity is forward-model PREDICTION ERROR (seek unpredictable transitions), not SD-025's representational-DENSITY following, and there is no DA-expansion partner shaping the space -- so it evidences the 'intrinsic drive -> directed approach, no explicit gradient' half of ARC-057 but not the SD-024 x SD-025 interaction that makes the approach land on reward.
failure_signatures: The intrinsic reward is prediction error in a learned inverse-dynamics feature space (novelty = surprise), whereas SD-025 defines novelty as representational density x (1 - familiarity). Curiosity here seeks the UNPREDICTABLE; ARC-057's curiosity seeks the representationally DENSE -- the shared word 'curiosity' spans two different computations.

There is no dopaminergic representational-expansion component: the environment's structure is fixed and curiosity explores it uniformly. ARC-057's distinctive claim is that DA ASYMMETRICALLY expands the map so that a uniform drive produces reward-directed approach -- this paper shows the drive-produces-approach half but not the asymmetry-of-the-substrate half.

Prediction-error curiosity is known to be vulnerable to the 'noisy-TV' trap (stochastic transitions look perpetually novel); this failure mode has no analogue in the density-following formulation, so a naive read that 'curiosity always yields adaptive approach' would over-claim.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational, heavily-cited normative model (validated against place- and grid-cell data) showing that goal-directed navigation is read off the STRUCTURE of a hippocampal representation -- a successor representation whose place fields skew and cluster around rewards and barriers -- rather than off an explicit stored value gradient. This is exactly ARC-057's core thesis ('there is no gradient -- there is more map'). Held at 0.62 because the representational scheme is a successor/predictive map (future-occupancy), NOT REE's DA-modulated RBF density expansion, and the paper contains no separate curiosity/information-seeking drive -- it grounds the 'representation-structure produces approach without an explicit gradient' premise but not the specific SD-024 x SD-025 two-component interaction that ARC-057 asserts.
failure_signatures: The map here is a successor representation encoding expected future state occupancy; place fields reshape around reward/goal locations, but the reshaping is driven by the transition/reward structure of the task, not by a dopaminergic representational-DENSITY expansion signal -- so it supports 'structure not gradient' generically while being silent on the DA-expansion (MECH-232/SD-024) leg ARC-057 specifically invokes.

There is no curiosity or information-seeking drive in the model. Approach follows the value/policy read off the SR map, so the paper does not evidence the ARC-057 claim that a UNIFORM curiosity drive (SD-025) operating on the asymmetrically-shaped map is what converts representational structure into approach.

Because the SR map itself encodes reward-weighted expected occupancy, a critic could argue the map is not gradient-free but rather bakes an implicit value gradient into the representation -- the very implicit/explicit boundary ARC-057 rests on is blurred here.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Shows that a DENSITY MODEL over the state space, converted into a pseudo-count intrinsic bonus, produces directed navigation toward distant goals in hard sparse-reward tasks (notably Montezuma's Revenge) with no explicit external gradient guiding the agent there. This grounds ARC-057's mechanism-plausibility -- that a density-based intrinsic drive yields emergent directed approach -- and matches SD-025's FAMILIARITY term almost exactly (the bonus is high for rarely-visited states). Held at 0.55 by a real sign-tension: count-based novelty seeks LOW-count / under-explored regions, whereas ARC-057's curiosity is ATTRACTED to HIGH representational density; the two theories agree on the familiarity/visitation term but are opposite on the representational-density term, which is REE's own contribution.
failure_signatures: The pseudo-count bonus is HIGH for LOW-density (rarely visited) states -- novelty-as-rarity. ARC-057's curiosity drive is ATTRACTED to HIGH representational density (more RBF centers = more to distinguish). The word 'density' means opposite things: state-visitation density (Bellemare, seek low) vs representational density (REE, seek high). Support holds only for the visitation/familiarity half of SD-025's novelty = density x (1 - familiarity).

Directedness comes from a value-bootstrapping RL agent propagating the intrinsic bonus via TD backups into a policy, i.e. the approach IS carried by a learned value function -- whereas ARC-057 claims approach without an explicit value/wanting gradient. The mechanism of directedness therefore differs from REE's density-following CEM read-out.

The result is exploration to reach novelty, not approach toward reward per se; the reward-directedness in Montezuma comes from extrinsic reward eventually being found and bootstrapped, not from an asymmetric DA-shaped representation making the drive land on reward.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical Seth & Friston review of interoceptive inference framework. Establishes that bodily states are regulated by descending predictions from deep generative models -- the architectural commitment that made-feelings / interoceptive-passivity entries depend on. Explicit on the role of precision (uncertainty) and its translation into neuromodulation, with implications for selfhood and emotion. Source quality very high (Phil Trans R Soc B, Friston coauthor). For ARC-058 the relevance is foundational: the framework requires an interoceptive comparator architecture; whether that comparator shares or separates trunks with somatic-discriminative (z_harm_s) channel is the empirical question ARC-058 vs ARC-033 disagree on. The review supports the existence of the interoceptive comparator without forcing one architectural side.
failure_signatures: If REE implements a working interoceptive forward model but observes flat affective comparator output regardless of arousal precision -- that would falsify Seth & Friston's prediction that interoceptive comparator output should be modulated by precision (neuromodulation analog). The made-feelings sub-cluster requires precision-modulated interoceptive comparator output.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Recent (2026) paper in Brain reframing functional neurological disorder as a disorder of precision control within predictive coding, explicitly placing the mechanism in a four-level hierarchy (affective, interoceptive, proprioceptive, spinal). Directly relevant to the made-feelings / interoceptive-passivity cluster: FND symptoms include made-feelings-shaped phenomena (loss of agency without wilfulness, give-way weakness, distractibility, entrainment) that arise from precision miscalibration at the interoceptive and affective levels. The four-level precision hierarchy maps onto the architectural question ARC-058 asks (shared vs separated trunk for aversive PE) -- if FND demonstrates that precision miscalibration can selectively affect interoceptive vs proprioceptive vs affective levels, that supports separable substrate per level rather than fully shared trunk. High source quality (Brain), high mapping fidelity for the substrate-level architectural question.
failure_signatures: If REE's affective/interoceptive harm streams are implemented with a fully shared forward-model trunk (the ARC-058 strong reading) but Lyndon's FND data shows clean dissociation across the four hierarchical levels under selective arousal challenges, the strong-shared-trunk reading should be retired in favour of separable-but-aligned streams.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Lancet Psychiatry review applying active inference to negative symptoms of schizophrenia (affective blunting, avolition, asociality), explicitly drawing links between social prediction, facial affect mirroring, interoception, and 'indistinctness of self-other boundaries.' Direct relevance to the made-feelings / interoceptive-passivity cluster: paranoid delusion content and self-other indistinctness are framed as the same predictive-precision miscalibration affecting interoceptive and social channels. The review proposes a computational story for how interoceptive uncertainty produces phenomenology that the agency_attribution_failure taxonomy entry needs to absorb. Source quality high (Lancet Psychiatry); mapping fidelity moderate because the review treats schizophrenia broadly rather than passivity cluster specifically.
failure_signatures: If the made-feelings / made-impulses sub-cluster of REE agency-attribution failure is implemented purely on a motor-style comparator (MECH-095 with motor channel only), the social-prediction and affect-mirroring components Jeganathan et al. argue are central will not be captured. The clinical story extends agency-attribution failure into social and interoceptive channels that REE V3 does not yet implement directly.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Authoritative review that lays out the computational landscape SD-048 is built to enable. The paper explicitly extends classical homeostatic reflex-arc control to flexible adaptive behaviour with interoceptive context, expectations, and forecasting -- the framework is exactly the one ARC-058's HarmForwardTrunk vs ARC-033's HarmForwardSeparate sit inside. SD-048 makes the substrate honest enough that this kind of computational model can be tested at all. Source quality very high (Trends in Neurosciences; Petzschner + Paulus + Khalsa coauthorship). Mapping fidelity high for Level 2 reafference cancellation framing. Transfer risk low-to-moderate -- the paper is a review, so its mapping holds across the broader category that SD-048 Sources 1-3 collectively instantiate.
failure_signatures: If SD-048 substrate cannot support the kind of computational interoceptive forward model the paper surveys -- e.g. comparator-style prediction-error signal across body-noise sources -- then the substrate fails to be the enabling substrate it claims to be.
If models trained on SD-048 substrate generalise poorly to held-out body-noise distributions, the broader interoceptive-prediction framework the paper articulates will not transfer.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Load-bearing for SD-048's framing of fatigue drift as a slow agent-independent body-state perturbation. Stephan et al. give an explicit Bayesian / hierarchical predictive-coding account in which chronic dyshomeostasis -- persistently enhanced surprise about bodily signals, equivalently low evidence for the brain's interoceptive generative model -- is exactly the substrate-level structure SD-048's fatigue source instantiates: a slow AR(1) drift that does not arise from current motor output. The metacognitive layer reading allostatic self-efficacy as belief-about-the-controller's-competence maps onto the comparator gate the SD doc invokes (whether the agent's interoceptive forward model can keep up). Source quality very high (Stephan, Friston-trained TNU group, Seth + Fleming + Petzschner coauthors). Mapping fidelity high for Source 3 (fatigue) and Level 2 framing; lower for Sources 1 and 2 individually, which the framework subsumes but does not differentiate.
failure_signatures: If SD-048's fatigue source produces no detectable change in the comparator's prediction error or in the precision (Bayesian uncertainty) on its outputs, that would weaken Stephan et al.'s claim that chronic dyshomeostasis is the relevant interoceptive signature -- and weaken SD-048's case that fatigue drift is doing the substrate work it advertises.

If REE's interoceptive comparator never tracks fatigue drift because the slow AR(1) timescale exceeds the comparator's effective horizon, the prediction-error signature predicted by Stephan et al. for chronic dyshomeostasis cannot be obtained on this substrate -- a substrate-ceiling pattern.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical framework establishing that a blocked/extinguished trace is not erased but preserved and re-expressed under context change (renewal, spontaneous recovery, reinstatement, rapid reacquisition). Strongly validates ARC-060/SD-039's preserve-don't-erase architecture. Held at 0.75 because it simultaneously weakens the sub-claim that MECH-292's recoverability gate can be inhibition-only: biology shows that without an explicit erase path, rumination/intrusion is the predicted equilibrium, not an aberration.
failure_signatures: A cue/behaviour judged 'extinguished' (zero response) re-expresses at full strength merely because the test context differs from the extinction context (renewal) -- a 'resolved' goal returns on context change with no new evidence.
Elapsed time alone reinstates the inactive trace (spontaneous recovery): suppression is treated as time-bounded.
A single outcome re-exposure (reinstatement) or one reinforced repetition (rapid reacquisition) snaps the whole inactive trace back -- small triggers produce disproportionate full return.
Inhibition is more context-specific than excitation, so the maladaptive original trace generalises across contexts better than its suppression -- the system is structurally biased toward relapse.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct human single-unit evidence that an internally generated cue reinstates the original episode-specific trace, and does so ~1.5 s before the content reaches verbal report. This is the strongest available warrant that an internal goal/context vector is a legitimate retrieval cue (MECH-293's internally triggered probe). Held below 0.85 because it is correlational -- it shows reinstatement precedes report, not that the internal cue causes selection of that trace -- and it does not adjudicate the matching rule.
failure_signatures: Only a sparse, item-specific subset of episode-selective neurons reliably reactivated at recall -- not every stored trace is addressable by the internal cue.
The paper characterises successful reinstatement only; the common recall-omission case (internal cue evokes no reinstatement) is left uncharacterised, so the silent-miss boundary is unknown.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Net supports modelling deferred/blocked goals as persistent context-recoverable OPERANT traces (extends Bouton 2004 from Pavlovian cues to voluntary action policies -- directly the bank's case). But it specifically and strongly WEAKENS the recoverability-gate-can-close assumption: accumulated suppression evidence (36 vs 4 sessions, identical resurgence) does not retire the trace, so a literal recoverability cutoff is biologically unsupported. Confidence moderate: behavioural-only, clinically framed, no quantitative gate.
failure_signatures: Resurgence: a deferred goal that was successfully replaced by an alternative returns the moment the alternative stops paying off -- relapse triggered by loss of the substitute, not by the original cue (retiring an anchor because a competitor is winning is unsafe).

Extended elimination training does not reduce return (36 sessions = 4 sessions resurgence): more evidence of hopelessness does not make the trace safer to drop; an evidence-integrating recoverability gate will be falsely confident.
Rapid reacquisition: one lapse restores the full behaviour because the reinforced trial is itself part of the original context.
Reinstatement after punishment: aversively suppressed behaviour returns after a single outcome reminder -- knowledge of bad consequences does not durably retire the trace.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical causal demonstration that biological cued recall is genuinely partial-cue pattern completion (CA3-specific NMDA knockout selectively abolishes partial-cue recall while sparing encoding and full-cue recall). High source quality. Confidence held below 0.9 by the transfer gap: the REE bank does a single linear cosine readout, not recurrent attractor dynamics, so it inherits the behaviour but not the basin-interference failure modes.
failure_signatures: When too few of the original cues remain, completion fails outright and the correct trace is not retrieved (CA3-NR1 mutants impaired specifically in the partial-cue condition).
Place-cell representational stability silently degrades under partial-cue conditions when recurrent NMDA plasticity is absent -- the cue->trace map fails quietly rather than signalling an error.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Provides the causal anatomical substrate for cue-matched-trace -> instrumental invigoration and a clean double dissociation of outcome-specific (BLA) vs general (CeA) cue-driven vigor, replicated one synapse downstream by Corbit & Balleine 2011 (NAc shell vs core) including reversible inactivation at test. Directly validates separating goal_match (specific) from a general wanting/arousal gain in ghost_priority. Held below 0.85 because the biology insists these are dissociable channels, not one multiplicative product.
failure_signatures: CeA/NAc-core-type failure: cues generally invigorate ANY available action regardless of whether it earns the cue's predicted goal -- nonspecific arousal-driven over-pursuit.
BLA/NAc-shell-type failure: loss of the cue->specific-goal mapping, so a matched cue no longer preferentially re-probes its own deferred goal while generic drive persists.
Because expression depends on these structures at test (2011 muscimol), a well-encoded cue can fail to invigorate if the retrieval-time channel is offline -- 'stored but un-actionable' bank entries.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: RL^2 is the foundational ML implementation of meta-RL. It demonstrates that a recurrent network trained on a distribution of MDPs learns, in its hidden state, a fast inner-loop RL algorithm that adapts to new MDPs without weight updates. For Pull 4 it grounds the Wang 2018 biological-mapping paper in a concrete, well-tested ML framework that REE could adopt directly. Confidence not higher because RL^2 is a preprint that did not get accepted at ICLR (in the published form) and because the empirical demonstrations are simulated bandit/maze tasks rather than the long-horizon continuous-state regimes REE cares about.

RL^2 known failure mode: the hidden state has limited capacity and meta-learns a *task-distribution-specific* algorithm rather than a general one. If REE adopts RL^2 vocabulary, it inherits this limitation.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the foundational schema-tradition paper that introduced the dual-mechanism architecture (contention scheduling + supervisory attentional system) underpinning four decades of executive-function neuroscience. For Pull 4 it is the canonical citation for the SAS = top-down rule-application override, and for the dual-mechanism architecture that closely parallels REE's ARC-062 + MECH-312 split. Confidence not higher because it is conceptual/theoretical without empirical anchoring of its own (later work like Shallice 1988, Cooper-Shallice 2000, and the meta-analysis literature provides that), and because the SAS-as-single-system framing has been refined into multiple-component executive systems in modern accounts (Stuss 2011, Diamond 2013).
failure_signatures: If REE's ARC-062 gated_policy + discriminator cannot be functionally separated from MECH-312 arbitration in the way SAS is separated from contention scheduling, the dual-mechanism claim is weakened.

The SAS framework predicts dissociable patient lesion patterns: frontal SAS-lesion produces utilisation-behaviour / capture-error syndrome; basal-ganglia / contention-scheduling lesion produces apraxia / sequencing-error syndrome. If REE's ARC-062 and MECH-312 cannot be selectively ablated to produce dissociable failure modes, the architectural separation is not load-bearing.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The explicit adjudication of the fork. Lundqvist, Herman & Miller argue the standard 'persistent spiking' picture is largely an artifact of averaging spikes across time and trials; single-trial activity occurs in sparse transient gamma bursts, and information is carried BETWEEN spikes by short-term synaptic plasticity ('impressions left in the network'). Delay activity is a WM mechanism, but it is sparse, not persistent. Resolves the autopsy's A-vs-B fork toward B (with sparse bursty reactivation), and underwrites both CRF prescriptions: activity-decoupled maintenance + a non-per-tick-firing readout.
failure_signatures: Trial-and-time-averaged firing creates an ILLUSION of continuous persistent activity that disappears on single trials (sparse bursts). A maintenance readout built on smoothed/aggregate activity (or on per-tick active fraction) inherits this artifact and misreads sparse-but-maintained as either continuous or absent.

If information is carried between spikes by synaptic 'impressions', then any activity-based availability accounting necessarily under-counts maintained-but-silent rules -- exactly the crf_frac_active 0.016 collapse in the differentiated regime.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, replicated single-unit demonstration that dorsolateral PFC neurons hold a selective representation across an input-absent delay by sustained firing -- the existence proof for the rule/task-set-cell maintenance class ARC-063 instantiates. High source quality. Marked supports (not fork-deciding) because it establishes that maintenance of the CURRENTLY-RELEVANT item is carried by persistent delay activity; it does NOT speak to holding several differentiated, currently-unselected rules at once, which is the CRF's actual bottleneck. mapping_fidelity is moderate: the CRF needs a maintained POOL, this paper shows one engaged memorandum.
failure_signatures: Persistent delay-period firing is demonstrated for the single item currently held in memory (one cued location per trial); the paradigm does not require, and does not show, simultaneous sustained maintenance of multiple distinct task rules. Read literally it licenses sustained activity only for the engaged/selected rule, not for an available-but-unmatched pool.

Memory fields are spatially tuned and the delay activity is for an item that was just cued and will imminently be acted on -- i.e. the attended/selected item -- so it cannot be cited as evidence that an UNSELECTED rule must keep firing across long context-absent gaps.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical recurrent-attractor ('bump attractor') mechanistic model of how persistent delay activity is sustained: strong recurrent excitation (NMDA-dominated) balanced by inhibition holds a self-sustaining activity bump with no external input. Strongly supports fork A as a MECHANISM for maintaining the engaged item. Marked mixed for ARC-063 because the same model exposes fork A's ceiling for the CRF's problem: an attractor network holds ONE bump (a few items at most), is metabolically expensive (tonic high-rate firing), and is prone to drift/interference -- it does not scale to silently holding a differentiated POOL of 10-16 sparsely-matching rules, which is exactly the CRF regime in V3-EXQ-666 ARM_2.
failure_signatures: A continuous-attractor (bump) network sustains a single localized activity packet; capacity is small and adding more simultaneously-active memoranda causes bumps to merge or compete. It cannot maintain a large pool of distinct currently-unselected rules by persistent firing.

Persistent-firing maintenance is metabolically costly (all maintained items fire tonically at elevated rates for the whole delay) and the bump drifts over time and is disrupted by distractors -- arguing against per-tick sustained firing as the maintenance substrate for an availability POOL that must persist across thousands of ticks.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The decisive mechanistic model for fork B and the most directly IMPLEMENTABLE answer for the CRF. Working memory is maintained by calcium-mediated short-term synaptic FACILITATION on recurrent connections: a memory leaves a synaptic trace that persists for ~1 s WITHOUT any spiking, can be refreshed by sparse activity at a low rate, and is read out when input arrives. Gives the CRF a concrete maintenance primitive: a non-firing, slowly-decaying, sparsely-refreshable availability trace decoupled from per-tick activity. Supports ARC-063's maintenance need and supplies the exact mechanism. Slightly below ceiling because it is a model, and the biological time constant (~1 s) is far shorter than the CRF's thousands-of-ticks horizon -- the principle transfers, the constant does not.
failure_signatures: Facilitation-based maintenance has a finite decay time constant (calcium kinetics, ~1 s); a trace not refreshed within that window is lost. A pure synaptic-trace CRF availability with too-fast decay reproduces the 666 collapse; the maintenance horizon must be set deliberately, not inherited from the biological constant.

The synaptic trace is capacity- and interference-limited: many overlapping memories compete for the same synaptic resources. A differentiated CRF pool is the favourable case (distinct, pinned directions -> low interference), but the model warns that maintenance is not free and unbounded.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Authoritative primate-electrophysiology defence of the persistent-firing (pole A) account, co-authored by the Goldman-Rakic/Arnsten lineage. High source quality. It SUPPORTS the existence of a maintained prefrontal rule/cue representation across the delay (the ARC-063 rule-cell class is real) but it argues AGAINST the activity-silent / synaptic-only reading that the V3-EXQ-666 autopsy leans toward -- hence 'mixed' relative to the substrate fork. Mapping fidelity is moderate: their object is delay-period spike rate to a remembered cue, not availability of a sparsely-matched differentiated rule, which is the regime where even they concede single cells are not continuously active.
failure_signatures: If the CRF abandons any sustained-availability term and relies purely on a fast synaptic trace, this camp's data (selective delay-period elevation of firing in PFC rule/cue cells) is the evidence it would be ignoring -- a pure activity-silent fix risks under-modelling the genuine sustained component.

Their critique that synaptic-plasticity-only and rhythmic-only models are 'inconsistent with the neurophysiological data' is a caution against a CRF fix that maintains rules ONLY between matches with no above-threshold readout ever -- the truth is a hybrid, not either pole exclusively.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the deliberate counter-current paper. Botvinick and Plaut show that a single recurrent connectionist network can reproduce all the routine-sequential-action behaviour the Cooper-Shallice schema-hierarchy model produces -- including the action-disorganisation-syndrome lesion patterns -- *without any explicit schema hierarchy*. Context is encoded in distributed, recurrent state. This directly weakens the architectural commitment that REE's ARC-062/064/MECH-318 cluster needs an explicit rule-state-abstraction substrate at all. Confidence is calibrated to weakens-direction: this paper is a serious challenge to the explicit-rule-abstraction view, but it has not won the field -- subsequent options/HRL literature continues to assume explicit hierarchical decomposition.
failure_signatures: If REE's existing latent-stack representations (z_world, z_self) when given recurrent dynamics are sufficient to support routine sequential action without an explicit MECH-318 substrate, then MECH-318 is a redundant claim and the relevant Pull 2 R2 verdict is wrong.

Botvinick-Plaut 2004 predicts that recurrent connectionist networks lesioned in their representational substrate will produce ADS-like patterns indistinguishable from schema-hierarchy lesions. If REE's V3 substrate cannot reproduce ADS-like patterns under representational lesion, the connectionist account is the more parsimonious one and MECH-318 should be questioned.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Solway et al. give a normative theory for what makes a behavioural hierarchy optimal -- one that balances task-decomposition entropy with sub-policy reusability -- and provide four behavioural experiments showing humans spontaneously discover hierarchies close to the optimum. This is directly relevant to ARC-064: it tells us bottom-up rule discovery in humans is approximately optimisation of a specific objective, and gives us a candidate objective. Confidence not higher because the empirical experiments are simple maze tasks and the optimum is sensitive to task-distribution assumptions.
failure_signatures: If REE's MECH-316 (cross-episode-regularity-extraction) cannot be expressed as approximate optimisation of the Solway hierarchical-cost objective, the inheritance pathway from this paper to MECH-316 weakens.

If REE's discovered behavioural hierarchies in long V3 runs do not match the bottleneck-state pattern Solway predicts, the bottom-up rule discovery substrate is implementing something other than optimal decomposition.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The option-critic architecture closes the gap between Sutton-Precup-Singh 1999 (formalism) and ARC-064 (we need an option-discovery algorithm). It derives policy-gradient theorems for both the intra-option policy and the termination condition, and shows that the agent can simultaneously learn options end-to-end from environment reward without subgoals or pseudo-rewards. This is directly the substrate algorithm that ARC-064 + MECH-317 need. Confidence not 1.0 because (a) it needs reward signal so it does not handle the reward-agnostic chunking case, (b) the empirical demonstrations are on Atari/four-rooms, not biological agents, and (c) the discovered options often collapse to short-horizon (the so-called option-collapse problem) which is exactly the kind of failure mode REE's monomodal-collapse motif touches.
failure_signatures: If REE's MECH-317 cannot be implemented as a learned termination condition + intra-option policy + gating layer, the option-critic transfer fails and we need a different inheritance path.

Option-collapse (Bacon 2017's known failure mode: discovered options become trivially short or trivially identical) is the exact REE-side failure pattern observed in V3-EXQ-543 (ARM_1c seed-2 byte-identical to baseline). The diagnostic signatures match across paradigms; the inherited diagnostic tool here is the option-collapse literature.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the foundational options framework paper -- the canonical citation for any work on temporally abstract policies. It defines the option triple (initiation set I, intra-option policy pi, termination condition beta), proves SMDP value-learning convergence under standard conditions, and gives Bellman equations for option-level planning. Mapping fidelity to REE rule-apprehension vocabulary is HIGH for the bottom-up rule discovery cluster (ARC-064) and MECH-317 behavioural-pattern-compression (an option IS a chunked behavioural pattern with start, body, and stop). Confidence not 1.0 because options-as-formalism does not yet specify how options are *discovered* -- that is left to follow-on work (Stolle 2002, Bacon 2017, Eysenbach 2018).
failure_signatures: If REE's MECH-317 (action-chunking) does not have a clean option-triple representation (no initiation set, no termination condition, no intra-option policy), the inheritance pathway from this paper fails -- we either have to add those primitives or accept that MECH-317 is not really option-machinery.
If REE's ARC-064 bottom-up rule discovery produces representations that cannot be translated into options, the claim that 'rule apprehension is policy machinery in different vocabulary' is falsified.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This review paper synthesises two complementary mechanisms for fast learning that directly map to REE's architecture: episodic memory (cross-episode regularity extraction = MECH-316) and meta-RL (within-episode adaptation = Wang 2018 entry). It explicitly frames both as solutions to the slow-RL sample-complexity problem, which is what REE's bottom-up rule discovery is also trying to solve. Confidence not higher because the paper is a review rather than original empirical work, and because the clean fast/slow dichotomy may oversimplify the more complex multi-timescale picture Pull 2 R3 surfaced (online + offline + sleep-mediated consolidation).
failure_signatures: If REE's MECH-316 cross-episode-regularity-extraction does not produce the same kind of episodic-memory-mediated fast-learning signature (rapid generalisation to novel tasks based on stored episode memories) the Botvinick 2019 episodic-RL framing predicts, the inheritance pathway weakens.

The fast/slow dichotomy may collapse REE's three-timescale structure (online + within-episode + sleep-mediated consolidation) into two; if so, REE has a finer-grained timing structure than the literature, which would be a candidate KEEP-AS-IS for R3.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: PASS with supporting direction

High-quality synthesis that draws the field's load-bearing distinction -- KNOWLEDGE-based vs COMPETENCE-based intrinsic motivation -- and argues they are functionally distinct drives with distinct mechanisms. Direction is MIXED for REE: it supports the legitimacy of REE's existing knowledge-based stack (MECH-314 family) as one half of IM, but it documents that REE has NO competence-based IM claim at all, which is exactly the missing ingredient WS-1's competence floor implicates. Confidence is high on the conceptual distinction (mapping fidelity strong) but the source is a conceptual/review chapter, not a single decisive experiment.
failure_signatures: Knowledge-based IM (novelty, prediction error, learning progress on the WORLD MODEL) improves the agent's model but does not by itself reward the acquisition of SKILLS/competence -- an agent can be maximally curious and still behaviourally incompetent (the exact WS-1 pattern: curiosity substrate wired, foraging still zero).

Competence-based IM requires a repertoire of self-generated GOALS and a per-goal competence-progress estimator; without an explicit goal representation to measure improvement against, competence-based IM cannot be computed -- a substrate with only a global scalar novelty bonus cannot host it.

Conflating the two IM types (using a single knowledge-based signal to drive skill learning) produces agents that explore richly but never consolidate reusable competences -- the pathology the chapter is written to prevent.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical RL-side instantiation of MECH-314a (novelty/count-based bonus): it derives a PSEUDOCOUNT from a density model so that count-based novelty generalises from the tabular case to high-dimensional non-tabular states, and shows a large exploration gain on Montezuma's Revenge. High source quality (NeurIPS, ~1300 citations). Supports MECH-314a's core mechanism (recency/rarity-of-encounter bonus) AND supplies the exact estimator REE needs to make a count-based bonus computable in a learned latent space rather than a tabular grid.
failure_signatures: The pseudocount is only as good as the density model: a poorly-fit or slowly-adapting density model gives mis-calibrated novelty, either over-rewarding already-seen states or failing to flag genuinely novel ones.

Count-based novelty is a LEVEL signal (rarity), not a derivative -- it shares MECH-314a's vulnerability to the noisy-TV / stochastic-trap failure Oudeyer & Kaplan flag: irreducibly random states stay perpetually 'novel' and can sink exploration budget.

The bonus decays as counts accumulate, so it drives COVERAGE (visit-everything) not COMPETENCE (achieve-goals); on Montezuma it helps reach new rooms but does not by itself teach robust goal-directed skill.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational formalisation of learning-progress-as-compression-progress that MECH-314c already cites (Schmidhuber 1991). Very high source quality. Direction is MIXED, not pure support: it corroborates the derivative-of-model-quality signal REE registered, but Schmidhuber's own framing folds curiosity, creativity, and skill acquisition into a SINGLE scalar intrinsic reward on ONE world-model+controller, which is exactly the single-functional framing REE's three-incommensurable-channels design (ARC-021/MECH-069) deliberately rejects. It is therefore simultaneously supporting evidence for MECH-314c and a documented instance of the design REE argues against.
failure_signatures: The intrinsic reward is a single scalar (compression progress) maximised by one RL controller -- a wireheading/self-delusion surface: the agent can be drawn to data it can trivially make more compressible, and the theory needs the environment to supply genuinely novel learnable regularity to avoid degenerate loops.

Compression progress rewards improving the WORLD MODEL (knowledge), not achieving GOALS (competence); Schmidhuber acknowledges skills are acquired only as a side effect of seeking compressible data, so it does not by itself guarantee the agent crosses a behavioural competence floor.

Requires a compressor whose improvement is measurable and attributable to the agent's actions; in high-dimensional stochastic input the compression-progress estimate is noisy and can misattribute environmental change to agent learning.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical source that MECH-314's typology (novelty / info-gain / learning-progress sub-flavours) is organised around, and the direct namesake of MECH-314c (learning_progress_curiosity). Very high source quality (foundational, thousands of citations, defines the field's vocabulary). Mapping fidelity is high because REE's three-way MECH-314/314a/314c split IS Oudeyer & Kaplan's typology re-expressed; the caveat is that Oudeyer & Kaplan derive learning-progress as the reward signal that provably avoids the two failure modes REE's Phase-1 broadcast-scalar instantiation does NOT yet avoid.
failure_signatures: Prediction-error / novelty maximization (MECH-314a-like) drives the agent to unlearnable stochastic regions -- the 'noisy TV' / white-noise trap -- because raw unpredictability is maximal where nothing can be learned.
Predictability-maximization (the dual: seek maximally predictable states) collapses the agent onto trivial, already-mastered regions -- the 'blank wall' trap.

Only the DERIVATIVE (rate of change of predictive error = learning progress), not the level of error or novelty, tracks genuine competence acquisition; a scalar novelty/PE bonus without the derivative is vulnerable to both traps.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Pre-registered as a primary anchor for ARC-066 with the explicit gloss that LC-NE tonic mode provides a directional bias TOWARD action (distinct from MECH-313's noise function). The 2005 theoretical framework is consistent with that reading at the conceptual level (tonic mode = disengagement + search for alternatives = directional shift toward exploration / action). However, the same authors' subsequent direct empirical test (Kane et al. 2017, separate entry) found LC-NE tonic effects are noise-mediated, not directional. This entry is therefore mixed: the 2005 theoretical paper is the original architectural anchor for the LC-NE-direction reading of ARC-066, but the 2017 follow-up by the same group weakens that reading. The lower confidence (0.62 vs the 0.84 it received as the LC-NE-substrate anchor in ARC-065) reflects the R2-verdict downgrade: this paper is now evidence for what ARC-066 is NOT (i.e., not an LC-NE-direction function distinct from MECH-313).
failure_signatures: If REE attempts to instantiate ARC-066 as an LC-NE-direction analog based on the Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 framework, it will fail to compose with MECH-313 (already substrate-landed as the LC-NE noise floor). The original theoretical disambiguation between phasic-mode-as-exploitation and tonic-mode-as-exploration was shown by Kane 2017 to collapse the 'tonic-mode-as-exploration' channel into a noise effect, which is what MECH-313 already implements.

If a future child mechanism for ARC-066 cites Aston-Jones 2005 as primary substrate evidence without citing Kane 2017 as the disambiguating empirical test, governance review should flag the omission. Current evidence supports MESOLIMBIC DA (Salamone, Niv) as the ARC-066 substrate, not LC-NE.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the load-bearing R2 paper. Kane et al. ran a direct causal test of the Aston-Jones LC-NE-tonic-mode prediction in rats using DREADDs to selectively elevate LC tonic activity, and explicitly modelled whether the resulting earlier patch-leaving was best explained by (a) increased decision noise or (b) a directional bias on the leave threshold. The published finding is unambiguous: noise-best-explanation, no detectable directional shift. This is the strongest available empirical evidence on whether LC-NE tonic mode provides a SEPARATE directional-action-bias function distinct from MECH-313's noise floor. The verdict is that LC-NE tonic mode is one mechanism (noise), not two -- pushing ARC-066's substrate attribution AWAY from LC-NE and TOWARD mesolimbic DA / BAS.
failure_signatures: If REE attributes ARC-066 to an LC-NE-direction substrate analog, it will fail to reproduce Kane 2017's empirical pattern. The published evidence is that LC-NE tonic effect on patch-leaving is noise-mediated, not direction-mediated -- a directional-bias-only LC-NE mechanism would produce a different pattern (consistent leave-threshold shift, reduced variance) than what Kane observed.

If a future REE child mechanism for ARC-066 is wired with LC-NE-mediated gain modulation, it should be expected to compose redundantly with MECH-313 (which already covers LC-NE noise), and the Kane 2017 caveat means the directional-bias function would have no clear biological substrate to anchor it.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Salamone & Correa make the cleanest published case for dissociating mesolimbic DA's role in BEHAVIOURAL ACTIVATION / EXERTION OF EFFORT / SUSTAINED TASK ENGAGEMENT (the activational dimension) from its role in HEDONIC value or consummatory liking. The dissociation is grounded in decades of pharmacology data (DA antagonist / accumbens DA depletion experiments) showing instrumental / preparatory / approach behaviour is selectively impaired while consumption is preserved. This is load-bearing for R1: it gives ARC-066 a mesolimbic DA substrate that is target-INDEPENDENT (about behavioural activation generally) rather than tied to specific reward delivery. Slightly weakened by the paper's exclusively rodent/primate pharmacology grounding -- the human version of this dissociation is in companion papers (Treadway, Beierholm, Chong) not in Salamone & Correa directly.
failure_signatures: An REE substrate that wires ARC-066 to the same mechanism as z_goal-driven wanting (specific-target seeking) will fail to reproduce the Salamone & Correa dissociation: DA depletion should selectively impair effortful instrumental responding while leaving consummatory choice intact. If REE collapses these into one substrate, the dissociation cannot be reproduced.

An REE substrate that ties ARC-066 to hedonic 'liking' (MECH-295) will fail: the literature is explicit that DA effort-vigor activation is dissociable from hedonic value. ARC-066 should compose with but not be substituted for liking.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Theoretical-formal anchor for the average-reward-rate / tonic-DA / vigor account. The opportunity-cost derivation makes the architectural commitment of ARC-066 mathematically explicit (a long-run average reward rate enters the cost-benefit equation as an additive cost on time-spent-passive, equivalently an additive bonus on time-spent-acting). Companion empirical paper Beierholm 2013 provides the human-pharmacological causal test, which is the reason this is not the highest-confidence entry on its own. Cited >2200 times; load-bearing for R1 substrate-attribution and R3 implementation-shape verdicts.
failure_signatures: An REE substrate that does not maintain a long-window average-reward-rate integrator will fail to reproduce Niv's vigor-as-opportunity-cost predictions: response latencies should shorten as the average reward history rises, even when the local reward expectation is unchanged. Without ARC-066, REE has no signal that produces this scaling -- z_goal targets are local, not history-integrated.

If the ARC-066 child mechanism uses a fast (single-episode) reward-rate integrator instead of a slow (across-episode) one, the vigor signal will collapse onto z_goal and fail Niv's distinguishing prediction that vigor is set by long-run reward history independent of any specific currently-pursued target.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: JMLR publication (submitted 2017, published 2022); grounded in developmental robotics and infant curiosity research; demonstrates automatic curriculum generation through learning progress maximisation across a parameterised goal space. Highly relevant to REE's infant-stage substrate problem: IMGEP's learning-progress-driven curriculum prevents monostrategy by actively seeking goals where the agent is currently making progress, rather than goals where it has already converged. Maps onto ARC-066 (tonic vigor) and ARC-072 (hippocampal cue-indexed goal repertoire). Main caveat: IMGEP's goal space is explicitly parameterised and continuous; REE's goal space is more implicit.
failure_signatures: Learning-progress-based goal selection can stall if the agent reaches a plateau on all current goals simultaneously -- the system needs a mechanism to invent new goals or expand the goal space when progress is zero everywhere.

IMGEP requires the agent to have already learned to pursue some goals before it can generate a useful learning-progress curriculum. A cold-start agent with no goal representation cannot initialise the system -- suggests IMGEP-like curricula require a bootstrapping phase (infant babbling analog) before they can generate diversity.

Without an explicit goal-space parameterisation, learning progress is not computable. REE's implicit goal representation (residue field wanting) needs to be made explicit enough to track per-goal progress for an IMGEP-like curriculum to operate.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Functional review arguing that boredom serves an adaptive role: motivating pursuit of new goals when the current goal is no longer beneficial. The functional-role argument is convergent with van Tilburg & Igou 2017 but framed at a coarser level (goal-pursuit-shift rather than meaning-seeking-action). Source quality moderate (open-access journal, peer-reviewed but lower-tier than Psych Review or Emotion); high relevance to R1 functional account but the mechanism specification is less detailed than van Tilburg or Westgate. Mapping fidelity strong for the goal-shift framing.
failure_signatures: An ARC-067 substrate that produces aversive pressure but no goal-shift behaviour (the agent merely sits and feels the aversive without changing direction) fails Bench & Lench's functional account -- boredom is supposed to drive the agent off its current trajectory toward an alternative, not merely to register dissatisfaction.

If the boredom-driven goal-shift is indiscriminate (any new goal, regardless of expected value), the substrate produces erratic switching rather than the value-sensitive shift Bench & Lench describe. This boundary distinguishes ARC-067 from a pure stimulation-seeking mechanism.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational Nature Reviews piece on HPA-axis stress regulation. High source quality, but mapping to ARC-067 is INDIRECT -- the paper does not address boredom specifically; it addresses physical and psychological stress more generally. Relevance is for the R2 chronic-timescale verdict and as substrate context for the R5 anhedonia/abulia anchor: chronic understimulation regimes produce HPA-axis dysregulation, which is one candidate substrate-mapping for the chronic-anhedonic-flatness pole of the timescale split. Direction is 'mixed' because the paper neither directly supports nor weakens ARC-067; it provides substrate context but the specific mapping to chronic boredom is inferential.
failure_signatures: If ARC-067's chronic timescale is implemented as a simple slow-extension of the acute mechanism (single-substrate, two-rate-constant model) and the chronic substrate maps onto HPA-axis-like dysregulation, the predicted ablation signature should resemble HPA-related anhedonic phenotypes (cortisol-flat-affect signatures). An ARC-067 substrate without a chronic-axis component will fail to reproduce these phenotypes if R2 splits the timescales.

If chronic understimulation does NOT engage HPA-axis substrates in REE-analogous ways, the chronic-pole of the R2 split needs a different substrate framing (purely-cortical accumulator, dopaminergic mesolimbic, etc.) -- this paper bounds but does not settle the substrate.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Eleven-study Science paper showing that participants find spending 6-15 minutes alone with their thoughts so aversive that many self-administer electric shocks rather than continue. Directly demonstrates the architectural commitment ARC-067 names: doing-nothing is not neutral, it is actively aversive enough to recruit costly action. Behavioural-aversive evidence is the strongest possible support short of direct neuroimaging. Source quality very high (Science, multiple replications across 11 studies); transfer risk modest because the demonstration is on enforced disengagement rather than lifelong-low-engagement steady state.
failure_signatures: An REE substrate that treats no-op as zero-cost (no aversive accumulation under enforced disengagement) directly fails to reproduce the Wilson 2014 finding. The agent should prefer a costly action (analog: a small-but-nonzero z_harm cost or resource cost) to continued no-op when no other action is available.

If the boredom aversive accumulates only over very long timescales (chronic / sessions only), the substrate will fail Wilson's 6-to-15-minute experimental window -- the acute timescale must produce measurable aversive within tens of episodes, not just over hundreds. This supports R2's acute/chronic timescale split.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Top-tier theoretical paper in Psychological Review proposing the Meaning-and-Attentional-Component (MAC) model. Decomposes boredom into two semi-independent profiles: (a) attentional misfit (cognitive demands vs available resources, both under- and over-stimulation), and (b) meaning misfit (activities vs valued goals, or absence of valued goals). The two-component decomposition is the load-bearing R1 finding -- it forces the verdict away from a single-cause functional account toward a compositional one. Source quality very high; mapping fidelity high for the architectural shape; transfer risk modest.
failure_signatures: An REE substrate that implements only a single-component boredom (engagement-rate aversive, no meaning component) will fail to discriminate between MAC-attentional and MAC-meaning profiles -- e.g., it will collapse over- and under-stimulated boredom into one signal when MAC predicts they should arise from different substrates with different downstream signatures.

If the MAC two-component decomposition is correct, a discriminative test pair should hold: under-stimulation arms (low cognitive demand, low novelty) and meaning-violation arms (high engagement but goal-incongruent task) should both produce boredom-like behaviour, but with separable internal signatures. An ARC-067 substrate that implements only the engagement-rate channel will fail the meaning-violation arm.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational definitional paper that synthesises psychodynamic, existential, arousal, and cognitive theories of boredom into a single attention-anchored construct: 'the aversive experience of wanting, but being unable, to engage in satisfying activity.' Highest-relevance R1 paper for the functional-emotion-engagement-search account. Mapping to ARC-067 is direct: the architectural commitment that prolonged low-engagement is itself aversive maps onto Eastwood's 'wanting-to-engage-but-unable' definition. Source quality strong (peer-reviewed integrative review in Perspectives on Psychological Science); transfer risk modest because the construct is human-introspective and the REE substrate is computational, but the functional shape transfers cleanly.
failure_signatures: An REE substrate that does not produce action-pressure under sustained low-engagement (well-fed, safe, familiar, no z_goal) will fail to reproduce the Eastwood 'wanting-to-engage-but-unable' phenomenology and thus will not exhibit the boredom-driven exploratory behaviour Eastwood treats as definitional.

If the ARC-067 mechanism is implemented as inverted novelty (novelty-bonus going negative when novelty rate is low), the substrate will incorrectly mark genuinely novel-but-non-interactive territory as engaging, which Eastwood's definition rules out -- the agent is bored if it wants engagement but cannot achieve it, regardless of stimulus novelty.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical Salamone-Correa review establishing that accumbens dopamine mediates the ACTIVATIONAL aspect of motivation -- the willingness to expend effort against work-related response costs -- separable from primary reinforcement / hedonic reward. This is the load-bearing anchor for R4 (effort-cost vs opportunity-cost separation): Salamone's cost is a movement-energy / response-cost term, NOT an opportunity-cost-on-time term. The two are dissociable. The paper supports ARC-068 indirectly by showing that the activational scalar Niv 2007 attributes to opportunity-cost-on-time has a parallel but DISTINCT effort-cost-on-action substrate (also DA-mediated). For REE this licenses keeping ARC-068 architecturally separate from MECH-258 (cingulate.precision_weighted_pain_PE) effort-cost machinery while acknowledging both terms ride on the same DA system.
failure_signatures: If REE collapses ARC-068 (opportunity-cost-on-time) into the existing effort-cost machinery (MECH-258 et al), Salamone's framework predicts the resulting agent will fail to dissociate the two: DA-depleted Salamone animals reallocate FROM high-effort high-reward TO low-effort low-reward, but they retain primary appetite for food. An REE substrate that conflates effort-cost and opportunity-cost will not reproduce this dissociation under simulated DA depletion (e.g. parametric reduction of the relevant scalar).

If ARC-068 is instantiated as a movement-energy cost (Salamone's term) rather than a time-foregone-reward cost (Niv's term), it will fail to fire in the well-fed-safe-familiar regime where no movement is being attempted -- Salamone's term scales with movement; ARC-068's must scale with elapsed time independent of motor activity.

If the implementation lumps opportunity-cost and effort-cost into a single signed scalar, the agent's response to environmental changes will be non-physiological: Salamone's effort-cost responds to action requirements (ratio schedule), Niv's opportunity-cost responds to reward history (rate of reward). They have different temporal kernels; collapsing them produces a kernel that is neither.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The Shenhav lab's empirical reinterpretation of the dACC-foraging-value signal as choice-difficulty tracking. Direction `weakens` for ARC-068's reliance on the dACC-foraging-value substrate as a clean biological anchor for opportunity-cost-on-rest. If Shenhav is right, the dACC signal Kolling identified is generic choice-difficulty rather than a dedicated foraging-value computation, and ARC-068's biological grounding becomes the Niv 2007 mesolimbic-DA tonic-scalar substrate (not a cingulate signal at all). Confidence moderate because the question is genuinely contested -- this is one side of an active debate, not a settled finding. R1 verdict critically depends on this paper's interpretation prevailing.
failure_signatures: If Shenhav's choice-difficulty interpretation is correct, the SD-032b dACC foraging_value computation does not have the substrate-grounding the implementation_note attributes to it. Both SD-032b and ARC-068 lose their dACC-as-foraging-substrate anchor; ARC-068 falls back to Niv's mesolimbic-DA substrate, SD-032b loses its principal anchor.

If Shenhav is partially correct (dACC carries both signals but choice-difficulty dominates), the multi-signal framing of Kolling 2016 holds with a different signal weighting -- ARC-068 and SD-032b can still be architecturally separate but the dACC connection for either is weaker than literature commonly assumes.

If Kolling is correct and Shenhav's reinterpretation is wrong (choice-difficulty signals are confounds, not the primary dACC computation), then SD-032b's foraging-value anchor holds -- but ARC-068's separation from SD-032b still has to lean on the timescale / kernel argument (Niv long-run vs Kolling current-environmental), not on substrate.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Critical empirical paper for R2 (reward-rate kernel verdict). Constantino & Daw directly test the marginal-value-theorem opportunity-cost-as-learned-threshold model against temporal-difference learning, in a human patch-foraging task with parametric variation of opportunity cost across blocks. The MVT threshold-learning rule (long-window historical avg-reward over previous rewards) wins decisively over TD. This is the load-bearing empirical evidence that the kernel for opportunity-cost computation IS a long-window historical average, not a fast TD-style estimator. Confidence high because the empirical question (which kernel?) is precisely R2, the design is parametric, the human-behavioural readout is direct, and the result is decisive. Slight discount because the task is a foraging task -- there is task-conditioning that ARC-068's always-on framing does not have, so the kernel-form transfers but the always-on regime is one step removed.
failure_signatures: If REE implements ARC-068 with a fast TD-style kernel (single-trial / single-episode integrator), Constantino & Daw's data predict the agent will fail to track block-wise opportunity-cost changes the way humans do -- humans behave according to a slow MVT threshold-learning rule, not a fast TD update.

If the EMA window for ARC-068 is set at the wrong timescale (too short -- collapses onto z_goal-local; too long -- becomes essentially constant across the agent's lifetime), the ARC-068 child mechanism will not match Constantino & Daw's per-block adjustment behaviour. The empirical recommendation: a window covering tens of episodes / minutes of agent-time, scaling with the block-length of the environment.

If REE attempts to layer multiple kernels (current + historical, per the user's R2 question) without principled aggregation, the resulting estimator may not match either single-kernel prediction. Constantino & Daw test single-kernel models; the multi-kernel architectural question is not addressed.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Theoretical anchor for the felt phenomenology side of opportunity cost: the experience of effort / disengagement / 'wasting time' is reframed as the output of a cost-benefit computation in which the next-best alternative use of the relevant computational mechanism enters as opportunity cost. This is the closest existing-literature analogue to the user-observed phenomenology that triggered ARC-068 registration ('felt pull of I am wasting time'). Confidence moderated because the paper is explicitly THEORETICAL (BBS target article with peer commentary; Westbrook & Braver commentary published alongside) and the empirical predictions are partial -- the framework licences ARC-068 but does not isolate it from effort-cost (Salamone) or boredom (ARC-067) at mechanism level. Lit-conf weight is reduced rather than higher because R4 (effort vs opportunity cost separation) is precisely the question this paper deliberately collapses.
failure_signatures: If REE implements ARC-068 as a pure opportunity-cost-on-time scalar with no effort-cost-on-action term in parallel, the Kurzban framework predicts the agent will fail to display the asymmetric performance-degradation-with-time-on-task signature that motivates the felt-effort literature. The two terms compose; an opportunity-cost-only architecture is incomplete.

If ARC-068 is implemented at the trajectory-score layer but the upstream subjective-effort signal is missing, the agent will not produce the disengagement-when-better-alternative-becomes-available behaviour Kurzban models -- ARC-068 alone does not generate the disengagement signal, only the bias against passive trajectories.
Kurzban's framework is silent on the temporal kernel (long-window vs short-window vs current-task); R2 cannot lean on this paper without supplementing with Niv 2007 or Constantino & Daw 2015.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational theoretical anchor for the entire ARC-068 framing. Niv et al. derive an average-reward reinforcement-learning model in which the long-run average rate of reward acts as an opportunity cost on time; this IS the architectural shape ARC-068 commits to, expressed in REE language as `score(no_op) -= avg_reward_rate * time_consumed`. The same paper grounds the ARC-066 vigor side and the ARC-068 opportunity-cost side as TWO FACES of the same scalar — load-bearing for R3 collapse arbitration. Confidence higher than the 0.83 weighting in the parallel ARC-066 entry because for ARC-068 the readout (cost-on-rest) IS what the paper formalises (whereas for ARC-066 the readout was a vigor-on-action by-product). Weighted on heavy mapping fidelity for an architectural claim.
failure_signatures: An REE substrate that omits a long-window average-reward-rate scalar will fail to reproduce the Niv prediction that response latencies / no-op-trajectory selection track reward history independent of any specific currently-pursued target. Without ARC-068, REE has no signal that produces this scaling.

If the ARC-068 child mechanism uses a fast (single-episode) reward integrator rather than a slow (across-episode) one, it will collapse onto z_goal-local computations and the agent will not exhibit the well-fed-safe-familiar action gradient the family registers.

If ARC-068 is implemented WITHOUT a corresponding ARC-066 vigor-on-action term (or unified signed scalar), the score-function asymmetry implied by Niv's derivation is broken: the same average-reward scalar should both penalise rest AND inflate action-vigor; an asymmetric implementation will not match the pharmacology data Niv reviews.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Load-bearing anchor for R2 (the LOAD-BEARING verdict of this pull). Schacter / Addis / Buckner consolidate the empirical evidence that imagining future events recruits substantially the same core neural network (medial PFC, medial temporal lobe / hippocampus, retrosplenial / posterior cingulate, inferior parietal lobule) as remembering past events. This is the strongest available empirical anchor for ARC-070's commitment that imagination-side processing shares substrate with observation-side processing -- shared neural network is a NECESSARY (though not sufficient) condition for shared event-segmentation machinery. Combined with Zacks 2007's theoretical framework, this paper supplies the empirical half of the R2 verdict.
failure_signatures: If REE substrate uses an entirely separate imagination-side processing pipeline disjoint from MECH-288 event_segmenter, the design will violate the core constructive-episodic-simulation finding that observation and imagination share a single neural substrate. Such a design would predict that lesions to the observation-side event segmenter would NOT impair imagination-side segmentation; the literature predicts the opposite.

If ARC-070 fires on a fundamentally different signal class than MECH-288 (e.g. one uses prediction error and the other uses bottleneck-state distance), the architecture would predict a dissociation that the constructive-simulation literature has not observed. Both directions of the bidirectional substrate must read from the same predictive engine.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Load-bearing anchor for R1 (PE-as-trigger), R2 (shared substrate for segmentation across streams), and R5 (error-driven boundary signal). Zacks 2007 is the foundational theoretical statement of event segmentation theory: perceptual systems continuously make predictions and a transient prediction-error pulse is the canonical event-boundary signal. The mathematical structure -- a running event model whose error pulses gate a re-segmentation update -- maps directly onto ARC-070's commitment that low-V_s (= prediction error on a chunk's region) triggers re-segmentation of the rollout proposal stream. Strong source quality (foundational Psych Bull review, >2000 citations), strong R1/R5 mapping. R2 mapping is partial: the 2007 paper states the framework but the explicit observation/imagination shared-substrate evidence is more directly carried by Schacter Addis Buckner 2008 (companion entry).
failure_signatures: An REE substrate that uses a constant-grain rollout proposal stream without a prediction-error-conditioned re-segmentation step will fail to reproduce Zacks-style boundary-locked computational events. The event-segmentation framework's core empirical signature is a transient PE-locked re-segmentation pulse, which ARC-070 (with V_s as the trigger) is designed to instantiate.

If the ARC-070 child mechanism uses only mid-execution prediction error (not pre-commitment / simulation-side error) it will fail to reproduce the imagination-side segmentation phenomena that the broader event-segmentation literature has documented across observed and imagined activity streams. A simulation-only segmentation gate is required.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct mechanistic anchor for the imagination-side rollout substrate. Pfeiffer & Foster show rat hippocampus generates brief place-cell sequences before goal-directed navigation that encode future trajectories from current location to remembered goal -- the rodent analog of REE's hippocampal rollout substrate (ARC-007 / SD-002). The trajectories elaborate dynamically as the agent approaches prediction-relevant cues, which is precisely the imagination-side substrate that ARC-070 needs to operate on. Strong source quality (Nature, single-unit electrophysiology with clean methodology). Mapping fidelity moderate-strong: the paper does not directly demonstrate decomposition-on-prediction-failure but it does demonstrate the substrate (forward sweeps) on which ARC-070's decomposition would operate.
failure_signatures: If REE's hippocampal rollout substrate produces only static / single-shot trajectories without the kind of dynamic elaboration Pfeiffer & Foster document, ARC-070 cannot operate on the substrate as designed -- decomposition presupposes a forward-sweep mechanism that produces variable-grain trajectories. The substrate (ARC-007 hippocampal proposals) needs to support the dynamic-elaboration property documented here.

If the forward-sweep mechanism is constant-grain (single-action timesteps with fixed temporal compression), ARC-070's variable-grain decomposition will not have a substrate to operate on. The hippocampal rollout substrate needs to support multi-grain trajectory representation, consistent with Pfeiffer-Foster's evidence of cues elaborating sequence content.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational anchor for R3 (hierarchy depth verdict). Badre & D'Esposito review anatomical, neuroimaging, electrophysiological and developmental findings supporting a multi-level functional hierarchy along the rostro-caudal axis of frontal cortex. Anterior regions encode more abstract action representations; posterior regions encode more concrete motor specifications. The hierarchical decomposition direction (abstract intention -> concrete motor act) is exactly the inverse of REE's chunk-to-primitive composition direction, so ARC-070's decomposition direction is grounded in the same anatomical substrate. R3 verdict (multi-level vs single-level decomposition) is settled in favour of multi-level by this paper's evidence: the brain instantiates AT LEAST 3-4 levels of action abstraction along the rostro-caudal axis, and the corresponding mechanism shape for ARC-070 is multi-level chunk -> sub-chunk -> primitive recursion, not single-level chunk-to-primitive only.
failure_signatures: An ARC-070 child-MECH that supports only single-level decomposition (chunk -> primitive, with no chunk-of-chunks recursion) will fail to match the multi-level hierarchical organisation Badre & D'Esposito document in frontal cortex. The mechanism design must support recursive decomposition with practical recursion bounds.

If the implementation places all decomposition operations at a single anatomical / computational locus (no functional differentiation across abstraction levels), the design will lose the predictive structure of the rostro-caudal gradient and any rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) reading the decomposed sequence will lose the abstraction-level signal that the hierarchy carries.
