recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Cleanest formal analog of policy composition. The options framework gives ARC-071 the formal vocabulary -- options are exactly chunked-primitive equivalents (closed-loop policies with initiation set, termination condition, and internal policy). Source quality high (founding paper, ~6000 citations, Sutton-Precup-Singh). The mapping is formal-not-biological, which is the dominant caveat: ARC-071 needs to instantiate options-like structure in REE substrate, not just reproduce options on top of REE primitives.
failure_signatures: Options have three required fields: policy, initiation set, termination condition -- ARC-071 chunks cannot be just a sequence; they must carry context-keyed initiation and completion conditions. Pure-sequence implementations without these will mis-fire.

Options-discovery is the open problem in hierarchical RL -- the options framework SUPPLIES the formalism but does NOT settle how options are discovered. ARC-071's biological-trigger commitment (repetition + outcome consistency) is the biology-side answer to the discovery problem; the formal framework does not constrain it.

Options compose with primitive actions interchangeably -- ARC-071 chunks must be selectable in the same selection step as their constituent primitives, not in a separate hierarchy-only selection step.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Load-bearing R6 source -- weakens the assumption that biology cleanly distinguishes real-executed from imagined/replayed in the chunking write path. Joint hippocampal-striatal reactivations during sleep, with hippocampal activity LEADING ventral striatal replays, drive sleep-dependent motor sequence consolidation including chunk crystallisation. This means biology DOES allow replay-driven plasticity in the chunking circuit -- sleep-replay is part of the chunking machinery, not gated out of it. ARC-071's strict MECH-094 hypothesis_tag=False gating is therefore biologically MORE CONSERVATIVE than reality, which has substantive safety-vs-realism tradeoff implications for REE. High mapping fidelity (this is the question R6 asks); high source quality (Hippocampus journal, well-replicated finding).
failure_signatures: Sleep replay drives motor consolidation INCLUDING chunk-level changes -- biology does NOT cleanly gate the chunking write path against replay. ARC-071 implementation in REE can either (a) be MORE CONSERVATIVE than biology by enforcing strict hypothesis_tag=False gating (current MECH-094 design), trading off some realism for safety; or (b) permit replay-driven chunking, matching biology but exposing the agent to hallucinated-chunk risk.

Hippocampal-striatal coupling during sleep is reward-prediction-biased -- if ARC-071 permits replay-driven chunking, it should be VALUE-CONDITIONED (only consolidate replays of high-reward sequences). REE's analog would be E3-score-conditioned replay-chunking.

REE has a pre-existing architectural gap registered here -- biology says sleep replay does chunk, MECH-094 says simulation must not chunk. This is a substantive conflict the synthesis should escalate as a NEW REE GAP, not just a parameter choice.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational reference establishing the chunking-of-action-repertoires construct in the striatum. Cited >2000 times. Direct mapping to ARC-071's compose-on-repetition commitment. Substrate identity (striatum) and direction (sequence -> single performance unit) both nailed. Mapping fidelity is the dominant component; the only caveat is that the 1998 paper proposes the construct rather than testing it experimentally, so source_quality is rated on conceptual rigour and subsequent empirical validation rather than primary data in the paper itself.
failure_signatures: ARC-071 must accumulate over (sequence, outcome) pairs, not over (sequence) alone -- Graybiel 1998 is explicit that S-R learning shapes the chunked unit; without outcome-keyed accumulation the slot is mis-specified.
Recoding-of-cortically-derived-information happens within the striatum, not in cortex -- ARC-071 substrate must be a striatum-analog, not a generic policy-cache.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct human-behavioural evidence for spontaneous chunking with quantified chunk-size constraints (typically 2-4 items, sometimes 5). This is the load-bearing R5 source for parameterising the outcome-consistency threshold and the chunk-size budget. The reference-time-gap operationalisation (chunks identified by inter-element-time clustering) is a clean behavioural signature ARC-071 implementations can mirror. Source is the original Sakai paper, though the briefing mistakenly placed it in Curr Op Neurobiol (it is in Exp Brain Res). Mapping fidelity 0.78 -- the chunk-size-budget evidence translates directly; the reference task is finger-sequence learning so the motor-chunk grain is fine-grained.
failure_signatures: Chunks are typically 2-4 items, sometimes 5 -- ARC-071 should default to small-grain chunks; chunks-of-15 are biologically unusual and likely indicate over-aggressive accumulator parameters.

Chunks are identified by inter-element TIME GAPS -- ARC-071's chunk-execution signature should emit a faster within-chunk timing than between-chunk timing; this is a direct behavioural test of whether chunks formed.
Subjects spontaneously chunk during sequence learning without instruction -- ARC-071 implementation should fire automatically, not require explicit goal-driven chunking instruction.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong direct support for the ARC-071/MECH-322 procedural-replay boundary. The paper demonstrates DLS task-sequence replay during sleep, links replay content to later procedural performance improvement, shows DLS offline plasticity is required for consolidation, and shows replay features persist after large bilateral hippocampal lesions. This strengthens the existing MECH-322 carve-out beyond Albouy 2013's human fMRI hippocampal-striatal coupling by adding rodent DLS replay and hippocampal-lesion evidence. Confidence is not higher because the paper does not selectively disrupt DLS replay itself, and the task is motor-procedural rather than REE cognitive/rule chunking.
failure_signatures: Any REE wording that treats hippocampal replay as the universal source or orchestrator of all offline replay should be narrowed. Procedural/chunk replay can be striatal and hippocampus-independent.

MECH-322's sleep-replay carve-out remains necessary: biology permits replay-origin procedural consolidation, but REE still needs replay_origin audit flags and corroboration deadlines because biological replay is not an alignment or safety guarantee.
A MECH-322 validation should measure replay-origin chunk formation and next-block performance/latency improvement, but should not assume hippocampal replay is the sole causal driver.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: JMLR publication (submitted 2017, published 2022); grounded in developmental robotics and infant curiosity research; demonstrates automatic curriculum generation through learning progress maximisation across a parameterised goal space. Highly relevant to REE's infant-stage substrate problem: IMGEP's learning-progress-driven curriculum prevents monostrategy by actively seeking goals where the agent is currently making progress, rather than goals where it has already converged. Maps onto ARC-066 (tonic vigor) and ARC-072 (hippocampal cue-indexed goal repertoire). Main caveat: IMGEP's goal space is explicitly parameterised and continuous; REE's goal space is more implicit.
failure_signatures: Learning-progress-based goal selection can stall if the agent reaches a plateau on all current goals simultaneously -- the system needs a mechanism to invent new goals or expand the goal space when progress is zero everywhere.

IMGEP requires the agent to have already learned to pursue some goals before it can generate a useful learning-progress curriculum. A cold-start agent with no goal representation cannot initialise the system -- suggests IMGEP-like curricula require a bootstrapping phase (infant babbling analog) before they can generate diversity.

Without an explicit goal-space parameterisation, learning progress is not computable. REE's implicit goal representation (residue field wanting) needs to be made explicit enough to track per-goal progress for an IMGEP-like curriculum to operate.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality theoretical review from a leading lab (NYU Infant Action Lab, Adolph) synthesizing decades of empirical work. Mapping fidelity to INV-055/INV-073 is strong: the core claim that behavioral flexibility requires extensive varied motor experience before reinforcement narrows the repertoire directly evidences both invariants. Transfer risk is low -- the developmental substrate (motor-sensory exploration epoch, posture-specific learning, error-as-information) maps cleanly to REE's infant stage design requirements. Confidence capped at 0.78 rather than higher because the paper does not address valence or reward learning directly -- only the affordance/motor side of INV-055.
failure_signatures: Affordance learning is posture-specific: experience as a crawler does not transfer to walking. REE's infant stage would need to support multiple action-posture modalities (or a single abstract motor interface) to avoid re-learning per new capability layer.
Infants do not perceive affordances when first acquiring skills -- the infant stage must therefore precede the point where goal-pursuit learning begins, or goal learning will lock in prematurely.

Environmental variation is necessary for flexibility: an impoverished training substrate (few object types, fixed layouts, no surface diversity) would produce a narrow option library even with long training time.

ARC-073.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=5 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.666

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical single-unit macaque study in a top venue with a clean threshold-crossing result, so source_quality is high. Confidence is held below the source-quality figure because the mapping is analogical: patch-leaving in a depleting reward environment shares the FORM of ARC-073's criterion (leave when the marginal rate of return falls to a threshold rather than after a fixed dwell time) but not its CONTENT (the depleting quantity there is reward rate, not prediction-error reduction / learning progress).
failure_signatures: The threshold was not fixed in absolute terms: longer travel times reduced the gain of stay-responses and RAISED the firing-rate threshold for leaving. A REE implementation that hard-codes a single play_lp_saturation_threshold, insensitive to the cost of the transition itself, would be under-specified relative to this finding.

The quantity that depletes here is exogenous (the patch empties whether or not the animal learns anything). ARC-073's quantity depletes endogenously (PE falls BECAUSE the agent learned). A criterion tuned on an exogenous depletion signal can fire on a merely unrewarding environment rather than on a mastered one.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Good-quality animal study combining behaviour across three tasks with prefrontal slice physiology, published in a strong venue, and it speaks to a half of ARC-073 that has almost no other evidence. Confidence is held to 0.58 because the manipulation is total social isolation across the play period, which is a much blunter intervention than 'premature transition out of play mode' -- the mapping is directional rather than quantitative.
failure_signatures: The deficits appeared specifically 'under novel or challenging circumstances' and impulsive CHOICE was unaffected. Undertraining from truncated play is therefore not a global policy deficit -- a REE falsifier that measures mean task performance in familiar conditions would likely miss it, and would wrongly read a prematurely-transitioned agent as intact.

The isolated rats were re-socialised until adulthood and the impairments persisted. If this transfers, a REE agent given extra play AFTER a premature transition would not recover the lost policy structure, which makes the transition timing non-recoverable rather than merely suboptimal.

Loss of prefrontal pyramidal-neuron sensitivity to dopamine accompanied the behavioural deficit, i.e. the cost of truncated play showed up as degraded MODULATION of the control substrate rather than as absent policy. An REE readout of policy content alone would not detect this signature.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Well-cited ICML paper from the group whose work ARC-073's notes already cite, and the closest computational instantiation of the claim's proposed signal. Marked mixed rather than supports because the agent's LP-driven attention explicitly RETURNS to goal regions whose performance decays -- saturation is demonstrated to be non-terminal, which is the single most consequential qualification of ARC-073's exit criterion. Confidence 0.62: high relevance, simulation-only, and the global-exit half of the claim is untested here rather than supported.
failure_signatures: Absolute learning progress is used, not signed LP, precisely so that a module whose performance is DECAYING is re-selected. A REE exit rule keyed on |d(PE)/dt| < threshold across all regions can therefore fire on a transient plateau and close a play episode that would have resumed producing world-model learning.

CURIOUS implements no transition to a non-exploratory mode at all: LP-based selection reallocates attention WITHIN exploration and never terminates it. The 'across all goal regions -> exit play' half of ARC-073 has no instantiation in the paper it is most naturally read as resting on.

LP is estimated over a sliding window with epsilon-greedy selection; the estimator is noisy, so the threshold test is a statistical decision with a false-positive rate that ARC-073 does not currently specify.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong design -- a leaky-accumulator MVT model fitted against recorded ACC activity AND a pharmacological inactivation to test causality -- in a solid venue. Direction is mixed rather than supports because the two halves of the result bear in opposite directions on ARC-073: the behavioural half replicates the depletion-threshold decision rule in a second species, while the causal half dissociates that rule from the cortical signal that appeared to implement it. Confidence sits at 0.58 because the entry is doing double duty and neither half maps cleanly onto play.
failure_signatures: ACC inactivation profoundly changed foraging decisions and response times, YET rats still followed the MVT decision rule. A REE design that locates the play-exit criterion in one monitored signal and assumes ablating that signal removes the transition would be contradicted by this dissociation.

The authors conclude the ACC encodes foraging-related variables 'for reasons unrelated to patch-leaving decisions'. A correlate that tracks the saturation variable beautifully is therefore not evidence that the correlate is the trigger -- which is exactly the inference an REE diagnostic reading a rolling LP estimate would be tempted to make.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: An older, small-scale developmental-psychobiology study in a mid-tier venue, so source_quality is the limiting factor. It is included because it is the cleanest available counter-case to ARC-073's exclusion clause ('not by scheduled duration'): the transition out of juvenile-typical play here is preprogrammed by perinatal hormone exposure and fails to occur in neonatally castrated males regardless of their play experience. Confidence 0.55 reflects genuine evidential weight against a strong reading of the claim, tempered by design limitations and by the fact that it concerns a change in play STYLE rather than play-to-real mode exit.
failure_signatures: Neonatally castrated males failed to show the age-related shift in playful defense that intact males showed, despite normal juvenile play experience. Competence accumulated through play was therefore not sufficient to trigger the transition -- an organisational hormonal signal was necessary.

The transition in intact animals arrives on a pubertal schedule. If an REE agent's play-to-real transition is driven purely by an LP-saturation test, it has no analogue of the maturational gate that biology appears to use, and the claim's 'not by scheduled duration' exclusion is stronger than the animal data support.
Prior work in this line reports that changes in play frequency and defensive tactics arise largely independently of social experience, which is the direct inverse of a competence-triggered account.

ARC-077.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=5 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.839

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality critical review that is the principal counterweight to Csibra & Gergely's INNATENESS claim -- it argues receptivity to teaching is built from non-specific adaptations for social bonding and social learning, not a dedicated genetic 'natural pedagogy' module. For REE this is informative rather than damaging: it does NOT weaken the architectural NEED for an external population channel; it weakens any assumption that the channel comes for free / is innately given. Logged as mixed and used to bound how MECH-337/ARC-077 may be framed.
failure_signatures: Component-by-component review (eye contact, contingency, infant-directed speech, gaze cuing, rational imitation) finds the evidence does not support each being a reliable, genetically dedicated adaptation FOR teaching -- so a substrate that ASSUMES an innate, pre-wired ostensive-population channel as a free primitive is over-claiming and would inherit an unsupported assumption.

If receptivity to teaching is itself culturally/associatively constructed, the caregiver-population channel is not a fixed given but a developmentally-built capacity; a model that hard-codes MECH-337 as innate machinery rather than as a learned/constructed channel mis-specifies its developmental status (and its GAP-L caregiver-substrate gate).

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The genuine principled counterweight: a heavily-cited synthesis arguing that substantial structured content (objects, agents, number, space, social partners) is supplied by innate, endogenous-maturational core systems, NOT socially sourced. It does not refute ARC-077 but it BOUNDS its scope -- ARC-077 must not claim that all candidate-rule structure is externally populated. Logged as mixed; confidence reflects a real but scope-limiting (not refuting) contribution.
failure_signatures: Four-plus core knowledge systems (object mechanics, agents/goals, number, geometry, social partners) provide structured representations early, with phylogenetic and ontogenetic depth, BEFORE and INDEPENDENT of social scaffolding -- a model that attributes ALL rule/candidate structure to a socially-scaffolded population channel over-claims and would mispredict the endogenous structure infants demonstrably bring.

Core systems are domain-specific and set the priors social input is interpreted against; a population mechanism (MECH-337) that writes into a blank field rather than into a field already shaped by endogenous core structure mis-specifies what scaffolding acts ON.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-cited theoretical synthesis in a top review venue, marshalling a converging infant-cognition literature. It is the single most direct external grounding for MECH-337: it specifies the exact mechanism the slot posits -- ostensive cueing marks a regularity as generalizable/kind-relevant, enabling transmission of cognitively opaque content the agent could not extract observationally. Held below 0.85 because it is a theoretical proposal (not one decisive experiment) and its strong-innateness framing is itself contested (see Heyes 2016 counter-entry); the REE-side instantiation as a CandidateRule write is an architectural extrapolation the paper does not make.
failure_signatures: Cognitively opaque cultural content (where the function/rationale is not recoverable from observation alone) is shown to require ostensive communicative transmission rather than observational learning -- a substrate that populates its candidate-rule space only from the agent's own observation/behaviour (ARC-064 bottom-up alone) would fail to acquire exactly this class.

Ostensively marked information is interpreted by infants as generic and kind-relevant rather than episodic; a population mechanism that wrote scaffolded regularities as one-off episodic facts rather than as context-tagged generalizable candidates would mispredict this.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational, field-defining observational study (it introduced the term 'scaffolding') and the canonical operationalization of Vygotsky's zone of proximal development. Direct support for ARC-077's architectural commitment that an external agent controls task structure beyond the learner's unassisted reach, and for MECH-337's six-function population mechanism. Below 0.8 because it is a small-sample observational tutoring study, the scaffolding<->ZPD link was tightened by later authors rather than this paper, and the REE mapping (tutoring functions -> CandidateRule writes) is an architectural extrapolation.
failure_signatures: A scaffold lets a novice solve a task beyond unassisted effort by the tutor controlling the elements initially beyond the learner's capability -- a substrate whose candidate rules are bounded by what the agent can already do unaided (no external task-structuring) cannot acquire regularities in this above-unaided band.

Effective tutoring is contingent: support is titrated to the learner's current state and withdrawn as competence grows. A non-contingent, fixed external signal would not reproduce the tutoring gain, so a scaffolding channel modelled as a static injection rather than a contingent, fading one is mis-specified.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Highly influential BBS target article synthesising comparative and developmental evidence. It grounds the PRECONDITION for ARC-077/MECH-337 -- shared intentionality, joint attention and social referencing are the motivational/representational substrate that lets an agent be scaffolded at all. Confidence is moderate (not high) precisely because it maps to the enabling condition rather than to the population mechanism itself: it explains why a caregiver channel can transmit conventions, not the write operation that MECH-337 specifies.
failure_signatures: Skills of shared intentionality (joint attention, social referencing, role-reversal) emerge gradually over the first ~14 months and are species-unique; an agent lacking the motivation/representation to share psychological states does not acquire conventions or norms from others even with exposure -- a caregiver-population channel bolted onto a substrate with no shared-intentionality precondition would not function.

Convention and norm acquisition is shown to depend on the species-unique social-motivation pathway, not on general intention-reading alone; a model that assumes scaffolded rule uptake from observation/imitation without a sharing motivation mis-locates the mechanism.

ARC-078.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=11 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.847

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical theory of the disengagement trigger: it is obstruction/non-attainment of a COMMITTED incentive, not an evidence tally -- supports the never-from-accumulated-hopelessness constraint. But the trigger expresses as a slow, stereotyped depression-like PHASE that does the disengaging, not a one-shot appraisal -- so it qualifies the 'one-shot flag' design. Foundational and central; the one-shot mapping is the uncertain part.
failure_signatures: Too late / stuck in the invigoration phase: persistent value-inflation and effort escalation toward an unreachable incentive (perseverative striving; the current concern never offsets).
Too early: premature collapse of commitment before genuine obstruction -> under-persistence and abandonment of still-attainable goals.
Cycle arrest in the depression phase: concern released from the old goal but no reengagement -> clinical depression.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Frames OCD compulsion as a CONSEQUENCE of a goal-directed (model-based) control deficit -- the override that would license stopping a no-longer-warranted action is impaired -- not a primary habit strengthening. Supports failure-to-disengage as a distinct mechanistic pathology located in the model-evaluation/override pathway. Mechanism is action-selection-level, not goal-bank-level, hence held at 0.72.
failure_signatures: The agent keeps executing a stereotyped sequence (checking/washing) triggered by a cue even though its own outcome knowledge marks the action as unnecessary -- slips of action against devalued outcomes.
Behaviour is rigid and stimulus-bound: it cannot be flexibly halted by a change in goal value because the goal-directed controller that would halt it is impaired.
Subjective recognition that the action is senseless coexists with inability to desist -- a dissociation between explicit goal knowledge and behavioural control.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Establishes that the adaptive-disengagement trigger is an unattainability APPRAISAL (not discouragement, not an evidence counter) and that disengagement is only adaptive when paired with reengagement. Directly supports the ARC-078 abandon-trigger design. Correlational individual-difference construct (Goal Adjustment Scale), so the trigger's computation is assumed-upstream, not modelled -- which is exactly the function REE must implement.
failure_signatures: Too late: difficulty disengaging from unattainable goals -> sustained distress, intrusive goal-related thought, lower well-being.
Too early / unconditional: disengaging from still-attainable goals -> loss of beneficial persistence.
Disengage-without-reengage: distress relieved but well-being not restored -- abandonment uncoupled from redirection leaves a purpose vacuum.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Well-cited review reframing mental fatigue as an adaptive cost/benefit recalibration -- fatigue signals that the energetical cost of continued effort now outweighs expected reward, motivating disengagement toward more rewarding alternatives, rather than reflecting depleted resources or aversive mood. Grounds fatigue's antecedent (accumulated effort + opportunity cost) and its disengagement consumer (ARC-078) as DISTINCT from suffering's aversive-uncontrollable antecedent. Source quality good (review, not primary data); mapping is conceptual.
failure_signatures: Treating fatigue as pure resource depletion ('out of fuel') rather than a cost/benefit signal predicts fatigue should be insensitive to incentive -- contradicted; fatigue-driven disengagement is reversible by raising reward, which is the signature of a value-recalibration, not an empty tank.

If fatigue were a negative-valence aversive signal (suffering-like), it would not preferentially redirect behaviour toward MORE rewarding alternatives; the data frame it as an opportunity-cost reallocation.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Neurocognitive framework casting fatigue as a MOTIVATIONAL signal (effort/opportunity-cost recalibration in dACC/anterior insula/lateral PFC) rather than energy depletion, and distinguishing transient STATE fatigue (waxes/wanes with cognitive or motor exertion) from persistent TRAIT fatigue/chronic exhaustion -- the state/trait split that separates a recoverable homeostatic stop from clinical aversive-mood conditions. Directly supports fatigue's distinctness from suffering/depression and its SD-012 placement. Review-level evidence; mapping conceptual.
failure_signatures: Modelling fatigue as energy depletion mispredicts its recovery profile and its incentive-sensitivity; the framework requires fatigue to act as a value/cost signal feeding effort-based decision systems.

Collapsing transient state-fatigue into trait/clinical exhaustion (or into anhedonia/depression) erases the recoverable-stop-recover dynamic that distinguishes the homeostatic signal from suffering-driven withdrawal.

ARC-080.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=8 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.833

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational and many-times-replicated demonstration that a hidden object is REPRESENTED as continuing to exist long before Piaget's manual-search criterion. Directly grounds the existence of a persistence buffer (MECH-045): permanence is a representational competence dissociable from action. Confidence held at 0.7 rather than higher because (a) the drawbridge paradigm specifically carries a documented low-level novelty/familiarity confound (Rivera/Wakeley/Langer 1999; Cashon & Cohen 2000), and (b) the mapping from looking-time surprise to a substrate-level buffer is conceptual, not mechanistic.
failure_signatures: The drawbridge version of VOE has a known low-level confound: infants may simply prefer the larger/more-novel 180-degree rotation independent of any box representation (Rivera, Wakeley & Langer 1999). The permanence inference rests on the full VOE literature, not this paradigm alone.

Looking-time 'surprise' demonstrates that SOMETHING about the hidden object is represented; it does not specify whether the representation is a token-instance object-file, a spatial expectation, or a physical-event prediction. It cannot by itself adjudicate the token-vs-type question MECH-045 must answer.

A representation sufficient to drive differential looking is not necessarily sufficient to drive search/retrieval -- the competence (representation) / performance (action) gap (see Diamond 1985 entry) means MECH-045's buffer must be specified at the level it is consumed.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct, clean evidence that infants represent a partly-hidden object as a single connected entity -- a token-level unity inference that bridges occlusion. This is the perceptual-completion sibling of full-occlusion permanence and grounds MECH-045's persistence buffer at the unit level. Confidence 0.7 because the binding CUE the paper isolates (common motion of the visible parts) is precisely the cue REE's anchor-keyed ghost bank does NOT use -- so the paper supports the capability while exposing a mechanism mismatch in REE's current implementation.
failure_signatures: Unity was perceived from COMMON MOTION of the visible surfaces; with static, homogeneous, aligned, simple-shaped edges infants did NOT perceive a connected object. REE's persistence stores key on a spatial anchor (ghost bank) or a static type tag (SD-049), neither of which is the motion-based amodal-completion cue the infant uses.

The study tests completion of a CURRENTLY partly-visible object, not full occlusion across time -- it is the spatial-gap analog of permanence, one inferential step short of the temporal-gap (fully-hidden) case Baillargeon tests.

Common-motion binding is a perceptual-input grouping operation; it does not by itself establish a stored token that survives the object becoming fully invisible. MECH-045 must add the temporal-persistence step that this paradigm stops short of.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong, widely-reproduced existence proof that a token-instance object-centric representation (a set of exchangeable 'slots' that competitively bind to objects) is learnable end-to-end and is the natural ML realization of the object-file / generalised z_object that ARC-080 proposes. Held below 0.8 by transfer risk: slot attention is unsupervised object discovery on image/CNN features, not drive/goal-coupled binding over REE's engineered latent streams, and a single-frame slot set does not by itself give cross-time permanence.
failure_signatures: Slot attention without a temporal/recurrent extension (e.g. SAVi) gives object-centric grouping WITHIN a frame but no token-instance persistence ACROSS occlusion -- so it grounds the binding/identity half of ARC-080 but not Pillar 1 (permanence) on its own.

Slots bind by competition over reconstruction of perceptual input; REE's z_object is detached from reconstruction and coupled to drive/goal value -- the binding pressure that makes slots specialise may be absent if REE supplies no comparable reconstruction or contrastive objective.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong, reproduced ML existence proof that slots can be TRACKED across time -- each slot persists as the same object-token frame to frame, predicted forward by a transition model. This is the persistence half that vanilla slot-attention (Locatello 2020) lacks, and it maps onto REE's shape exactly: slots + a forward predictor = SAVi, and REE's E2 IS that predictor. Held at 0.71 by transfer risk: weakly-supervised (optical-flow target + first-frame conditioning cues), synthetic video, pixel-reconstruction-driven -- REE's z_object is value-coupled and reconstruction-free over engineered latents.
failure_signatures: SAVi tracking is bootstrapped by weak supervision (optical flow as the prediction target; first-frame object-location/coordinate conditioning cues). Remove that scaffold and unsupervised temporal binding degrades -- REE would need a comparable conditioning signal (e.g. drive/goal salience seeding a slot) or the slots may not specialise/persist.
Slot persistence is maintained while the object is visible-and-tracked; full through-occlusion permanence (ARC-080 Pillar 1) is only partially addressed and remains the harder problem.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-cited Neuron synthesis of the theta-gamma multiplexing code with broad hippocampal + cortical empirical support. Directly grounds MECH-089 (theta-gamma nesting packages E1 for E3) at near-mechanism fidelity and supplies the formal capacity argument (~7+/-2 = gamma-cycles-per-theta) that grounds the 'both mechanisms multiply representational capacity' claim in the object-binding design fork. Held below 0.8 because the capacity-extension mapping to ARC-080 is at the class level and because phase-coded multiplexing presupposes a slot/item layer REE does not yet have.
failure_signatures: Theta-gamma multiplexing presupposes discrete items to assign to gamma subcycles; with no slot/token layer (REE's current state) there are no items to multiplex and the phase code has nothing to carry -- the capacity advantage is unrealizable until slots exist.
Capacity is bounded (~7+/-2 gamma cycles per theta cycle); the scheme extends, but does not remove, a hard simultaneous-item limit.

ARC-081.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.695

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A well-cited neurocognitive model that decomposes body-ownership into exactly the components REE posits for the self-model: a pre-existing stored body model, online multisensory integration modulated by that model, and a referral step that yields the ownership experience -- with a named cortical division of labour (right TPJ incorporeability test, S2 online body representation, posterior parietal/ventral premotor recalibration, right posterior insula subjective ownership). The model-against-internal-model-of-the-body structure is a faithful biological analogue of SD-030's self-comparator and ARC-081's stored self-slot. Held below 0.7 because it is a review/model synthesis (not a single decisive experiment), and the INV-064 ordering mapping is weak.
failure_signatures: Body-ownership requires a pre-existing stored model of the body to gate which external objects are even incorporeable; without a prior self-model there is no referral step -- this is the structural prerequisite SELF-1 (stateful z_self) must satisfy before SD-030/MECH-215 can attach, and it fails if z_self is only an instantaneous EMA snapshot.

Ownership is computed as multisensory input weighted against the internal body model; when the two conflict beyond tolerance, incorporation fails -- a comparator-with-tolerance, matching SD-030's residual gate and failing exactly where the residual exceeds threshold.

The right posterior insula carries the subjective-ownership signal; if the interoceptive partner is absent the multisensory match can occur without the felt-mine experience -- predicting a dissociation that a purely exteroceptive self-model (no MECH-214 interoceptive channel) would suffer.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, massively replicated psychophysical demonstration that the felt boundary of the bodily self is a recalibratable inference over multisensory inputs, not a fixed given. This is strong direct support for the ARC-081 stance that z_self is a constructed, malleable object-representation rather than a privileged primitive. Confidence is held below 0.7 because the mapping from a perceptual ownership illusion to REE's latent z_self plasticity is an analogy at the representational level, not a measurement of REE's actual comparator.
failure_signatures: If z_self were an unrevisable body-state primitive rather than an inferred object, synchronous visuo-tactile stimulation of an external object could not capture ownership -- the rubber-hand effect shows the self-boundary is re-inferred from current evidence, exactly what ARC-081 requires and what a fixed-latent z_self would forbid.

The illusion requires temporally congruent multisensory input; asynchronous stroking abolishes it -- i.e. ownership is gated by a prediction/observation match, which is precisely the SD-030 comparator signature and fails when the match is broken.

ARC-085.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.758

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical statement and review of the constructive episodic simulation hypothesis, with converging cognitive, neuropsychological and neuroimaging evidence that remembering the past and imagining the future draw on overlapping psychological and neural processes. This is the single strongest biology anchor for ARC-085's core claim (one event-token store; simulation = forward re-composition of the same tokens replay reinstates backward). Confidence held below 0.85 because the support is for a SHARED-PROCESS / SHARED-NETWORK architecture inferred from overlap, not for a literal single addressable store, and because the review is integrative rather than a single decisive experiment.
failure_signatures: Overlap of neural substrates for past and future is consistent with a shared store but does not establish ONE store; a two-store model with shared upstream construction processes predicts the same imaging overlap, so the imaging evidence does not by itself discriminate ARC-085's single-store claim from its two-store falsifier.

The constructive system is described as error-prone (memory distortions, false recognition) -- the very flexibility that lets it simulate futures is the source of confabulation, which is the failure mode MECH-365's one-way provenance gate must contain rather than something this substrate prevents on its own.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The source-monitoring framework is the foundational and still-dominant account of how the cognitive system attributes a remembered event to its origin (perceived vs imagined, internal vs external, this-source vs that-source). It directly grounds MECH-365's central design move -- that provenance is a represented attribute of an event rather than a free-floating mode bit -- and the reality-monitoring sub-case is the biological form of the committed_vs_imagined field. Held below 0.8 because the framework treats provenance as a RECONSTRUCTIVE, probabilistic attribution made at retrieval (and routinely WRONG), which is in tension with MECH-365's stronger one-way, never-violated gate; the framework supports the existence and dimensionality of the field but partly weakens the absoluteness of the gate.
failure_signatures: Source monitoring is a heuristic, reconstructive judgement made at retrieval from imperfect cues (vividness, sensory detail, cognitive-operation traces), not a stored ground-truth label -- so the human system routinely MISattributes imagined events as perceived (the source-misattribution errors that ARE confabulation/false memory). This weakens MECH-365's premise that committed_vs_imagined can be a reliably-enforced, one-way, first-class field rather than a fallible after-the-fact inference.

Because 'source' is multidimensional with indefinitely many values, a single binary committed_vs_imagined bit may be an under-specification: provenance failures occur along many axes (who said it, when, internally-generated-by-me vs by-another), not just real-vs-imagined.

ARC-086.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=4 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.825

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality multicentre, double-blind, placebo-controlled RCT (n=89) with a pre-registered fMRI primary endpoint: a selective KOR antagonist (JNJ-67953964) significantly increased ventral-striatum activation during reward anticipation in patients with anhedonia and a mood/anxiety disorder. This is the human proof-of-mechanism the layer's kappa-axis proposal and PHARM-018 falsification condition turn on. Confidence below 0.8 because the primary endpoint is a circuit biomarker (reward-anticipation activation), not a clinical anhedonia or commitment endpoint, and it does not isolate a 'commitment-entropy' construct from general reward-circuit engagement.
failure_signatures: The trial demonstrates target engagement on a reward-anticipation circuit biomarker, not clinical anhedonia remission or any commitment/perseveration measure; a positive biomarker does not establish that the kappa axis is dissociable from the serotonin axis on clinical endpoints (the PHARM-018 falsification still stands open).

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Theory-driven secondary analysis of a KOR-antagonist RCT plus three other datasets, fitting a resource-bounded reinforcement-learning model that decomposes behaviour into memory and efficiency components, and a perseveration term. The striking result for REE: KOR antagonism increases reward sensitivity AND perseveration, and anhedonia is linked to deviation from OPTIMAL perseveration. This is the most architecturally-specific anchor for the layer's commitment-entropy framing -- 'perseveration' is the closest empirical analogue to MECH-048's commitment-stability construct. Confidence mid-range: secondary analysis, modest KOR n (24/31), and 'perseveration' is an operational proxy for, not identical to, REE 'commitment entropy'.
failure_signatures: The modelling finds KOR antagonism has DISTINCT cognitive effects, only one of which is related to anhedonia -- so the kappa->commitment-stability link is real but partial, and the layer's clean 'kappa = the commitment-entropy axis' framing risks over-attributing a multi-component drug effect to a single axis.

Optimal perseveration is bounded by memory capacity; 'more perseveration' is only therapeutic up to the resource-rational optimum, so a naive 'kappa antagonism stabilises commitment' reading omits the optimality constraint.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Rigorous, multi-pronged primary study (KOR antagonism, dynorphin gene deletion, CRF/urocortin challenge, CRF-receptor-subtype antagonists, phospho-KOR immunolabelling) establishing that the dysphoric/aversive component of stress is specifically encoded by CRF2-driven dynorphin release acting on KOR, with KOR activation localised to amygdala, nucleus accumbens, dorsal raphe and hippocampus. Foundational grounding for treating kappa/dynorphin as the aversive-state substrate the layer builds the commitment-entropy axis on. Confidence held below 0.8 because the bridge from 'encodes dysphoria/aversion' to REE's 'commitment-entropy destabiliser' is an interpretive construct, and the data are rodent place-aversion / immobility, not commitment dynamics.
failure_signatures: The system encodes the aversive/dysphoric VALENCE of stress (place aversion, immobility); it is not shown to raise policy-competition entropy or destabilise commitments -- the 'commitment-entropy' reading is REE's overlay on an aversive-valence finding.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Well-cited review consolidating the dynorphin/KOR-as-aversive-state-controller account: KOR activation produces dysphoria, potentiates drug-seeking and stress-induced reinstatement, and operates downstream of CRF. Grounds the layer's premise that there is a dedicated neuropeptide system whose job is to install/modulate negative affective state -- the substrate for a distinct vulnerability axis. Confidence mid-range because it is a review (synthesis, not primary), and as with Land 2008 the 'commitment-entropy' reading is REE's, not the literature's.
failure_signatures: The review frames dynorphin/KOR around dysphoria and addiction/relapse, not commitment or option-selection; it gives no independent support for the 'raises policy entropy' half of the layer's claim beyond the affective-state framing.

ARC-087.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.824

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the closest published anchor to the source trigger for the whole cluster (the Schrodinger colour-theory completion result). It shows empirically that perceptual colour space exhibits 'diminishing returns' -- large colour differences are perceived as LESS than the sum of small steps -- which is mathematically impossible in a Riemannian (locally additive) geometry. That is direct, high-quality evidence for ARC-087's specific assertion that the perceptual manifold is 'curved, compressed, asymmetric, non-additive, unlike the raw measurement space', and for MECH-372's placement of sight at the deep-adaptor end (colour geometry must be CONSTRUCTED, not read off). Confidence just below source_quality because it reanalyses/reframes existing colour-difference datasets rather than running a new psychophysical cohort, and the additivity-violation claim has prompted active debate.
failure_signatures: The paper overturns the long-assumed Riemannian (Helmholtz/Schrodinger) model of colour space but does NOT supply a replacement metric -- so it establishes that the colour adaptor's output geometry is non-additive without telling the adaptor designer what geometry to target.

It is a geometric reanalysis of aggregate colour-difference data; an adaptor-internal mechanism (how receptor signals are transformed into this non-Riemannian metric) is out of scope, so it grounds the OUTPUT shape, not the transform.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily replicated foundational result (Science, 1987; re-confirmed for naturalistic stimuli as recently as 2023) that a stimulus set induces a metric PSYCHOLOGICAL space in which generalization decays as an invariant (near-exponential) function of distance. This is direct, high-source-quality evidence for ARC-087's core premise -- perception contributes a structured GEOMETRY of difference, not raw signal -- and for Q-065's learned-metric arm (the metric is recoverable from similarity/generalization statistics). Confidence held below source_quality because the mapping is one level of abstraction removed: Shepard's space is a general psychological-similarity space, not specifically a per-sense perceptual adaptor manifold.
failure_signatures: The law is a metric-recovery and generalization result, not a constructive account of HOW a sensory adaptor builds the metric -- it constrains the target geometry but does not specify the transform (so it under-determines ARC-087's adaptor stage).

Shepard's two admissible metrics (Euclidean for integral dimensions, city-block for separable) assume a locally additive metric structure; later colour-geometry work (Bujack 2022) shows perceptual spaces can violate additivity at large differences, bounding the universality claim.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical mechanistic account of the ventral visual stream as a deep, largely feedforward cascade that progressively 'untangles' object identity manifolds -- transforming a representation in which identity is not linearly separable (retinal/V1) into one in which it is (IT). This is the biological instantiation of ARC-087's deep visual adaptor: the adaptor IS a sequence of metric-reshaping transforms that build invariance (to position, scale, pose, lighting) BEFORE downstream read-out, not a flat feature extractor. It also concretely anchors MECH-372's deep end (sight needs a multi-stage adaptor). High source quality + high mapping fidelity; confidence below ceiling only because it is primate/human object-recognition specific and is a review/synthesis rather than a single decisive experiment.
failure_signatures: The untangling account is strongest for ventral-stream OBJECT IDENTITY; it does not establish that every visual sub-property ARC-087 lists (colour geometry, gaze salience, affordance) is built by the same cascade, so 'the adaptor' is plausibly several parallel manifold-constructors, not one.

Emphasis on a largely feedforward cascade understates recurrent/feedback contributions later work foregrounds; if the V4 visual adaptor is built as strictly feedforward on this paper's authority it may under-fit hard cases (heavy occlusion, clutter) the review itself flags as unsolved.

Included for the concept, not the method.

A system whose components are coupled hard enough will lock; one coupled too weakly will be independent. Neither is integration.

Combined with their own warning that redundancy makes emergence HARDER to detect, and REE's streams being heavily redundant by construction, a negative result in REE would be uninterpretable. So the paper enables a positive test of ARC-112 and forbids a negative one -- hence mixed rather than supports.

The criteria double-count redundancy up to n times, so systems with high redundancy yield false negatives. REE's streams share environmental input and are causally wired to each other (E2 consumes E1, the beta gate reads across), which is exactly the high-redundancy regime where the estimator is least sensitive.

Emergence is defined only relative to a chosen microscopic partition, and the authors state no principled method for choosing it. In REE the partition is a design decision (per-stream? per-latent-block? per-module?) that can manufacture or destroy the result, and nothing in the theory constrains it.

The framework assumes fully observable systems with Markovian dynamics, which the authors say 'often do not hold when dealing with experimental data'. REE's per-step telemetry is a partial view of a non-Markovian system with hidden recurrent state.

And the authors' own control found causal emergence 'did not capture a quantitatively different direction' from standard representation metrics -- it summarised information already scattered across weaker signals. Add a sign flip on CrafterReward (global alignment -0.95 against +0.35 to +1.00 elsewhere) and the quantity looks task-dependent rather than invariant.

REE's question is about emergence across NAMED heterogeneous streams with different dimensionalities and update rates; an algorithmic bipartition of a single latent layer is a different measurement and the paper offers no evidence the two behave alike.

Causal emergence scores were significantly above random projections but NOT significantly different from standard representation metrics (entropy, mutual information, autocorrelation, effective dimension, latent magnitude). The authors conclude it 'did not capture a quantitatively different direction'. A REE result showing high causal emergence may therefore be re-describable by a much cheaper statistic, which is a discriminant-validity failure, not merely a redundancy.

Global reward alignment was strongly POSITIVE in five environments and strongly NEGATIVE in CrafterReward (-0.95), which the authors attribute post hoc to exploration. A quantity whose sign depends on the task cannot be read as a substrate-independent organisational invariant, which is what search 10 was looking for.

Local (step-by-step) alignment was approximately zero in every environment. The quantity tracks slow representational drift over training, not moment-to-moment coordination -- so it does not speak to Q-081's per-step cross-stream organisation question at all.

Gaussian information theory was assumed after a copula rank-normal transform, and 28.53% of units still rejected normality. The estimator is a linear-Gaussian approximation applied to non-Gaussian neural activations.

The STRUCTURAL criterion is real and computable on a dependency graph: a set of constraints realises overall closure iff every constraint is both dependent and generative, and realises STRICT closure iff it additionally cannot be split into two closed sets. That third condition is ARC-112's assertion almost word for word -- one system rather than two independent ones -- and it can be evaluated on REE's constraint graph today without any experiment. The QUANTITATIVE part does not transfer at all: the tendency-to-closure measure dK(V,l) is defined over an increasing volume of physical SPACE, which REE does not have, and the authors themselves call the treatment 'still preliminary' and footnote that their notion of organised complexity is adopted for the discussion rather than in general. Scored 0.50 as the average of a genuinely useful structural criterion and a non-transferable measure, not as uniform mediocrity.
failure_signatures: The closure conditions are evaluated on a graph of constraints that someone must first construct. For REE that graph is an act of interpretation, not a measurement -- which mechanisms count as constraints, and which dependencies are direct, are analyst choices that determine the verdict before any computation runs.

Strict closure is a Boolean property of a chosen constraint set. It cannot distinguish a federation whose integration is functionally meaningful from one whose only cross-dependency is a single trivial wire, because both are unsplittable. The criterion therefore cannot speak to INV-091's band at all -- it has no notion of degree in the dimension that matters.

The quantitative tendency-to-closure measure dK(V,l) is defined by growing a volume of physical space and counting dependencies inside it. REE has no spatial embedding, so there is no non-arbitrary analogue of the volume-growth procedure and no analogue of the boundary-collapse signature the measure detects.

Garson's liberality objection applies to the framework generally: closure of constraints is satisfiable by simple systems that are intuitively not unified organisms. A REE constraint graph passing strict closure therefore does not by itself establish that REE is a federation in any interesting sense.
