recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The most direct available evidence for the DIRECTION of MECH-323/MECH-324's hysteresis, from the same lab and preparation as the ARC-071 substrate anchors already in the corpus. Long-term multi-unit recording in sensorimotor striatum across acquisition, extinction and reacquisition: task-related ensemble patterns 'successively formed, reversed and then re-emerged', and the paper opens by noting that learning not to perform an ingrained habit is notoriously difficult while regaining one can occur with a few exposures. That is an explicit acquisition-versus-dissolution asymmetry with a neural correlate, which is exactly the relation F_low < F_high is meant to encode. Source quality 0.92 (Nature, chronic ensemble recording, behaviour-correlated); mapping fidelity 0.55 (it is a timescale and reversibility asymmetry, not a variance-threshold measurement); transfer risk 0.40.
failure_signatures: The asymmetry Barnes et al. demonstrate is one of TIMESCALE and RETRIEVABILITY -- the pattern reverses under extinction but re-emerges almost immediately on reacquisition -- not one of a higher evidence THRESHOLD for dissolution. MECH-324's T_dissolve (slower dissolution timescale) is directly supported; F_high > F_low as a variance-gate asymmetry is supported only by analogy.

Because the trace survives dissolution, an REE implementation that DELETES a chunk on crossing F_high diverges from the biology: the biological chunk is suppressed and rapidly re-instatable, not erased. A dissolved chunk should be retained in a dormant state with a lowered re-formation threshold, which the current MECH-323/324 pair does not specify.

Task-irrelevant firing was suppressed, rebounded, then suppressed again across the three phases. If REE's accumulator has no analog of that rebound, dissolution will look cleaner in REE than in biology and the re-formation dynamics will be wrong even if the thresholds are right.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The behavioural half of the dissolution-asymmetry case, and specifically the INSTRUMENTAL (action) half rather than the Pavlovian one -- which matters because MECH-323 chunks actions, not cues. Bouton et al. review three converging relapse effects after instrumental extinction (renewal in a changed context, resurgence when an alternative response is itself extinguished, and rapid reacquisition on re-reinforcement), all showing extinction 'weakens behavior without erasing the original learning'. Extinction is new, context-dependent learning stored alongside the old. This is the mechanistic account of why dissolution is asymmetric with formation. Source quality 0.78 (review of the authors' own programme, rat operant, well-replicated effects); mapping fidelity 0.65; transfer risk 0.35.
failure_signatures: Extinction does not erase; it installs a competing, context-gated memory. An REE dissolution operator that removes the chunk from the library implements erasure, which the instrumental-extinction literature says is the wrong operation -- and predicts REE will not show renewal, resurgence, or rapid reacquisition, all of which are robust in the biology.

Extinction learning is 'relatively dependent on the context for expression'. MECH-323's chunks carry an initiation_set of contexts. If dissolution is context-blind while formation is context-conditioned, an REE chunk dissolved in one context stays dissolved in all -- diverging from renewal, where the behaviour returns simply by changing context.

Resurgence means a chunk can return not because its own evidence improved but because a COMPETING chunk was extinguished. Nothing in MECH-323/324 as registered produces that coupling, so a chunk library that competes for selection would need dissolution state shared across candidates to reproduce it.

Independent causal confirmation, by a different method (muscimol inactivation) in a different task (instrumental lever-press with specific-satiety devaluation) from a different laboratory, that infralimbic cortex is required for habitual rather than goal-directed control, and that removing it restores the goal-directed alternative INTACT. failure_signatures: The authors conclude that 'the development of habitual responding reflects the active inhibition of goal-directed responses that are mediated by action-outcome associations'. MECH-324's maintenance operator gates whether a CHUNK is selectable; it does not implement an inhibitory projection onto the decomposed goal-directed alternative. These are functionally similar and mechanistically different, and the difference predicts divergence wherever the two alternatives must compete rather than merely be enabled or disabled.

Goal-directed control returned in full after extended overtraining, meaning the action-outcome representation was never degraded by habitisation. Any REE implementation in which chunk crystallisation weakens, overwrites, or reduces the accessibility of the constituent primitives would diverge from this result. MECH-321 decomposition interacts here: the claim's own notes flag the open question of whether decomposition should trigger DISSOLVING, and this paper argues the primitives stay fully available regardless of chunk state.

Control-infused overtrained animals were insensitive to devaluation while muscimol animals were sensitive. A validation experiment that measures only chunk selection frequency, without an outcome-sensitivity probe, cannot distinguish 'the chunk was dissolved' from 'the chunk was never selected on these trials'. Devaluation-sensitivity is the discriminating measure and REE has no analog of it registered.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the causal-necessity paper MECH-324's implementation_note cites in spirit but which was not on file, and it is the direct biological warrant for the 2026-07-27 structural correction from erasure/tombstone to suppression-with-retention. Two findings map almost one-to-one: (1) disrupting infralimbic cortex BLOCKS an established habit online, within an average of three trials and as early as the first trial, so maintenance is a continuously-required gate rather than a one-shot crystallisation event; (2) after weeks of new-habit training, re-imposing the same perturbation caused rats to REGAIN the previously suppressed original habit while the newer one was blocked -- the suppressed chunk was retained, dormant and recoverable, which is exactly what MECH-324's corrected DISSOLVED state now asserts and what the as-first-built absorbing tombstone forbade. Held at 0.82 rather than higher because the mapping runs from an IL population-activity disruption to a software maintenance switch, and because rodent T-maze habit is a much narrower behavioural object than a policy chunk.
failure_signatures: The original habit was regained on re-perturbation, meaning it survived weeks of a competing habit being trained over it. Any implementation in which DISSOLVED is terminal, or in which a dissolved sequence is blocked from re-forming, is inconsistent with this result -- which is precisely the defect corrected in ree-v3 6c3e67e, where a retained tombstone permanently blocked its own sequence from re-forming at any number of repetitions.

Blockade occurred within about 9 seconds of inhibition and as soon as the first trial (<3 s). Maintenance is therefore fast-acting and continuously required. An REE maintenance operator whose dissolution is slow-by-construction (the DISSOLVING hysteresis window) will not reproduce this latency; if a validation experiment measures time-to-suppression it should expect a discrepancy attributable to REE design choice, not to a substrate bug.

Perturbation toggled BOTH ways -- suppressing the new habit while restoring the old one in the same intervention. This implies a competitive selection among retained chunks rather than independent per-chunk gates. MECH-324 implements per-chunk lifecycle states with no cross-chunk competition, so this is an unmodelled degree of freedom and a candidate explanation if a validation experiment finds dissolution behaving independently across chunks when biology predicts trade-off.

Generalised performance ability and motivation to consume reward were unaffected. A REE dissolution mechanism that degrades general policy performance alongside chunk suppression would be diverging from the biology, and a validation experiment should carry that as an explicit control rather than reading a global performance drop as successful dissolution.

MECH-329.confidence_rationale: exp=1 entry(s), lit=5 entry(s), exp_conf=0.231, lit_conf=0.777

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Smith, Berridge & Aldridge provide the neural-recording confirmation that hedonic 'liking', incentive-salience 'wanting', and learned-prediction signals are separately tracked and independently modulable in ventral pallidum / nucleus-accumbens circuitry: an intra-accumbens opioid microinjection simultaneously raised liking reactions, raised firing to a reward-PROXIMAL incentive cue, but did NOT alter firing to a reward-DISTAL learned-prediction cue. This is the dissociation MECH-329 requires as a PREMISE -- that wanting (incentive salience) is a distinct, separately-controllable signal that can in principle operate ahead of, or independently of, calibrated liking. It tests MECH-329 (the wanting-before-liking child mechanism) and is tagged ONLY to MECH-329, not MECH-189 directly, because it speaks to the wanting/liking architecture, not to goal-anchor writes. Confidence 0.55: strong electrophysiology, but it is adult rat and -- critically -- it demonstrates SEPARABILITY, not DEVELOPMENTAL ORDERING, which is what MECH-329 actually asserts.
failure_signatures: The paper shows wanting and liking are SEPARABLE in the adult brain; it does NOT show wanting comes ONLINE first developmentally. MECH-329's specific claim -- that the wanting system seeds the first goal anchors before liking is calibrated -- is a developmental-ordering claim this adult electrophysiology cannot establish. The ordering premise is grounded only at the separability level here; the temporal-developmental half remains under-evidenced (and the registered anchor 'Keren-Portnoy & Tomasello 2021' could not be verified in this pass).

If incentive-salience firing required an intact learned-prediction signal (i.e. wanting could not be modulated without learning), then MECH-329's approach-drive-before-calibration ordering would be incoherent. The paper rules this out -- opioid modulation moved wanting and liking without moving the learned-prediction signal -- but a substrate that ties its salience write-gate to a learned value estimate would reintroduce exactly that unwanted coupling.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Corbetta's account of infant reaching is the closest verifiable analogue to MECH-329's mechanism. She describes goal-directed reaching as originating, around 3-5 months, from a CASUAL CONTINGENT EVENT -- 'when the hand happens to contact a target' -- which 'provides new behavioral value', 'reinforces the motor action, and intrinsically motivates infants to attempt to reproduce the behavior.' This is structurally MECH-329's seeding story: an ACCIDENTAL contact, not a calibrated preference, is the originating event, and an intrinsic approach/motivation signal -- not a mature hedonic evaluation -- is what latches onto it and drives repetition. It places the seeding earlier than the 9-month third-person milestone in Behne 2005 and grounds the 'accidental benefit contact under approach drive' language directly. Confidence 0.58: it is a conceptual/review synthesis of the motor-development literature rather than a single decisive experiment, and 'intrinsic motivation' is not identical to mesolimbic incentive salience -- so it supports the accidental-contact-plus-approach-drive structure strongly while leaving the specific neuromodulatory identity open.
failure_signatures: Corbetta's 'intrinsic motivation' is a behavioural/motor-development construct, not specifically mesolimbic-dopamine incentive salience. Reading it as MECH-329's 'wanting' imports a neuromodulatory identification the paper does not make. If the infant motor-exploration drive is not dopaminergic incentive salience (cf. Opendak et al. 2025, who argue mesolimbic DA is not yet functional perinatally), MECH-329's specifically-mesolimbic framing is over-committed even though the accidental-contact-plus-approach-drive STRUCTURE survives.

The paper is a review/conceptual synthesis, not a controlled test of ordering. It does not directly measure that motivated reaching precedes calibrated preference; it asserts a developmental sequence consistent with that ordering. Treated as decisive evidence rather than as a well-grounded framework, it would overstate the case.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical, verifiable replacement for the unverifiable 'Keren-Portnoy & Tomasello 2021' anchor MECH-329 originally cited. Behne, Carpenter, Call & Tomasello tested infants at 6, 9, 12 and 18 months and found that from 9 months onward infants reacted with differential impatience (reaching, looking away) when an adult was UNWILLING versus merely UNABLE to give a toy -- 6-month-olds showed no such differentiation. The authors conclude infants 'first begin to understand goal-directed action at around 9 months of age.' This grounds the developmental-ordering half of MECH-329 indirectly but solidly: a proto-intentional, goal/desire-attributing capacity is operational in the first year, well before the slow, repeated-exposure calibration of a mature hedonic preference function. Confidence 0.6, not higher, because the paper concerns infants' reading of OTHERS' intentional action (third-person goal attribution), not first-person approach-drive seeding of the infant's own goals, and it says nothing directly about wanting-vs-liking neural ordering. It establishes that goal-directed/intentional structure is early, which is the temporal premise MECH-329 needs; it does not by itself establish the mesolimbic-wanting-first mechanism.
failure_signatures: The paper measures third-person goal attribution (how infants interpret an adult's intentional action), not the first-person approach-drive that MECH-329 says seeds z_goal anchors. Using it as the ordering anchor imports a mapping step: early goal-directed COMPETENCE is taken as a proxy for early approach-MOTIVATION operability. If the two dissociate developmentally, this anchor would be weaker than it looks.

Goal-directed action understanding emerging 'around 9 months' is a first-year milestone but is not the perinatal/Phase-0 window MECH-329's 'earliest accidental benefit contacts' language implies. If MECH-329's seeding is meant to begin at birth, this anchor places the verifiable onset later than the claim's strongest wording.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This developmental reward-circuit review both supports and stresses MECH-329. SUPPORTS: it argues the reward system must be understood through developmental TRANSITIONS, with age-specific circuitry that supports reward learning early -- i.e. functional reward/approach behaviour is operational in infancy before the mature adult circuit is in place, consistent with MECH-329's 'wanting operational early, calibrated evaluation lags' framing. STRESSES (the important half): it directly complicates MECH-329's specifically-MESOLIMBIC-DOPAMINE framing for early infancy. The authors note dopaminergic projections 'exhibit late functional maturation' and are 'likely not functional in supporting learning in the perinatal infant', when reward learning instead relies on locus-coeruleus NOREPINEPHRINE flooding the olfactory bulb. They warn that 'behavioral similarity does not imply circuit continuity' across development. So the ORDERING half of MECH-329 (approach/reward before calibrated hedonic evaluation) is supported, but the MECHANISTIC attribution to mesolimbic dopamine in the earliest window is weakened -- the earliest 'wanting' may be NE-driven, with mesolimbic DA arriving later. Confidence 0.55: high-quality multi-author review, high mapping relevance, but mixed direction and a rodent-perinatal-to-REE transfer step.
failure_signatures: Mesolimbic dopaminergic projections 'exhibit late functional maturation' and are 'likely not functional in supporting learning in the perinatal infant' -- early reward learning relies on locus-coeruleus norepinephrine, not mesolimbic dopamine. MECH-329's literal mechanism ('mesolimbic dopamine wanting seeds the FIRST anchors') is therefore over-specified for the earliest window: the first approach/seeding signal may be a different neuromodulator, with mesolimbic DA coming online later.

'Behavioral similarity does not imply circuit continuity' -- infant approach/appetitive behaviour can look adult-like while being driven by different circuitry. Inferring an adult-style mesolimbic-wanting mechanism from early goal-directed BEHAVIOUR (as the Behne and Corbetta entries do) is exactly the inference this review cautions against.

The strongest mechanistic ontogeny data here are rodent (olfactory-bulb NE, perinatal odor conditioning). Mapping the rodent perinatal reward-learning circuit onto the human-infant 'wanting' MECH-329 invokes both a species and a developmental-window transfer.

MECH-332.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=1 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.73

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality review from the Heinricher lab, the canonical authority on RVM cell-type function for three decades. Mapping fidelity is high: the paper directly characterises the PAG/RVM circuit as the substrate for SD-021's commitment-gated precision suppression. The ON/OFF cell firing pattern driven by ACC/pgACC motivational input and opioid tone is exactly the biological circuit SD-021 posits as its implementation. Transfer risk is low given human imaging corroboration of the PAG/RVM role in anticipatory analgesia. Confidence 0.82 (higher than the MECH-256 cross-file entry because the paper speaks more directly to SD-021's substrate than to the efference-copy question).
failure_signatures: Molecular identification of RVM cell types does not cleanly align with the ON/OFF functional classification, suggesting the circuit has more heterogeneity than SD-021's current binary model; this could mean the commitment-gated attenuation is less precise than modelled.
The review focuses primarily on rodent data; human imaging evidence for the specific ON/OFF cell firing patterns is limited to indirect BOLD correlates.

MECH-333.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.749

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Review-level synthesis of the canonical mechanism MECH-333 invokes: maturation of parvalbumin inhibitory interneurons (gated by Otx2 transfer and perineuronal-net assembly) triggers critical-period onset, and the same machinery controls closure. Supports the inhibitory-maturation-opens-the-window premise but is a review (not primary data), so confidence is held below the empirical entries.
failure_signatures: Critical-period onset is triggered specifically by parvalbumin-interneuron maturation and perineuronal-net consolidation; before that maturation the window does not open. A REE plasticity window keyed to a diversity/inhibitory element predicts no plasticity until that element reaches a threshold maturity -- a falsifiable timing prediction.

Perineuronal nets that consolidate around mature PV cells act to CLOSE the window and stabilize the circuit; disrupting them can reopen plasticity. The same structure that opens the window later enforces winner-take-all stabilization -- consistent with MECH-333's 'before winner-take-all capture' framing but implying the closing mechanism is an active brake, not mere decay.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Supports the existence and tunability of a time-bounded plasticity window (MECH-333's core), but WEAKENS the specific E/I-balance-centric mechanism MECH-333 invokes: the authors show silent-synapse (glutamatergic) maturation governs critical-period duration largely INDEPENDENT of inhibitory tone. Included deliberately as the disconfirming-mechanism counterpoint.
failure_signatures: Ocular-dominance plasticity here was 'largely independent of the inhibitory tone' -- contradicting the strong reading of MECH-333 that the window is opened/closed by E/I balance and GABA maturation specifically. A REE implementation that pins the plasticity window solely to an inhibition/diversity-weight knob may be mechanistically incomplete.

Loss of PSD-95 reinstated silent synapses and REOPENED juvenile-like plasticity after normal closure -- the window's closure is reversible and tied to a postsynaptic glutamatergic maturation marker, not an irreversible E/I set-point.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Causal genetic dissociation: VGAT-null transplanted interneurons migrate and mature normally but FAIL to induce a critical period, while control interneurons do. Directly supports MECH-333's premise that GABAergic (inhibitory) maturation is the trigger that OPENS a time-bounded plasticity window. Mapping fidelity moderate -- biology evidences the opening mechanism, less so REE's specific 'suppress dominant scoring pathway update magnitude' phrasing.
failure_signatures: Transplanted interneurons unable to load GABA into vesicles integrate into the host circuit but do NOT open a plasticity window -- the opening of the window is gated specifically on GABAergic transmission, not merely on the presence of inhibitory cells. The REE analog: simply adding a diversity/inhibitory element is insufficient; it must be functionally transmitting to gate the window open.

Timing of the induced plasticity is dictated by the maturation state of the transplanted GABAergic cells -- the window is yoked to a developmental clock of the inhibitory element, supporting MECH-333's 'time-bounded' framing.

MECH-334.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.846

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Independent, mechanistically distinct confirmation of MECH-334's active-locking thesis: Lynx1 protein rises with maturation and actively brakes adult visual-cortex plasticity; Lynx1 knockout retains juvenile-like plasticity into adulthood. A second, molecularly orthogonal lock (cholinergic brake) alongside Pizzorusso's perineuronal nets strengthens the 'closure is active, multi-mechanism braking' reading; held just under Pizzorusso for slightly narrower readout (VEP).
failure_signatures: Lynx1 knockout retains juvenile plasticity indefinitely -- removing a single brake is sufficient to prevent closure, so MECH-334's closure is not robust to omission of the locking mechanism: 'no closure' is the default, closure is the engineered addition.

Lynx1 acts via nicotinic acetylcholine receptor signalling, partially redundant with the perineuronal-net lock (Pizzorusso 2002); MECH-334 modelled as a single closure mechanism may under-represent a biologically multi-lock architecture, with implications for how brittle a single-mechanism REE implementation would be.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct causal demonstration that critical-period closure is an ACTIVE, maintained molecular lock rather than passive plasticity decay: perineuronal-net / CSPG maturation coincides with closure, is delayed by dark rearing, and enzymatic degradation (chondroitinase-ABC) in adults restores ocular-dominance plasticity. This is the core of MECH-334's 'closure is active locking, reversible in principle'. Slightly below the anchor's 0.92 to reserve headroom for the substrate-transfer gap.
failure_signatures: Plasticity reactivation required active enzymatic removal of the lock; spontaneous reopening did not occur -- MECH-334's closure must therefore be modelled as a maintained constraint, not a one-time event, or the crystallized distribution will not in fact be protected long-term.

Closure timing tracked perineuronal-net assembly and was delayed (not abolished) by dark rearing -- closure is experience-modulated, so a MECH-334 implementation with a fixed closure epoch independent of the realised learning trajectory would diverge from the biology.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct in-vivo evidence for a two-stage gate: waking monocular deprivation depresses fast-spiking interneurons (the instruction), and only subsequent NREM sleep -- with increased phase-locked principal-neuron firing -- executes the ocular-dominance shift. Supports MECH-334's sleep-gated crystallization AND INV-074's ordering requirement (correct competitive instruction must be encoded before crystallization). Moderate-high confidence; the strongest evidential value is the temporal ordering, which is exactly what the REE sleep dependencies (MECH-120/165) need.
failure_signatures: The ocular-dominance shift was evident ONLY after post-deprivation sleep, not after waking deprivation alone -- if REE crystallizes the diversity distribution during the active phase without a subsequent consolidation/sleep step, it will not reproduce the biological crystallization and MECH-334 would be mis-implemented.

Corrupted waking dynamics (incorrect gate-1 instruction) prevent sleep from crystallizing the right representation -- so MECH-334 cannot rescue a diversity distribution that was not competitively established during the MECH-333 open window; this couples MECH-334's success to INV-074's necessity condition and makes them jointly falsifiable.

MECH-337.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=4 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.848

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality critical review that is the principal counterweight to Csibra & Gergely's INNATENESS claim -- it argues receptivity to teaching is built from non-specific adaptations for social bonding and social learning, not a dedicated genetic 'natural pedagogy' module. For REE this is informative rather than damaging: it does NOT weaken the architectural NEED for an external population channel; it weakens any assumption that the channel comes for free / is innately given. Logged as mixed and used to bound how MECH-337/ARC-077 may be framed.
failure_signatures: Component-by-component review (eye contact, contingency, infant-directed speech, gaze cuing, rational imitation) finds the evidence does not support each being a reliable, genetically dedicated adaptation FOR teaching -- so a substrate that ASSUMES an innate, pre-wired ostensive-population channel as a free primitive is over-claiming and would inherit an unsupported assumption.

If receptivity to teaching is itself culturally/associatively constructed, the caregiver-population channel is not a fixed given but a developmentally-built capacity; a model that hard-codes MECH-337 as innate machinery rather than as a learned/constructed channel mis-specifies its developmental status (and its GAP-L caregiver-substrate gate).

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-cited theoretical synthesis in a top review venue, marshalling a converging infant-cognition literature. It is the single most direct external grounding for MECH-337: it specifies the exact mechanism the slot posits -- ostensive cueing marks a regularity as generalizable/kind-relevant, enabling transmission of cognitively opaque content the agent could not extract observationally. Held below 0.85 because it is a theoretical proposal (not one decisive experiment) and its strong-innateness framing is itself contested (see Heyes 2016 counter-entry); the REE-side instantiation as a CandidateRule write is an architectural extrapolation the paper does not make.
failure_signatures: Cognitively opaque cultural content (where the function/rationale is not recoverable from observation alone) is shown to require ostensive communicative transmission rather than observational learning -- a substrate that populates its candidate-rule space only from the agent's own observation/behaviour (ARC-064 bottom-up alone) would fail to acquire exactly this class.

Ostensively marked information is interpreted by infants as generic and kind-relevant rather than episodic; a population mechanism that wrote scaffolded regularities as one-off episodic facts rather than as context-tagged generalizable candidates would mispredict this.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational, field-defining observational study (it introduced the term 'scaffolding') and the canonical operationalization of Vygotsky's zone of proximal development. Direct support for ARC-077's architectural commitment that an external agent controls task structure beyond the learner's unassisted reach, and for MECH-337's six-function population mechanism. Below 0.8 because it is a small-sample observational tutoring study, the scaffolding<->ZPD link was tightened by later authors rather than this paper, and the REE mapping (tutoring functions -> CandidateRule writes) is an architectural extrapolation.
failure_signatures: A scaffold lets a novice solve a task beyond unassisted effort by the tutor controlling the elements initially beyond the learner's capability -- a substrate whose candidate rules are bounded by what the agent can already do unaided (no external task-structuring) cannot acquire regularities in this above-unaided band.

Effective tutoring is contingent: support is titrated to the learner's current state and withdrawn as competence grows. A non-contingent, fixed external signal would not reproduce the tutoring gain, so a scaffolding channel modelled as a static injection rather than a contingent, fading one is mis-specified.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Highly influential BBS target article synthesising comparative and developmental evidence. It grounds the PRECONDITION for ARC-077/MECH-337 -- shared intentionality, joint attention and social referencing are the motivational/representational substrate that lets an agent be scaffolded at all. Confidence is moderate (not high) precisely because it maps to the enabling condition rather than to the population mechanism itself: it explains why a caregiver channel can transmit conventions, not the write operation that MECH-337 specifies.
failure_signatures: Skills of shared intentionality (joint attention, social referencing, role-reversal) emerge gradually over the first ~14 months and are species-unique; an agent lacking the motivation/representation to share psychological states does not acquire conventions or norms from others even with exposure -- a caregiver-population channel bolted onto a substrate with no shared-intentionality precondition would not function.

Convention and norm acquisition is shown to depend on the species-unique social-motivation pathway, not on general intention-reading alone; a model that assumes scaffolded rule uptake from observation/imitation without a sharing motivation mis-locates the mechanism.

MECH-338.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.784

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality, mechanistically decisive mouse genetics in Science: a region-specific CA3 NMDA-receptor knockout selectively impairs recall from an INCOMPLETE cue set while sparing full-cue recall -- the canonical causal demonstration of hippocampal pattern completion. This is the biological substrate MECH-338 names for cue-driven, context-tagged retrieval. Held at 0.78: rodent model, and 'pattern completion of a stored representation' -> 'cue-addressed CandidateRule retrieval' is a substrate-plausibility mapping, not a behavioural spec.
failure_signatures: CA3-NR1 knockout mice show normal spatial memory with a full cue set but a selective deficit when retrieval is induced by an INCOMPLETE/partial cue set; CA1 place cells stay normal in full-cue environments but degrade under partial-cue removal -- direct causal evidence that a dedicated recurrent substrate completes a stored pattern from a partial cue. A retrieval architecture with no partial-cue completion stage would not reproduce the dissociation.

The deficit is specifically in recall from degraded input, not in encoding or in full-cue performance -- a model that conflated 'cue match' with simple feature lookup (no attractor/completion dynamics) mis-specifies the substrate MECH-338 depends on.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical empirical demonstration that ENVIRONMENTAL context at encoding gates later recall (the concrete instance of MECH-338's cue<->context-tag matching), but a high-powered 2021 pre-registered replication (Royal Society Open Science) failed to reproduce the effect. The principle MECH-338 rests on is independently secured by Tulving & Thomson; this entry is included for the concrete environmental instantiation but its confidence is deliberately low to register the robustness problem honestly.
failure_signatures: Original result: free recall was substantially better when the test environment matched the learning environment (land/underwater), directly instantiating context-as-retrieval-cue -- a retrieval gate insensitive to reinstated context would not show this.

ROBUSTNESS CONTRA: a 2021 pre-registered, higher-powered replication (Royal Society Open Science 8:200724) did NOT find a same-context advantage. The specific environmental-context-dependent-recall effect is fragile; MECH-338 must therefore rest on the general encoding-specificity principle (Tulving & Thomson) and on the neural substrate (Nakazawa CA3 pattern completion), NOT on the strength of the environmental-context phenomenon alone.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational, robustly-replicated principle that is the formal core of MECH-338: a retrieval cue is effective to the extent it overlaps the operations performed at encoding. Maps almost verbatim onto 'a cue is matched against context tags written at population time; matching candidates become rollout-eligible'. High confidence; held at 0.82 (not higher) because the principle is general-memory, the REE object is a context-tagged candidate RULE rather than an episodic item, and the rollout-eligibility gate is a REE-side construct.
failure_signatures: A strong pre-experimental associate that was NOT the encoding context fails to cue an item that a weak but encoding-matched cue retrieves -- cue strength per se is not what governs access; encoding-context match is. A retrieval gate that scored candidate availability by raw cue salience rather than by match to the tags written at population time would mispredict this (the recognition-failure-of-recallable-words result).

If the operations performed at encoding determine what is stored and therefore which cues are effective, a population mechanism that writes a candidate WITHOUT binding it to its scaffolding context provides nothing for a later cue to match -- context-free population breaks cued retrieval.

MECH-339.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.668

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the most direct behavioural confirmation available for the SPECIFIC gating rule MECH-339 asserts -- not merely that context cues help retrieval, but that their contribution is CONDITIONAL on the strength of the direct (item) cue. Isarida et al. report that the size of the environmental context-dependent recognition effect DECREASES as item-cue strength increases, i.e. a strong item cue outshines the context cue. That is the outshining gate, measured. Confidence held at 0.66 rather than higher because (a) the substrate is human verbal recognition, not an agent's goal-bank retrieval, so the channel identities (item-cue<->z_goal match, ambient-context<->SD-039 payload) are an analogy not an import; (b) assessed from the abstract + meta-analytic summaries, not the full results tables.
failure_signatures: If the context channel were an always-on additive term rather than a strength-gated fallback, context-dependent effects would NOT shrink as the direct cue strengthens -- Isarida et al. observe exactly that shrinkage, so an unconditional additive context term mispredicts the data.

Context-dependent recognition here is carried by recollection (encoding-specificity / 'remembering'), not familiarity; a context channel wired to a familiarity-like graded-strength signal rather than a match-conditional recollective probe would not reproduce the regime.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Corroborates the boundary side of MECH-339: it shows the context channel carries real, recoverable retrieval signal (a richer dynamic context reinstates context-dependent recognition where static photographic contexts often produce null effects), which is what justifies including a context channel at all. But it is mixed for the claim because it primarily varies context salience rather than the item-cue strength that defines the outshining gate; it bounds and motivates the context channel without testing the gate's conditional shape directly. Held at 0.50 to reflect that indirectness plus abstract-level assessment.
failure_signatures: Static, low-information contexts can yield null context-dependent recognition even when an episode was encoded there -- so a context channel whose salience term is flat (insensitive to how much contextual information is actually available) would over-credit weak contexts and predict effects the data do not show.

Context-dependent recognition is fragile and depends on context richness; a model that treats any stored SD-039 payload as an equally strong context cue regardless of its informational content would mispredict the conditions under which the fallback actually helps.

MECH-340.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.683

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong support for MECH-340's core architectural commitment that persistence is an EXPLICIT, SEPARABLE control/efficacy gate over a disengagement default -- not a property of the stressor or of accumulated failure. In males, behavioural control over an identical stressor abolishes its sequelae via a prelimbic->dorsal-raphe gate; in females the same control is acquired but does NOT engage that protective circuit, so the buffering is absent -- and pharmacological activation of prelimbic cortex restores it. A dissociation in which identical control with identical outcomes does or does not gate persistence depending on whether a specific cortical circuit is engaged is exactly the 'the gate is a separate mechanism, present-but-can-be-silent' structure MECH-340 posits. Held at 0.62: rodent stressor-controllability paradigm mapped to an agent's goal-bank persistence is a structural analogy with real transfer risk, and the female-circuit finding is a boundary as much as a confirmation.
failure_signatures: A persistence gate can be PRESENT yet not ENGAGED: females acquire the controlling response and possess the prelimbic->DRN circuitry, yet the protective gate is not recruited and the disengagement default proceeds -- so 'the gate exists' does not entail 'the gate fires', and an architecture that conflates the two mispredicts the female data.

Persistence buffering tracks engagement of a specific cortical control-detection circuit, not the objective controllability of the situation: identical control with successful acquisition produces opposite sequelae depending on circuit engagement, ruling out a gate keyed on attained-control-as-fact rather than detected-control-as-signal.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Causal (lesion) evidence that the control-detection gate is NECESSARY for the persistence/buffering effect: excitotoxic lesions of medial prefrontal cortex PREVENT the stressor-controllability effect, so escapable and inescapable stress become equivalent without the gate -- the default proceeds when the detector is removed. This is the loss-of-function complement to Baratta 2018's present-but-silent / restorable gain-of-function, and together they bracket MECH-340's separable-gate-over-a-default architecture. It also shows a controllable experience inoculates against a later uncontrollable one, matching the reengagement-coupled, history-as-appraisal (not history-as-tally) framing. Held at 0.60: same rodent-aversive-to-agent-goal-bank transfer risk, and the lesion speaks to gate necessity, not to the specific appraisal variables MECH-340 leaves to Q-053.
failure_signatures: Remove the control-detection substrate (mPFC lesion) and the controllability benefit vanishes: escapable and inescapable stressors become behaviourally and neurochemically equivalent -- so persistence does NOT arise from the objective availability of control, only from its detection by an intact gate.

Without the gate, the dorsal-raphe-mediated default (reduced exploration, serotonergic activation) proceeds regardless of whether control was in fact available -- a system lacking the explicit detector collapses to the disengagement default.

MECH-341.confidence_rationale: exp=3 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0.687, lit_conf=0.756

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: PASS with supporting direction

Causal lesion + electrical-perturbation evidence (J Neurosci) that a dedicated basal-ganglia pathway is the source of the behavioral variation that downstream selection acts on. Maps onto MECH-341's structural argument (a diversity-generating circuit must hold parity with the deterministic pathway) but at the motor-output / proposal stage rather than strictly at a value-scoring step, so mapping fidelity is moderate.
failure_signatures: Lesions of Area X (song-specific basal ganglia) permanently eliminate rapid within-syllable fundamental-frequency variation; without that variation, reinforcement-driven song learning loses its substrate. The REE analog: if the diversity circuit is ablated or down-weighted, the candidate pool collapses to a single deterministic class and there is nothing for E3 scoring to discriminate among.

The constructive system is described as error-prone (memory distortions, false recognition) -- the very flexibility that lets it simulate futures is the source of confabulation, which is the failure mode MECH-365's one-way provenance gate must contain rather than something this substrate prevents on its own.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The source-monitoring framework is the foundational and still-dominant account of how the cognitive system attributes a remembered event to its origin (perceived vs imagined, internal vs external, this-source vs that-source). It directly grounds MECH-365's central design move -- that provenance is a represented attribute of an event rather than a free-floating mode bit -- and the reality-monitoring sub-case is the biological form of the committed_vs_imagined field. Held below 0.8 because the framework treats provenance as a RECONSTRUCTIVE, probabilistic attribution made at retrieval (and routinely WRONG), which is in tension with MECH-365's stronger one-way, never-violated gate; the framework supports the existence and dimensionality of the field but partly weakens the absoluteness of the gate.
failure_signatures: Source monitoring is a heuristic, reconstructive judgement made at retrieval from imperfect cues (vividness, sensory detail, cognitive-operation traces), not a stored ground-truth label -- so the human system routinely MISattributes imagined events as perceived (the source-misattribution errors that ARE confabulation/false memory). This weakens MECH-365's premise that committed_vs_imagined can be a reliably-enforced, one-way, first-class field rather than a fallible after-the-fact inference.

Because 'source' is multidimensional with indefinitely many values, a single binary committed_vs_imagined bit may be an under-specification: provenance failures occur along many axes (who said it, when, internally-generated-by-me vs by-another), not just real-vs-imagined.

MECH-366.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=5 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.808

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Establishes the core construct MECH-366 needs: personal memories are represented from one of two viewpoints -- FIELD (first-person, original field of view) or OBSERVER (seeing oneself from outside) -- so perspective is a real, represented structural property of an episode, not just an encoding artefact of the camera. That is direct support for the existence of a viewpoint tag. Held at 0.6 (mixed) because the paper does NOT demonstrate the part MECH-366 most needs: that viewpoint is freely SWITCHABLE at retrieval independent of encoding viewpoint. It shows perspective varies with emotion/self-awareness and age of memory, which actually suggests perspective is partly determined by encoding/affect rather than arbitrarily re-set on demand.
failure_signatures: Nigro & Neisser show perspective CORRELATES with emotionality, self-awareness and memory age (older and more self-focused memories drift toward observer perspective). This is evidence that viewpoint is partly DETERMINED by encoding and emotional content, which is in tension with MECH-366's claim that viewpoint is freely switchable at retrieval INDEPENDENT of encoding viewpoint -- the independence is not demonstrated and is mildly contraindicated.

The construct is established by self-report questionnaire on naturalistic memories, with no manipulation showing a single memory can be voluntarily re-experienced from the other viewpoint on demand; switchability is inferred, not tested.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Rice & Rubin show that first- and third-person visual perspectives are NOT mutually exclusive opposites: people commonly report experiencing a single memory from both perspectives, and the two ratings correlate differentially with vividness rather than trading off as a single bipolar dimension. This supports two things MECH-366 needs: (1) viewpoint is a graded, represented property that can be queried independently (not one fixed camera angle baked into the trace), and (2) it is a property distinct from the content of the episode. Held at 0.7 because the evidence is retrospective self-report rating rather than a manipulation showing on-demand switching, and the reported gender/individual differences mildly echo the encoding-dependence caveat from Nigro & Neisser.
failure_signatures: Perspective is partly an individual-differences and gender-linked variable (females report third-person perspective more often). As with Nigro & Neisser, this is a mild contra-signal to fully arbitrary, person-independent switching -- the viewpoint tag's default may be partly fixed by the rememberer, not freely re-set per retrieval.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Brewin et al.'s dual-representation account of intrusive imagery is a clinical anchor that viewpoint is a represented, dissociable property and that imagined/re-experienced content carries a viewpoint that can be therapeutically shifted (e.g. moving a flashback from a field/reliving perspective to an observer perspective reduces distress). That supports MECH-366's 're-experienced from either viewpoint' clause and extends it to imagery, not just recall. Marked MIXED, not supports, because the same literature documents that traumatic intrusions often come with an INVOLUNTARY, fixed first-person reliving perspective that resists voluntary re-setting -- a direct partial contraindication to the 'freely switchable at will' reading of MECH-366.
failure_signatures: Traumatic intrusive images are characteristically involuntary and locked to a first-person reliving (field) perspective with a 'nowness' quality; the viewpoint is precisely what the patient CANNOT switch at will. This is a real-world failure mode of free viewpoint-switching and shows the switch can be blocked by the affective/encoding status of the memory -- consistent with the Nigro and Rice caveats that perspective is partly determined, not arbitrary.

The field<->observer shift that therapy induces is effortful and often requires structured intervention, not a costless retrieval-time toggle -- a faithful REE viewpoint switch may need to model the cost/eligibility of switching, not just its availability.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the switchability keystone the Nigro & Neisser entry explicitly named as the missing follow-up. St. Jacques et al. instruct participants to recall a recently encoded autobiographical event from EITHER the original (typically own-eyes) perspective or the alternative perspective, and show that adopting a novel visual perspective at retrieval is (a) possible on demand and (b) actively reshapes the phenomenology of the memory, with precuneus recruitment scaling the degree of change. This is direct evidence for the load-bearing second half of MECH-366: viewpoint is a represented property that can be re-set at retrieval, independent of the encoding viewpoint, rather than a fixed encoding artefact. Held at 0.78 rather than higher because the manipulation is instructed/voluntary in a lab paradigm and the reshaping effect means switching is not perfectly content-preserving -- which is itself architecturally interesting but slightly complicates a clean 'same token, switchable label' reading.
failure_signatures: Shifting perspective does not merely re-render the same stored episode from a new angle -- it MODIFIES the memory (emotional intensity and vividness change, precuneus activity predicts the degree of change). So MECH-366's clean picture (one event token, a switchable viewpoint label read at retrieval) is complicated: in the brain, exercising the switch writes back to the trace. A faithful REE implementation must decide whether viewpoint-switch is a pure read operation or one that legitimately updates the episode.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Johnson & Raye's reality-monitoring model grounds the OTHER facet of MECH-366 named in the task: the imagined-vs-experienced viewpoint label. They show that memories carry attributes (perceptual detail, contextual richness vs records of cognitive operations) that the system uses to decide whether a memory originated externally (perceived) or internally (imagined/reasoned), and that this attribution is reconstructive and can fail. That is the biological warrant for treating imagined-vs-experienced as a represented, decidable label on an episode rather than a given. Held at 0.62 because (a) it is a 1981 theoretical model, and (b) reality-monitoring is really the imagined-vs-experienced SOURCE axis, which overlaps MECH-365/MECH-430 provenance more than the field/observer SPATIAL axis -- I am grounding one of MECH-366's two viewpoint dimensions, with explicit overlap into the provenance claims.
failure_signatures: Reality monitoring is reconstructive and fallible: the imagined-vs-experienced label is INFERRED from memory attributes at retrieval, not stored as ground truth. This grounds the EXISTENCE of an imagined-vs-experienced label but, exactly as the MECH-365 Johnson-1993 entry already recorded, leans against the absoluteness of a one-way committed-vs-imagined gate -- the brain's tag is probabilistic and can be wrong (imagined events misattributed as experienced).

MECH-368.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.743

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Compelling, convergent animal+human evidence that emotional arousal, via the basolateral amygdala (BLA) and its neuromodulatory (noradrenergic/glucocorticoid/cholinergic) inputs, MODULATES the strength of memory consolidation -- the degree of amygdala activation at encoding predicts subsequent recall. This is the biological mechanism MECH-361 names as 'affect gradient as memory WRITE-WEIGHT' and is a strong anchor for the salience/affect input to MECH-368's event-level write-authority gate. Held below 0.85 because the substrate modulates a GENERIC arousal/valence magnitude, not the per-candidate, signed affective GRADIENT MECH-361 specifies, and because it concerns the episodic/declarative write path, not the durable world-model/policy weight path that is MECH-368's under-covered target.
failure_signatures: The amygdala modulates write strength as a function of overall emotional AROUSAL (a largely scalar magnitude), whereas MECH-361 requires a per-CANDIDATE affective gradient (a vector over considered options). The BLA literature grounds 'affect scales write depth' but not 'the differential gradient ACROSS candidates is the write-weight' -- the candidate-differentiation that is MECH-361's actual novelty is not evidenced here.

BLA modulation operates on consolidation of declarative/episodic and procedural memory; it is NOT shown to gate durable updates to a predictive world-model or policy weights, which is exactly the path MECH-368 flags as under-covered. Transfer to the online model-update path is by analogy.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct behavioural demonstration of a two-factor write-eligibility mechanism: a weak experience sets a transient, input-specific 'learning tag' that yields only short-term memory UNLESS a separate novelty/salience event within a critical time window supplies the plasticity-related products that convert it to long-term memory. This is a strong biological analogue of MECH-368's separation of write-ELIGIBILITY (the tag) from write-CONSUMMATION (capture of consolidation resources), and grounds 'plasticity_eligibility' as a real gated state rather than an engineering label. Held at 0.7 because it concerns hippocampus-dependent episodic/behavioural LTM, not durable world-model/policy weight updates, and the gating variable is novelty/PRP availability rather than MECH-368's fuller f(PE, salience, residue, goal_relevance) conditioning set.
failure_signatures: Behavioral tagging gates the consolidation of episodic/behavioural memory traces; it is NOT shown to gate durable updates to a predictive world-model or action policy, the path MECH-368 flags as under-covered. The analogy to E1/E2/policy weight-writes is structural, not demonstrated.

The 'second factor' that licenses long-term write is NOVELTY-driven protein synthesis within a time window, a narrower and more passive trigger than MECH-368's active per-event gate conditioned on prediction_error, salience, residue_status, goal_relevance and plasticity_eligibility together. Tagging shows eligibility-then-capture exists; it does not show the rich multi-input arbitration MECH-368 posits.

MECH-369.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=1 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.538

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical review (source_quality 0.92) of a SLOW, BROADLY-PROJECTING neuromodulatory system (LC-NE) with two activity modes -- phasic (task exploitation) and tonic (disengagement / search for alternatives) -- in which a value-INDEPENDENT GAIN parameter sets engagement vs release of the current behaviour. This is the value-independent slow-modulator-class anchor MECH-369 was flagged as LACKING (AE-9 L4): a slow field-state that biases the action-release/engagement landscape WITHOUT being a value estimate. Direction set MIXED, not supports, because of a polarity inversion: tonic LC-NE promotes DISENGAGEMENT/lability, whereas MECH-369's compulsive stickiness is the LOW-disengagement (hard-to-release) pole. The anchor grounds the EXISTENCE and form of the modulator class; the stickiness polarity is a free parameter, not directly evidenced. exp_conf unchanged 0 -- PROMOTES NOTHING.
failure_signatures: POLARITY INVERSION: LC-NE tonic mode drives DISENGAGEMENT and exploration; MECH-369 is about excess STICKINESS / failure to release. The paper grounds a value-independent release/engagement modulator but its documented direction is opposite to compulsion -- do NOT cite it as evidence that the modulator produces stickiness.

LC-NE gain is driven by ACC/OFC utility monitoring, so it is not strictly utility-BLIND at the system level; MECH-369's 'value-independent' is about the modulator carrying no value ESTIMATE itself, which holds, but the upstream drive is utility-derived -- a subtle mapping boundary.
Generic-neuromodulator transfer: LC-NE is one specific system; using it as the slow-modulator-class template risks importing NE-specific properties (arousal coupling) that MECH-369 does not intend.

MECH-371.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=1 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.687

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The foundational, well-replicated empirical paper establishing the p factor (a single general-psychopathology dimension) in a 20-year longitudinal cohort. It grounds the EXISTENCE and transdiagnostic-loading premise of MECH-371's p-factor analogue -- a single broad vulnerability dimension that raises joint susceptibility across failure modes. Held at 0.72 because the paper validates the construct in humans but says nothing about MECH-371's specific MECHANISTIC interpretation (that the p-factor analogue IS control-plane / setpoint-regulation instability, ARC-005); that mapping is REE's own hypothesis and is not in the source.
failure_signatures: The p factor is a statistical/structural finding (a latent dimension that fits cross-disorder covariance better than separable factors); it does not identify a single causal mechanism, so MECH-371's claim that the analogue is specifically control-plane regulatory instability goes beyond what the source establishes and could be the wrong mechanistic identification.

p-factor structure can be partly an artefact of measurement and comorbidity-counting; a REE substrate that builds in a single global-instability scalar by construction risks manufacturing the dimension rather than discovering it -- the human evidence is for a latent factor, not for a designed-in scalar.

MECH-372.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.804

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the closest published anchor to the source trigger for the whole cluster (the Schrodinger colour-theory completion result). It shows empirically that perceptual colour space exhibits 'diminishing returns' -- large colour differences are perceived as LESS than the sum of small steps -- which is mathematically impossible in a Riemannian (locally additive) geometry. That is direct, high-quality evidence for ARC-087's specific assertion that the perceptual manifold is 'curved, compressed, asymmetric, non-additive, unlike the raw measurement space', and for MECH-372's placement of sight at the deep-adaptor end (colour geometry must be CONSTRUCTED, not read off). Confidence just below source_quality because it reanalyses/reframes existing colour-difference datasets rather than running a new psychophysical cohort, and the additivity-violation claim has prompted active debate.
failure_signatures: The paper overturns the long-assumed Riemannian (Helmholtz/Schrodinger) model of colour space but does NOT supply a replacement metric -- so it establishes that the colour adaptor's output geometry is non-additive without telling the adaptor designer what geometry to target.

It is a geometric reanalysis of aggregate colour-difference data; an adaptor-internal mechanism (how receptor signals are transformed into this non-Riemannian metric) is out of scope, so it grounds the OUTPUT shape, not the transform.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical mechanistic account of the ventral visual stream as a deep, largely feedforward cascade that progressively 'untangles' object identity manifolds -- transforming a representation in which identity is not linearly separable (retinal/V1) into one in which it is (IT). This is the biological instantiation of ARC-087's deep visual adaptor: the adaptor IS a sequence of metric-reshaping transforms that build invariance (to position, scale, pose, lighting) BEFORE downstream read-out, not a flat feature extractor. It also concretely anchors MECH-372's deep end (sight needs a multi-stage adaptor). High source quality + high mapping fidelity; confidence below ceiling only because it is primate/human object-recognition specific and is a review/synthesis rather than a single decisive experiment.
failure_signatures: The untangling account is strongest for ventral-stream OBJECT IDENTITY; it does not establish that every visual sub-property ARC-087 lists (colour geometry, gaze salience, affordance) is built by the same cascade, so 'the adaptor' is plausibly several parallel manifold-constructors, not one.

Emphasis on a largely feedforward cascade understates recurrent/feedback contributions later work foregrounds; if the V4 visual adaptor is built as strictly feedforward on this paper's authority it may under-fit hard cases (heavy occlusion, clutter) the review itself flags as unsolved.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct behavioural demonstration that an olfactory signal functions as a near-raw spatial GRADIENT that can be followed for navigation -- a single functional olfactory neuron suffices for chemotaxis up a measured odour gradient, and bilateral input improves accuracy mainly by raising signal-to-noise. This is strong support for MECH-372's placement of smell at the LOW-adaptor-depth end: orientation behaviour (follow / approach / strengthen / weaken) is recoverable with minimal transformation of the raw chemical signal, in contrast to the multi-stage construction vision needs. Confidence held moderate because the model is Drosophila larva -- the gradient-primitive PRINCIPLE transfers but the specific biology is phylogenetically distant from REE's intended agent.
failure_signatures: Demonstrated in larval Drosophila with a single odour and an externally imposed monotonic gradient; it shows a near-raw gradient is SUFFICIENT for orientation, not that biological olfaction in general stays low-adaptor (mammalian odour-identity / mixture demixing may require substantial transformation, which would complicate MECH-372's 'smell = low-adaptor' as a blanket claim).

The bilateral-comparison benefit is largely an SNR effect, not a rich spatial-geometry computation -- so it supports 'gradient primitive' but offers no evidence for any structured olfactory MANIFOLD, leaving the depth of the olfactory adaptor under-specified at its upper bound.

MECH-380.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.718

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical integrative review of inner speech, explicitly built on the Vygotskian internalisation account (social speech -> private/egocentric speech -> condensed inner speech) and reporting the neurobiology (left inferior frontal gyrus / Broca's area as the production core; superior temporal gyrus involvement; supplementary motor and parietal contributions). It grounds MECH-380's central assertion -- that overt self-narration is the EXTERNAL phase of a cognitive-control system that later compresses inward -- with mechanism evidence rather than textbook analogy, and grounds MECH-381's compression ladder via the documented private->inner speech internalisation. Confidence held below 0.8 by the architectural-mapping step: the review describes inner speech as verbal thinking / self-monitoring / executive support, not as an arbitration-driving control surface in REE's specific sense, and REE has no spoken-language modality at all.
failure_signatures: The review documents that inner speech SUPPORTS executive function, planning, and self-regulation, but it does not establish that the external (overt) phase is functionally NECESSARY as a control surface -- the correlation between private-speech use and task performance is developmental and individual-difference evidence, not a demonstration that cognition must be externalised before it can be internalised.

Inner speech is shown to be variable (some adults report little; condensed vs expanded forms differ) -- the ladder MECH-381 asserts is a central tendency, not an obligatory sequence, which weakens any claim that the externalise-then-internalise route is the ONLY developmental path to internal control.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Provides the explicit Vygotskian internalisation MECHANISM that the compression ladder (MECH-381) needs: inner speech develops through a transition between EXPANDED (full, external-like, dialogic) and CONDENSED (abbreviated, covert) forms, and the neural-correlates literature is read through that lens (low verbal-self-monitoring tasks like reciting in inner speech vs high VSM tasks like auditory verbal imagery dissociate in temporal-lobe activation). The compression-and-condensation account is the closest mechanistic statement of MECH-381's externalise->internalise axis. Confidence is moderate because the paper's primary explanatory target is auditory verbal hallucinations (a pathology of mis-attributed inner speech), so the mapping to a healthy REE control surface runs through a clinical model, and the neural evidence is correlational.
failure_signatures: The condensed/expanded framework is a theoretical integration of mixed and partly inconsistent neuroimaging findings, not a settled mechanism -- the authors themselves flag that prior studies rested on 'unexamined assumptions about the form and developmental significance of inner speech'.

The paper's account of WHEN inner speech is mis-attributed (AVHs arise from abnormalities in the condensed<->expanded transition) implies the compression ladder has a failure mode REE has not modelled: a poorly tagged self-generated control signal can be experienced as external/other, i.e. the ladder is not automatically safe.

MECH-382.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=1 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.688

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct, converging-methods (ERP + fMRI) neuroscience test of MECH-382's exact claim: referring to oneself in the third person (self-distancing) reduces self-referential emotional reactivity -- a smaller late positive potential within the first second, and reduced medial prefrontal cortex (self-referential) activation -- and does so WITHOUT increasing cognitive-control markers (no extra stimulus-preceding negativity; no increase in cognitive-control fMRI regions). That 'alters processing of the affective/self-referential state, cheaply, without recruiting effortful control' is precisely MECH-382's framing of distancing as a low-effort arbitration-altering operator. Confidence held below 0.8 by modest sample sizes typical of ERP/fMRI studies and by the architectural step from human mPFC self-referential processing to REE's self_reference_frame vocabulary.
failure_signatures: The effect is demonstrated for down-regulating NEGATIVE affect (aversive images, negative autobiographical memories); the paper does not show third-person framing helps with the broader 'sticky high-conflict self-referential state' MECH-382 targets (e.g. unresolved prediction-error pressure), so the generalisation to arbitration-level conflict is an extrapolation.

'Without engaging cognitive control' is an inference from the ABSENCE of increases in a-priori control markers (SPN; control regions); a null on chosen markers is weaker than a positive demonstration that no control was used, so the 'low-effort' premise rests on accepting a null.

MECH-383.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.738

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the theoretical statement of the mechanism that MECH-383 names -- the label-feedback hypothesis -- and is the 'top-down precision-control partner' the grounding task asked for. It assembles the evidence that labels exert rapid, pervasive, top-down effects on categorisation, visual discrimination, and even stimulus detection, and argues the right framework is one where labels MODULATE ongoing perceptual processing in a task-dependent, flexible way (rather than verbal vs non-verbal being separate stores). That modulatory, task-dependent framing is exactly MECH-383's 'label as control input to precision'. Confidence moderate because it is a review/position piece, not a single decisive experiment, and its 'reject the verbal/non-verbal distinction' framing is stronger than REE needs (REE only needs labels to be ONE control input among others).
failure_signatures: Label effects are described as both deep (reaching basic visual processes) AND fragile (verbal interference can nullify them) -- so a label-as-control input is state-dependent and can be knocked out by load, meaning REE could not treat it as a reliable always-on precision signal.

The review is a theoretical synthesis advocating a position (language modulates perception online); it is not itself an experiment, so it grounds the FRAMEWORK for MECH-383 rather than supplying a new decisive datum beyond the primary studies it cites.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical direct test of MECH-383's exact claim: producing a self-directed label ('saying the target name aloud') temporarily improves visual SEARCH for that target -- a perceptual-control intervention, not a post-perceptual report. The design is causal (within-subject manipulation of speaking vs not speaking the target name) and the effect is graded by name-target association strength, which matches MECH-383's framing of labels as tunable top-down signals. Confidence held below 0.8 because the manipulation is overt natural-language speech in humans and the boundary condition (speaking HURTS when the label mismatches the target) shows the control input is not free -- both relevant transfer caveats for a non-linguistic REE substrate.
failure_signatures: The facilitation reverses to IMPAIRMENT as the discrepancy between the spoken name and the visual target grows -- a mis-specified label actively degrades search, so a label-as-control input in REE would need accurate label generation to be net-beneficial (no free lunch).

The effect is on visual SEARCH (finding a known target among distractors), which is template-matching/attentional, not on detecting genuinely novel or unexpected cues -- so the paper supports the 'bias toward label-relevant cues' reading of MECH-383 more strongly than the 'novelty-gradient toward unexplained change' reading.

MECH-385.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=1 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.678

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The foundational formal statement of the exact problem INF-7/ARC-091 names: under partial observability the policy must map a BELIEF over hidden states (not the raw observation) to action. High source-quality (the canonical POMDP reference) and a precise normative grounding for MECH-385. Confidence capped because REE explicitly does NOT adopt exact Bayesian belief updating, so the mapping is principle-level, with real divergence in mechanism.
failure_signatures: Failure-to-infer-hidden-danger / hidden-safety is exactly the cost of acting on observation rather than belief; the POMDP framework makes precise why an observation->action policy is provably suboptimal when state is hidden.
Context loss (MECH-126): a memoryless reactive policy that ignores observation/action history is the degenerate belief-state failure the formalism rules out.

MECH-388.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=1 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.678

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical formal treatment decomposing the value of a policy into pragmatic (reward/harm) and epistemic (uncertainty-reducing) components, so that information-gathering actions are selected even when not immediately rewarding. Directly grounds MECH-388 (epistemic action pressure as a survival-relevant viability function) and the active-inference half of L5. Confidence capped by the formalism's strong assumptions (expected-free-energy minimisation) which REE does not adopt wholesale, and by it being theory rather than a single decisive empirical test.
failure_signatures: Anti-epistemic panic: an agent weighting only pragmatic value commits under threat without sampling -- the active-inference account predicts this as failure to value epistemic gain.

Epistemic freezing: the dual failure -- over-weighting epistemic value so the agent keeps gathering information and never commits -- is the over-exploration tail the pragmatic/epistemic balance must bound.

MECH-391.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=6 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.82

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Grounds the 'retired' state as a first-class ADAPTIVE, regulated operation (transience enhances flexibility + prevents overfitting; goal of memory is decision-optimisation not preservation) -- supports MECH-391's retired state. But for INV-080 it is a genuine TENSION: it argues controlled forgetting/attenuation is GOOD, cautioning against a naive 'never delete' reading. Net mixed: it reframes INV-080 as 'retirement must be GOVERNED', not 'no deletion'.
failure_signatures: Transience (forgetting) is adaptive -- it enhances flexibility and prevents overfitting -- so an over-strong INV-080 that forbids ALL deletion would itself be a failure mode (hoarding outdated, overfit detail). The invariant must be read as 'no SILENT/ungoverned deletion of the evidence base', not 'no forgetting'; a memory system that never retires anything degrades decision-making.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Directly on the integrate-vs-separate axis MECH-391's allocation gate steers: related memories interconnect via overlapping neuronal populations; mPFC schema representations guide reactivation that promotes hippocampal integration (schema_fit input). High mapping fidelity for the 'integrate' pole; the explicit DECISION policy (when to integrate vs separate, and pricing false-linking) remains the novel REE overlay.
failure_signatures: The paper documents integration as a mechanism but does not specify WHEN integration should be withheld; it evidences only the integrate pole, so it cannot ground the cost of OVER-integration (false linking) that INV-079 and the allocation policy must price -- a one-sided grounding that, taken alone, would bias the gate toward linking.

Causal-factor-space isoclines are a descriptive measurement framework fitted to dove hunger/thirst; it does not specify the neural mechanism of competition, so it constrains the functional form of arbitration but is silent on implementation.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The closest formal articulation of REE's drive layer: homeostatic set-points enter as priors that 'act as drives or goals to enslave action', and multiple control processes (Pavlovian, habitual, goal-directed) are cast as hierarchical contextualisations rather than competitors with a hard boundary. As a normative active-inference account it predicts behaviour minimises expected free energy; if REE's substrate cannot represent the homeostatic set-points as priors with calibrated precision, the soft-competition the framework promises will not emerge and arbitration could collapse to whichever drive has the largest raw error.

The paper establishes hunger-suppresses-others but does not characterise the reciprocal case (does extreme thirst or fear suppress hunger symmetrically?), so the competition geometry beyond the hunger-dominant regime is unconstrained by this evidence.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational normative theory establishing that the long-run average reward rate functions as an opportunity cost that sets a global vigour/allocation signal (reported by tonic dopamine). MECH-398.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.824

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational (Nature) result that pins down a load-bearing design constraint for MECH-398: in kitten visual cortex, combined destruction of BOTH the cholinergic AND noradrenergic inputs is required to abolish ocular-dominance plasticity -- lesioning either system alone leaves plasticity intact. A REE gate built as a single neuromodulatory input (ACh-analog alone, or collapsing NE into the same channel) would mis-predict redundancy: the biology shows the gate is conjunctive across at least two modulatory systems, so a one-input gate is more brittle than the substrate it models.

The authors note the catecholamine neurotoxin 6-OHDA can interfere directly with ACh action, and that earlier NA-depletion results conflicted -- a cautionary signature that crude single-transmitter manipulations conflate channels. A REE implementation that does not keep the plasticity-GAIN channel architecturally separate from the content channels (MECH-313 LC-NE / MECH-203 5-HT / SD-037 orexin) risks the same conflation that produced two decades of conflicting plasticity-modulation results.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High source quality (Nature; in vivo whole-cell recording in adult AI) and the single best mechanistic account of HOW cholinergic gating opens a plasticity window: NB pairing causes a rapid, stimulus-specific reduction of synaptic inhibition (seconds), followed by a slow excitatory increase and an activity-dependent inhibitory rebalancing (hours) that retunes the receptive field. A REE design that gates the opening (MECH-398) without a coupled rebalancing/closure mechanism (MECH-399 PV clock) risks runaway excitation: the biology never leaves the window open, it always rebalances.

The disinhibition was stimulus-SPECIFIC (only the paired stimulus's inputs were affected). A global REE gain scalar that opens plasticity for the whole encoder at once would over-generalise relative to this targeted, input-specific window -- arguing for the layer/input-specific resolution Q-072 raises rather than a single global gate.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, high-source-quality (Science, Merzenich lab) demonstration that basal-forebrain cholinergic activity is what ENABLES adult cortical plasticity: pairing a tone with nucleus basalis stimulation drives massive auditory-cortex remapping, while the same acoustic input without NB activation does not. This is the direct biological referent for the OPENING-side gate MECH-398 proposes -- a basal-forebrain ACh signal that gates whether sensory input is incorporated into long-term cortical representation. Held at 0.80 (not higher) because the transfer is from a phasic electrical-stimulation paradigm in rat AI to an algorithmic learning-rate scalar in REE; the mapping is to the abstract gating role, not the cholinergic pharmacology.

A REE gain scalar that merely scales a single global learning rate (rather than letting the paired input shape WHAT is learned) would under-represent this: the biology gates plasticity ON, the content of the change still comes from the input stream.

Plasticity required PAIRING (NB activation coincident with the stimulus); NB stimulation alone or stimulus alone did not remap. A REE gate driven by a state scalar that is not temporally bound to the to-be-learned input would mislocalise plasticity -- the gating must be coincident with the encoder's exposure to the input it should incorporate.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical review (Nat Rev Neurosci, Hensch) establishing that critical-period TIMING is set by the functional maturation of a specific PV-positive inhibitory interneuron subset, with structural consolidation via extracellular-matrix (PNN) reorganization. A single global REE plasticity-gain clock would contradict this -- the biology argues for the per-substrate / layer-specific resolution Q-072 raises, and against MECH-334's current binary on_phase3_entry transition as the final word.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong (Nat Neurosci) causal demonstration that the plasticity window is RE-OPENABLE in adulthood: environmental enrichment restored visual acuity and ocular dominance in adult amblyopic rats, via reduced GABAergic inhibition, increased BDNF, and reduced perineuronal-net density -- and benzodiazepine inhibition-enhancement PREVENTED it.
