MECH-411.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=1 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.697

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct experimental (not merely correlational) evidence that induced guilt motivates reparative/prosocial action toward the harmed party, dissociated from shame, using economic-game behaviour as the dependent measure. Strong for the action-outlet half of ARC-097 and for MECH-411 (guilt generates and selects a repair trajectory). Held mid-band because it is a single (multi-experiment) lab paper on healthy adults with self-report inductions, and the later de Hooge work itself qualifies the picture (guilt's prosociality is regulated by whether reparative action has occurred, and can be at others' expense).

A repair-routing mechanism keyed only to harm-detection would over-repair.

Later work in this line shows guilt-driven compensation can be taken at the expense of uninvolved third parties when that is the cheaper route -- reparation is targeted at discharging the guilt, which is not guaranteed to be globally prosocial.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The modern CLS restatement, co-authored by the DeepMind team that put replay at the centre of agent design. Directly supports two of MECH-423's readiness sub-conditions: replay is the mechanism by which experience statistics are integrated across the system (R3), and neocortical learning can be RAPID when new information is consistent with existing shared structure -- i.e. the super-additive regime is precisely 'schema-consistent' integration. Explicitly bridges neuroscience and ML agent design, which is the exact cross-domain register MECH-423 lives in. Mapping fidelity moderate because it is a review, not a controlled super-additivity test.
failure_signatures: If replayed experience is not weighted/selected to interleave across the modules that share the latent, integration does not accrue and the integrated arm shows no advantage -- replay merely rehearses within-module and the cross-pollination MECH-423 predicts never occurs.

When new information is INCONSISTENT with the existing shared structure, neocortical (slow, shared) integration is slow and can interfere; super-additivity is expected only in the schema-consistent regime, so a mismatched module pairing can produce a null or negative result that is about task-relatedness, not about integration machinery.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong empirical grounding (humans + macaque) that a transmodal integration hub (the DMN) sits at the apex of a principal cortical gradient, maximally and equidistantly removed from primary sensory/motor cortex -- exactly the topographical signature of a region whose function is to integrate information detached from immediate sensory input. This grounds the BIOLOGICAL plausibility of MECH-423's readiness condition R-DMN (a DMN-analogue offline integration hub). Confidence held to 0.66 because REE has no explicit DMN module (per project_attention_distributed_precision_selection, REE's analogue is distributed), so the mapping is to a FUNCTIONAL prerequisite, not a named substrate component.
failure_signatures: If the integrated substrate has no apex region detached from sensory/motor streams (no transmodal hub equidistant from the modalities it integrates), there is no locus for cross-module integration to occur -- integration collapses back to within-modality processing and the super-additive gap does not open.

The gradient is a structural/topographical observation; an integration hub being PRESENT does not entail it is actively integrating during the measurement window -- a static hub with no online integration is the degenerate-readiness case.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The foundational demonstration that a SHARED representation trained on related tasks generalises better than isolated single-task models -- the direct ML precedent for MECH-423's 'integrated beats isolated'. It SUPPORTS that super-additive transfer is real and arises from feature sharing in the hidden layer. But it is tagged MIXED because Caruana is explicit that the benefit is CONDITIONAL on task relatedness; sharing across unrelated tasks does not help and can hurt. This conditionality is exactly the readiness/regime caveat MECH-423 must respect, so the paper both supports the claim's existence and bounds its universality.
failure_signatures: Sharing a representation across tasks that do not share underlying structure yields no transfer benefit and can degrade performance -- a sub-additive or negative result that is about task UNrelatedness, not about the integration machinery; MECH-423 must therefore pair modules whose features genuinely overlap (E1<->E2) or risk a null that misattributes to integration failure.

The MTL benefit is an emergent property of gradient-coupled hidden units; if the shared layer is too small or the task-specific heads absorb all the signal, the cross-task features never form and the integrated model reverts to the isolated baseline.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Supplies the OPERATIONAL readiness metric for MECH-423: it defines conflicting gradients as those with negative cosine similarity, and shows negative transfer (a shared representation performing WORSE than separate models) arises when conflicting gradients coincide with high positive curvature and a large magnitude difference. This converts MECH-423's vague 'non-zero cross-module gradient' readiness check into a concrete, measurable two-sided gate (coupling non-zero AND not net-conflicting). Tagged mixed because it is primarily evidence of the FAILURE mode -- a shared latent is not automatically super-additive; it can be sub-additive by gradient conflict.
failure_signatures: A shared representation can perform WORSE than independent per-task models (negative transfer) when task gradients on the shared parameters conflict -- so an integrated arm at-or-below the isolated baseline may indicate destructive gradient interference, a regime where super-additivity is not even expected, rather than a clean refutation of the claim.

If the per-module gradients on the shared latent have a net-negative cosine similarity, the shared optimisation direction is not jointly beneficial; scoring super-additivity in that regime measures the wrong thing -- the readiness gate must detect net-conflict and route substrate_not_ready / re-scope, not FAIL.

A peer-reviewed (NeurIPS) demonstration that useful subgoals/options can be DISCOVERED via a manager-worker cross-level credit signal rather than hand-specified, and that discovered subgoals transfer to genuinely new tasks -- directly relevant to whether MECH-427's parent/subgoal credit machinery could plausibly extend to discovering NEW subgoal-like structure rather than only crediting a pre-given hierarchy. recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A clean computational demonstration that goals held at the agent's current level of attainability expand the set of achievable goals bottom-up under sparse reward, with no prior knowledge of the environment -- the zone-of-proximal-development principle made mechanical. Held down because the goal SPACE is given a priori and the architecture is flat goal-conditioned RL with no superordinate goal at all, so it evidences the reachability-expansion half of MECH-428 and not the parent-formation half.

The method presupposes a parametrized goal space (subsets of the state space) supplied by the designer -- it discovers WHICH goals are currently attainable, not what the space of goals is.

failure_signatures: Flat DQN scores zero on Montezuma's Revenge -- with terminal reward this sparse, direct top-down pursuit of the superordinate goal yields no learning signal at all, which is the seeding-failure regime MECH-428 is written for.

The paper's own stated diagnosis of the failure is INSUFFICIENT EXPLORATION resulting in an agent unable to learn robust value functions -- i.e. the goal representation never gets the contact it needs to become well-formed.

The subgoal set is supplied externally (entities from a custom object detector), so the demonstration is that ATTAINABLE SUBGOALS RESCUE learning, not that an agent can generate its own subgoal structure -- a limitation later hierarchical-RL work has repeatedly had to confront.

The meta-controller's value function over intrinsic goals exists from initialisation; nothing here shows a superordinate goal being CREATED by repeated subgoal attainment where it did not previously exist.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical source for scaffolding and the developmental anchor MECH-428's own notes flagged as the next lit-pull, so it fills a named gap in the claim's grounding. Confidence is deliberately modest: it is a 1976 observational study of tutor-child interaction whose abstract is not retrievable through PubMed, its evidential standards predate modern developmental methodology, and -- most importantly -- the scaffold it documents is EXTERNALLY PROVIDED, which is the sibling mechanism (scaffolded_sd054_onboarding) rather than MECH-428's internal complement.
failure_signatures: A task beyond the learner's current unaided capacity yields no productive engagement at all until it is decomposed -- the developmental counterpart of a superordinate goal that cannot be seeded because its terminal benefit is never contacted.
The decomposition in this paper is performed by a TUTOR, not by the learner; the study documents scaffolded acquisition and does not show a learner generating its own subgoal structure.

Effectiveness of tutoring varied systematically with the child's age and developmental level, indicating the subgoal grading must match current competence -- a mis-graded scaffold is not merely less helpful but can fail to engage the learner.
Non-retrievable abstract and 1976-era observational methodology mean effect sizes, sample and analysis cannot be independently verified from the record obtained here.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct grounding for MECH-429, which was reaped in the first ABM-9 pass as a completion-set partner with NO literature_evidence entry (lit_conf null) -- this entry closes that reap-only gap, which is exactly what the FINISH pass asked for. van Kesteren et al.'s SLIMM model proposes that medial PFC detects congruency between new information and existing neocortical schemas ('resonance') and, when congruent, routes that information into a fast mPFC-gated systems-consolidation pathway, bypassing the slow hippocampal-dependent route that incongruent information needs. That IS MECH-429's mechanism: schema-fit as a consolidation write-weight / routing variable with a fast vmPFC route. MECH-429's 'congruent is consolidated preferentially' is the central tendency, but a faithful model must represent the U-shaped congruence/novelty interaction, not a single linear schema-fit gain.

MECH-434.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=4 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.843

This is the neuromodulatory mechanism behind anti-epistemic-panic: under threat the substrate that would sustain extended inference is suppressed, forcing early commitment. Strong source; capped because it is about working-memory/PFC function generally, and the bridge to REE's specific commitment-timing gate is functional, not implemented.
failure_signatures: Anti-epistemic-panic mechanism: acute stress -> high catecholamines -> PFC deliberative/working-memory function impaired -> reliance on faster habitual/subcortical control -> commitment before the belief-state is resolved.
Predicts the inverted-U: too little arousal under-engages, too much collapses deliberation -- the commitment-timing axis has an optimal band, not a monotone.

Together with the JTC entry it brackets the commitment-timing axis from both ends -- under-gather (panic/JTC) vs over-gather (freezing/OCD). Confidence 0.70: rigorous model-based clinical study, but the over-gathering is in an abstract sampling task, and 'enhanced performance' shows the pole is not purely pathological (context-dependent).

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A strong synthesis of the threat-imminence framework, which is almost a direct description of the anti-epistemic-panic pole: as a threat becomes proximal/surprising, the system contracts its decision and state space and switches from model-based (deliberative, information-gathering) to model-free (fast, reactive) computation. That is exactly 'collapse the epistemic term and commit under urgency'. High relevance and source quality; capped by being a review framework and by the species/circuit specifics not mapping one-to-one onto REE.
failure_signatures: Anti-epistemic-panic: at high threat imminence the deliberative/model-based route is abandoned for model-free reaction BEFORE the belief-state is disambiguated -- adaptive when imminence is genuinely high, pathological when it fires on uncertain or distal threat.
The same axis predicts the opposite failure when imminence is mis-estimated as low (over-deliberation), linking to epistemic-freezing.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The cleanest computational grounding that WHEN to commit is a governed, time-varying control parameter rather than a fixed threshold: evidence is multiplied by a growing urgency signal, so the effective decision criterion drops over time and commitment timing is tunable. This is the mechanistic backbone of MECH-434 (commitment timing as the axis whose two poles are freezing and panic). recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the foundational fMRI paper localising the STN to response inhibition and coining the 'hyperdirect' (right-IFC -> STN) hypothesis -- the Aron & Poldrack seed line and the source of the 'hold' / global-NoGo primitive in MECH-439's scope. It grounds the EXISTENCE and anatomy of the hyperdirect hold: the STN suppresses thalamocortical output to block response execution, and Stop-related STN activity scales with inhibition speed. It is MIXED because the mechanism it characterises is a GLOBAL, NON-SELECTIVE BRAKE (cancel ALL responses), which is the OPPOSITE of conflict-graded widening of the consideration set. MECH-439's fix is GRADED (k scales with the F-gap), aligning with the Frank/Cavanagh conflict-threshold lineage, NOT with Aron's all-or-none global stop. So Aron & Poldrack supports that the hyperdirect HOLD primitive is real and STN-mediated, while flagging that REE's GRADED use is a refinement of (not identical to) the canonical global-NoGo -- a load-bearing distinction, because a blunt global brake would suppress diversity, not create it.
failure_signatures: The canonical hyperdirect signal is a GLOBAL NoGo that cancels all responses non-selectively; applied naively to E3 it would suppress the committed action entirely (a freeze), not widen the consideration set -- the graded k=f(F-gap) is required precisely because the raw Aron global-stop is the wrong primitive for generating diversity.

Aron & Poldrack localise the hold to a STOPPING context (an external stop signal), not to value/conflict-graded action selection among competing GO options; transferring the hyperdirect hold from reactive stopping to graded committed-selection requires the Frank/Cavanagh conflict-threshold bridge and is not directly evidenced here.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical computational model of the exact mechanism MECH-439's proposed fix translates: the subthalamic nucleus (STN), driven by cortical response conflict, dynamically raises the response threshold via the cortico-subthalamic-pallidal (hyperdirect) pathway, and this matters MOST when there are multiple competing responses. That is the qualitative content of the conflict-graded hold k=f(F-gap) -- small top-score gap (near-tie / high conflict) widens the consideration window so a non-dominant stream can still win. Confidence is held below 0.8 by one load-bearing structural divergence: Frank's STN raises a CONTINUOUS, TEMPORAL threshold (it buys time within a within-trial evidence accumulator), whereas REE's lever widens a DISCRETE consideration set (top-k) at a single commit step with no within-trial temporal accumulation. The biology's hold helps only because more evidence accrues during the delay and can overturn the leading option; REE's set-widening helps only if a modulatory channel can outweigh F WITHIN the shortlist scoring. Where F still dominates the shortlist (the 654g/625e failures), widening k does not move the argmax -- precisely the gap the divergence predicts.
failure_signatures: Frank's STN hold buys TIME on a within-trial accumulator so that additional evidence can overturn the leading option; REE's E3 commit step has no within-trial temporal accumulation, so substituting top-k set-width for a temporal hold only helps if a non-F channel already outscores F within the shortlist -- where F monopolises the shortlist scoring (654g seed-44 byte-identical, 625e monostrategy) the analog of the hold is inert.

The model's benefit is contingent on there being multiple genuinely-competing cortical responses at near-equal strength; if one score (F) dominates the cortical input itself, the cortico-STN conflict signal is small and the threshold is never raised -- the diversity ceiling re-appears one level upstream, in the conflict signal, not just at the argmax.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical-computation anchor the cluster-autopsy Reading-2 needs: divisive normalization (a neuron's response divided by the summed activity of a normalization pool) recurs across V1 contrast, attention, multisensory integration AND value coding, so a 'renormalize the dominant channel against the field' lever is a documented canonical operation, not an ad hoc REE invention. It is MIXED for MECH-439 because the canonical computation has two properties that BOTH bear on the F-monopoly: (a) it is order-preserving and continuous-global -- which SUPPORTS rank-preserving F-renormalization over a discrete near-ties shortlist (the divisive ratio acts on every channel every step, not only at near-ties); but (b) it is pooled-SYMMETRIC (every unit, including the dominant one, is divided by the SAME field-built denominator) and order-PRESERVING on the numerators -- so canonical normalization, applied faithfully, KEEPS F the argmax. It compresses F's lead, it does not strip F's rank. The diversity lift therefore comes from range-compression-under-downstream-noise, NOT from F losing the commit; and REE's stronger proposed lever ('F removed from the final argmin, used as a graded eligibility envelope only') is rank-ALTERING and goes BEYOND the canonical computation. That asymmetry (pooled-symmetric divisive gain control vs single-score targeted demotion) is the load-bearing finding: the biology grounds a WEAKER, faithful version of Reading-2 (divide the whole score vector by a pooled denominator, keep a stochastic commit) whose efficacy is conditional on a downstream stochastic/temperature selection stage and on the pool composition.
failure_signatures: Canonical divisive normalization is order-preserving on the numerators: if F's drive exceeds every competitor's, F's normalized response still exceeds every competitor's. So pure Carandini-Heeger normalization, applied to REE's E3 score vector, leaves F the deterministic argmax -- it cannot by itself lift committed-action diversity. The lift requires a downstream stochastic/softmax commit whose temperature the (now compressed) F-vs-rest margin can fall below; under a hard deterministic argmax with no temperature, divisive normalization changes nothing.

The canonical computation is pooled-SYMMETRIC -- every option, F included, is divided by the SAME normalization-pool denominator. REE's proposed lever is asymmetric (demote ONLY F). A faithful divisive-norm lever must renormalize the WHOLE score vector, which compresses F's lead AND the modulatory channels' leads proportionally; the modulatory field's relative leverage rises only if the modulatory scores are EXCLUDED from (or down-weighted in) the normalization pool. Which scores enter the denominator is therefore load-bearing design, not a free choice -- get it wrong and normalization uniformly compresses everything without transferring authority to the modulatory field.

REE's stronger 'F out of the argmin / F as eligibility envelope only' operation is rank-ALTERING at the commit level (a non-F criterion picks among F-eligible candidates). That is NOT the canonical divisive computation (which is rank-preserving at every level); it needs separate justification (the quality-diversity / MAP-Elites side already filed for Child 3), and should not be claimed as 'biologically canonical' on the strength of this paper.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This entry grounds the SECOND half of the autopsy diagnosis: not just that F must be renormalized, but WHERE a modulatory channel has to act to gain leverage over a normalized competition. Reynolds & Heeger show a single divisive-normalization circuit reproduces the full range of attentional effects (response-gain vs contrast-gain) depending on the size of the attention field relative to the stimulus, because attention enters by scaling the stimulus drive (numerator) BEFORE the pooled divisive normalization. The REE mapping: MECH-439's modulatory / within-class / rule-bias channels are floor-locked because they act as additive terms ON TOP of a raw dominant F; a control signal only converts to behaviour when it modulates the normalization itself (numerator gain or pool weighting), exactly as attention does here. It is MIXED because (a) it is an attention/sensory model -- transfer to a value selector leans on the canonical-computation generality claim; (b) the model is order-preserving, so attention biases the competition by changing GAIN, not by removing the dominant channel from the output -- reinforcing that the faithful REE lever is gain-on-the-normalization, not the asymmetric 'F out of the argmin'; (c) the response-gain-vs-contrast-gain reconciliation is a feature for REE (one mechanism, regime-dependent) but also a warning that the SAME modulatory input produces opposite effects depending on field/stimulus scale, so REE's modulatory leverage is regime-contingent, not guaranteed.
failure_signatures: Attention biases a normalized competition by scaling gain at the numerator/denominator, NOT by deleting the dominant channel -- the model is order-preserving. This reinforces that a modulatory channel cannot convert to committed diversity by being added on top of a raw dominant F; it must enter the normalization (numerator gain or normalization-pool weighting). REE's additive modulatory channels, which sit on top of an un-normalized F, are in the architecturally wrong place -- the 445h/485h/654g floor-lock signature.

The same attentional input produces response-gain OR contrast-gain depending on the size of the attention field relative to the stimulus. Transferred to REE, the same modulatory channel can have large or near-zero leverage on the committed action depending on the score-distribution regime (how concentrated F is, how many near-ties exist). Modulatory leverage is therefore regime-contingent, not a fixed property -- a tuning surface MECH-448's build must map, not assume.

This is a sensory-attention model; its application to a value/action selector rests on the canonical-computation generality claim (Carandini & Heeger), not on direct value-domain data. The Louie et al value entry carries the same-domain weight; this entry carries the WHERE-modulation-must-act structural argument, and should not be over-read as direct evidence about value-based commitment.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the strongest single bridge in the pull because it moves divisive normalization out of the sensory domain and INTO value-based choice -- exactly REE's E3 selection problem. It shows (in monkey LIP physiology and human choice) that an option's value is coded RELATIVE to the summed value of the competing set (relative value coding = divisive normalization), and that this produces 'classically irrational' context effects: distractor options and the number/value of alternatives measurably shift choice between target options. That directly grounds the autopsy's Reading-2 -- the principled way to stop one value channel monopolising the commit is to divide it by the field, and the lever operates on VALUE signals, not just sensory contrast (a short transfer). It is MIXED rather than supports because the diversity it produces is precisely the range-compression-under-noise mechanism: normalization compresses value differences so a STOCHASTIC choice stage yields more variable commits; it is pooled-symmetric and (deterministically) order-preserving, so it grounds a softmax-style whole-vector F-renormalization-with-stochastic-commit, NOT the asymmetric 'F out of the argmin'. The context effects are also a double-edged warning: pooled normalization can DEGRADE choice accuracy (a high-value distractor lowers the target's normalized value), so the same lever that lifts diversity can corrupt the commit if mis-scoped -- a cost MECH-448's build must bound.
failure_signatures: The committed-diversity lift from divisive normalization is mediated by range-compression under a STOCHASTIC choice stage, not by the dominant option losing rank. In monkey/human data the normalized values stay order-consistent for fixed context; behaviour becomes more variable because the compressed value differences interact with choice noise. If REE's E3 commits deterministically (hard argmax, no temperature), the Louie mechanism does not transfer -- the lever needs a downstream stochastic commit to convert compression into committed-action diversity.

Divisive normalization in value coding is pooled-symmetric: the target's value is divided by the SUMMED value of ALL options. Adding a higher-value distractor REDUCES the target's normalized value and measurably shifts/degrades choice ('classically irrational' context dependence). So a faithful F-renormalization that pools the whole field can lower the effective value of the very candidate REE wants to commit -- the lever can corrupt as well as diversify, and the normalization-pool composition (which scores enter the denominator) decides which.

The paper grounds relative/contextual VALUE coding, not an action-selection circuit that demotes one specific score out of the argmin. REE's stronger 'F as eligibility envelope only' operation is not what is demonstrated here; this entry supports the weaker rank-preserving whole-vector renormalization, and the asymmetric/argmin-removing version still needs its quality-diversity justification.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A well-designed and heavily replicated paradigm (the Horizon task) with a clean experimental manipulation, so source quality is high. Filed mixed rather than supports because it cuts both ways for MECH-440: it establishes that random exploration -- decision noise -- is genuinely modulated by task conditions rather than being a fixed floor, which supports the PREMISE behind leg (ii); but the modulating quantity is an explicitly computed, externally supplied control signal (the horizon), not a property that emerges from the noise generator learning its own scale. Confidence held at 0.72 by mapping distance: humans in a two-armed bandit are several steps from an E3 selection head.
failure_signatures: Random exploration (decision noise) and directed exploration (information seeking) are measured as two separable behavioural signatures within the same subjects and task, which is evidence that 'exploration' is not one quantity even at the level of overt choice.

The quantity that scales random exploration here is the decision horizon -- an explicit, externally imposed feature of the task that the subject computes over. Noise magnitude is set by a control signal from outside the noise mechanism, not by the noise mechanism annealing itself.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High source quality -- a canonical Nature paper combining microstimulation, recording and lesion in the same circuit, which is unusually strong causal evidence for a systems claim. Filed mixed because it supports the existence and real-time gating of a dedicated variability channel while weakening the specific idea that variability magnitude is a self-tuning property of the selection parameters. Confidence 0.75 rather than higher because the entry partly overlaps the existing Olveczky 2011 entry in this directory, and because songbird motor variability is a considerable distance from categorical action selection.
failure_signatures: Lesioning the output nucleus of the basal ganglia-forebrain circuit abolishes the natural modulation of song variability, while song itself is preserved. Variability magnitude is therefore delivered by a separable, lesionable channel rather than being an intrinsic property of the motor-production parameters.

Circuit activity fluctuations correlate with song variability and microstimulation produces specific changes in learned song features, so the same pathway both carries structure and sets variability -- but the variability is gated on a fast, moment-to-moment timescale by circuit state, which is a different timescale from any slow learning-driven decline.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The strongest dissociation evidence in this pull on methodological grounds: a double-blind, placebo-controlled pharmacological study with two active arms targeting different neuromodulators, which is a far higher bar than the correlational or model-fitting dissociations elsewhere in this literature. It is filed weakens because a selective noradrenergic effect on value-free RANDOM exploration, with no corresponding effect on the directed/uncertainty-driven component, is direct evidence that the exploration components MECH-440 bundles into one learned parameter are under separable neuromodulatory control. Confidence is held below 0.9 by the same mapping distance that limits the Wilson entry -- human bandit choice is not an E3 selection head -- not by any weakness in the design.
failure_signatures: Propranolol (noradrenergic antagonist) attenuates value-free random exploration while amisulpride (dopaminergic antagonist) does not, and the directed/novelty component is not attenuated in the same way. Two components of exploration are therefore under separable neuromodulatory control -- a pharmacological dissociation, not merely a modelling one.

This lands specifically on MECH-440's own biological grounding. The claim is justified in claims.yaml by the LC-NE adaptive-gain literature (Aston-Jones and Cohen 2005, Tervo et al. 2014). Here the noradrenergic system is shown to control the value-free RANDOM component specifically -- which supports an LC-NE-gated stochastic floor, but as ONE separable component, not as a single mechanism that also carries state-conditioning and self-annealing.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Filed weakens with good confidence because of what the paper's existence demonstrates rather than how strong its own results are. MECH-440 asserts that NoisyNet-style weight noise is 'state-conditioned by construction'. This paper proposes SANE specifically to add state-conditioning to NoisyNets via a separate auxiliary module -- which is only a contribution if NoisyNets does not already have it. That is a clean architectural argument that does not depend on SANE's benchmark results replicating. Confidence held to 0.78 because it is an arXiv preprint I did not find a peer-reviewed venue for, and because I am resting on the paper's framing of its own contribution rather than on an experiment that measures NoisyNet's state-dependence directly.
failure_signatures: SANE is motivated as improving on NoisyNets 'by allowing a non-uniform perturbation, where the amount of parameter perturbation is conditioned on the state of the agent', implemented through a separate auxiliary perturbation module whose output is state dependent. State-conditioning is thus an ADDED component, not an emergent property of learned weight noise.

The stated motivation is that uniform, non-state-conditioned perturbation causes failures in high-risk states -- i.e. the practical problem NoisyNet leaves unsolved is precisely the one MECH-440 assumes NoisyNet already solves by construction.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The single most decision-relevant paper in this pull, and the only one that directly adjudicates the question MECH-440 was commissioned on. Source quality is very high: millions of trials in a well-controlled rodent forelimb task, with a model comparison that separates the two processes quantitatively rather than asserting them. Mapping fidelity is good but not perfect -- motor variability in a ballistic forelimb movement is not categorical action selection in E3, and the correspondence is functional (what regulates injected variability) rather than structural. Confidence is held below 0.9 by that mapping gap alone, not by any weakness in the source. It is high for a literature entry because the paper's decomposition is exactly the dissociation MECH-440 assumes away, measured directly.
failure_signatures: Motor variability is regulated by TWO distinct processes with different timescales and different inputs, not one. A mechanism that packages state-conditioning and self-annealing as a single learned quantity is asserting a coupling this paper measures apart.

The FAST process is keyed to recent trial OUTCOMES -- variability increases when performance is poor. It is failure-driven, not uncertainty-driven. A design that expects a single noise parameter to both track state and anneal with confidence is asking one quantity to carry two signals that biology delivers separately.

The SLOW process does not itself inject variability -- it tunes the GAIN of the fast process, and it is keyed to uncertainty in the reward landscape. So uncertainty enters at the gain-setting layer, one level above the variability injection, rather than scaling the noise directly.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A basal-ganglia dynamical model in which a double winner-take-all selects exactly ONE action, and learning drives a transition from an exploratory (random-action) phase to a STABLE DIRECTED phase where the agent always picks the single correct action. This is the biologically-faithful behavior of the selection gate -- diversity does NOT survive the commit; it collapses to one winner as the reward gradient strengthens. Directly weakens the reading that a per-niche-elite archive operates AT the committed argmax, and corroborates that F-dominance (MECH-439 winner-take-all collapse) is the gate's correct behavior. Moderate confidence: it is a model, and it weakens the at-argmax framing specifically, not the upstream-archive framing.
failure_signatures: The basal-ganglia selection gate is a winner-take-all that resolves to a SINGLE action and, with learning, collapses from exploratory-random to stable-directed (always one action) -- so committed-action diversity does NOT survive the selection gate; it must be preserved upstream of it.

F-dominance / single-optimum collapse at the commit (REE MECH-439) is the biologically CORRECT behavior of the selection gate, not a pathology to be fixed AT the gate -- which constrains MECH-442 to an upstream / eligible-set-restriction mechanism rather than an at-argmax per-niche store.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Strong, clean lesion dissociation in a well-controlled songbird system: a dedicated basal-ganglia-forebrain circuit (LMAN/AFP) generates and actively regulates behavioral variability SEPARATELY from the motor output pathway. Maps faithfully onto the MECH-442 claim that committed-action diversity is maintained by a structure distinct from the value-maximizing selector. The variability circuit is upstream of / parallel to the premotor output, not an at-the-selection-gate per-niche structure -- so it does not directly evidence a per-niche-elite mechanism AT the committed argmax.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Authoritative review (Annu Rev Neurosci) consolidating human + animal evidence that motor variability is a regulated FEATURE -- purposeful exploration of behavior space that, coupled with reinforcement, drives learning -- not unwanted noise. Maps with high fidelity onto the MECH-442 premise that behavioral diversity must be actively maintained (not a side-effect) to be useful. Caps below 0.8 because it grounds the necessity-and-regulation of diversity, not the specific archive-survives-the-commit-gate mechanism.

The review notes variability is regulated structurally (task-dependent, dimension-specific), which warns that a single uniform behavioral-descriptor may be the wrong granularity.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality cellular recording + lesion study (Cell, Datta/Sabatini) showing the dorsolateral striatum encodes the identity and ordering of a discrete repertoire of sub-second 3D behavioral motifs and is required to assemble them into sequences. Directly evidences a structured behavioral-MODULE repertoire that the basal ganglia selects over -- the closest biological analog to MECH-442's behavioral-descriptor archive. Capped because the result is about sequence COMPOSITION over a module set, not per-niche-elite preservation against a value argmax.
failure_signatures: The striatum encodes module identity/ordering and assembles sequences, but the paper does not show per-niche-elite preservation through a value-maximizing selection -- it evidences a repertoire + selection-over-it, not diversity surviving a strong reward gradient.

Module selection here is facilitated by fast direct/indirect-pathway decorrelation (a competitive gating), consistent with a winner-take-all commit rather than simultaneous multi-niche retention at the output.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Computational/theoretical model formalizing the songbird two-stage architecture: a basal-ganglia tutor circuit (LMAN) injects exploratory variability AND a corrective bias, gradually consolidated into a separate motor (RA) student circuit. failure_signatures: The diversity here is a variability-injection-plus-corrective-bias mechanism (explore then consolidate), not a per-niche-elite archive that survives selection -- so it supports the generator/selector separation, not the specific MAP-Elites structure.

Mismatches between the tutor (variability) signal and the student plasticity rule impair learning -- a warning that an REE diversity-injection coupled to the committed selector must be matched to the downstream learning rule or it degrades performance.

Direct recordings, clean revaluation design.

The dissociation between behaviour (toward restricted outcome) and replay (away from it) means a REE priority signal read off the action-value of the committed policy would point the wrong way.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A mechanistic CA3 model showing reverse replay, which occurs preferentially at REWARDED locations, selectively strengthens the goal-directed (forward) synaptic pathway -- i.e. reward-anchored replay GATES which downstream pathway is updated. This is the closest biological analog to 'replay gates which experiences update downstream representations', the core of MECH-443. recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Direct rodent place-cell recordings showing reward/motivational relevance gates which sequences are pre-played -- preplay occurred for the rewarded but not the unrewarded unexplored arm. Reward here is a binary present/absent contrast, not a graded magnitude, so it supports prioritization-by-relevance but does not establish the shape of the priority function.

This paper's context-routing is implemented in a RECURRENT E/I network whose disinhibitory dynamics settle to context-appropriate states -- consistent with 'context-dependent selection resolves through recurrent inhibitory dynamics, not a one-shot readout.' But the paper does not isolate or test a settling STEP as such, does not compare against a one-shot readout, and the recurrence is cortical sensory-context, not MECH-450's BG thalamocortical settling. Held to 0.48: the paper is congenial to the premise but does not directly evidence the specific settling-vs-argmin substitution.
failure_signatures: The functional solution is carried by recurrent inhibitory dynamics; a one-shot feedforward readout would not reproduce the context-dependent re-routing. This is indirect support for MECH-450's claim that a single-pass argmin is the wrong primitive, but the paper does not run the head-to-head settling-vs-one-shot comparison MECH-450 needs.

Disinhibition modulates RECURRENT excitation (per the Keller 2020 cortical circuit this line builds on); a settling implementation that treats lateral inhibition as a static subtraction rather than a dynamic recurrent term may miss the mechanism, and this paper does not adjudicate the dynamical form.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: High source quality (primate single-unit, top venue) but only moderate mapping fidelity: it measures neural representation of decision variables, not separate LEARNABILITY of channels nor any action-conversion benefit. Net supports the no-single-scalar premise while documenting a shared/categorical bottleneck.
failure_signatures: The integrated subjective-value population was relatively few in number; most frontal neurons instead encoded categorical decision-type (delay- vs effort-based), so a learner exposed to finer channels might discover category gating rather than value-channel mixing.
Specialization was incomplete (ACC carried both cost types), so the putative channels are not cleanly orthogonal.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical evidence that hedonic 'liking' is a separately-instantiated channel doubly dissociable from motivational 'wanting'/dopaminergic vigour. But predominantly rodent pharmacology/lesion synthesis establishing NEUROCHEMICAL dissociation, silent on separate learnability and on improves-conversion; substantial abstraction to map a hedonic hotspot onto a gating-layer channel.
failure_signatures: 'Liking' is shown to be hard to move (dopamine and most manipulations fail to enhance it; it lives in small fragile opioid/GABA hotspots) -- so a liking channel may be low-variance / weakly action-coupled, exactly the profile a gating learner would down-weight to zero, reproducing rather than relieving a conversion ceiling.
The components normally co-occur and interact; clean separability is a laboratory dissociation, not the default operating regime.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Best available match to 'separately-learnable': human MVPA shows OFC carries outcome-identity-specific, independently-updatable representations dissociable from general scalar value (vmPFC). But it is correlational fMRI and the finer channel still routes through a vmPFC value bottleneck to influence choice.
failure_signatures: The OFC identity channel had to route through vmPFC general-value coding to influence choice (connectivity-predicted choice change), mildly supporting a funnel into a common value bottleneck -- the conversion-ceiling architecture MECH-451 worries about.
Correlational fMRI: connectivity PREDICTS choice change, it does not show that exposing a finer channel CAUSES better conversion of control influence into committed action.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical normative RL theory establishing vigour as a separable control quantity (tonic DA / opportunity cost) distinct from phasic action-selection -- conceptually close to REE's substrate. But it is a model, not a measurement of separable learnable channels, and is silent on the improves-conversion question; it also argues one scalar suffices for vigour.
failure_signatures: The model collapses vigour into a single global scalar (average reward rate), so it actually supports COMPRESSION at the vigour level -- one scalar is normatively optimal, in mild tension with MECH-451 expecting vigour to need fine sub-channels.
Vigour-as-opportunity-cost is a global quantity, not state-specific, so it does not by itself support different control functions mattering in different states.

MECH-454.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=5 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.797

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A comprehensive review consolidating the empowerment formalism (channel capacity between actions and future sensor states) and surveying its behavioral consequences across sensorimotor configurations. It strengthens the same COMPONENT the Klyubin 2005 entry anchors -- reachable-option preservation as a principled, task-independent objective -- and adds breadth (showing the same formalism yields option-preserving behavior across many embodiments, and noting empowerment's proposed use as a safety/keeping-options-open heuristic). It does NOT introduce uncertainty-gating, and it remains a maximization objective rather than a conditional cost. Confidence is mapping-fidelity-weighted and set slightly below the Klyubin origin entry to avoid double-counting two empowerment sources that anchor the same half of the claim.
failure_signatures: The review surveys empowerment as an always-on maximization objective and a 'keep options open' safety heuristic, but nowhere conditions option-preservation on forecast uncertainty -- so it cannot discriminate MECH-454's confident-forecast case (where foreclosure should be cheap) from the uncertain-forecast case (where it should be costly). The uncertainty-gate that distinguishes MECH-454 from generic option-preservation is not present.

Empowerment-as-safety-heuristic (keeping the world controllable) is framed around the agent's broad influence over its environment, which can over-generalize into resisting any irreversible change -- the same pathological over-preservation pole MECH-454 warns about when the cost is un-gated.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the foundational paper introducing empowerment -- the channel capacity between an agent's actions and its later sensory states -- as a task-independent intrinsic objective. It is the closest direct formal anchor for the OPTION-PRESERVATION half of MECH-454: an empowerment-maximizing agent prefers states from which more distinct future sensor states are reachable, i.e. it avoids cheaply foreclosing its own reachable-option space. It supports the COMPONENT (reachable-option preservation as a quantifiable objective an agent can score) but maps only weakly onto MECH-454's full claim, because empowerment is a continuous maximization objective over future controllability, NOT a discrete COST term inside an ethics-engine action-selector, and -- critically -- it carries no uncertainty-gating: empowerment does not become more or less weighted as a function of how confident the agent's forecast is. Confidence is set by mapping_fidelity (architectural claim): the reachability-preservation idea transfers cleanly, the cost-term framing and the uncertainty-gating do not.
failure_signatures: Empowerment is maximized everywhere, unconditionally; it provides no mechanism by which option-preservation should be weighted MORE under an uncertain forecast and not at all under a confident one. MECH-454's defining uncertainty-gating is absent, so an agent built on empowerment alone would over-preserve options even when a confident forecast justifies irreversible commitment (the 'pathological option-preservation / chronic indecision' failure pole).

Empowerment is a standalone drive, not a residual cost integrated alongside harm/benefit/goal terms in a single trajectory score; an empowerment maximizer can trade away task reward for raw controllability, which is the opposite failure (refusing necessary irreversible action) from the one MECH-454 is surfaced by (premature irreversible commitment).

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the precise anchor for MECH-454's UNCERTAINTY-GATING half -- the piece empowerment and relative-reachability lack. Arrow & Fisher prove that when an action is irreversible AND the future is uncertain AND that uncertainty can be resolved by waiting, there is a positive 'quasi-option value' to preserving options, and -- decisively for MECH-454 -- this premium VANISHES when there is no uncertainty (under certainty, the irreversibility imposes no extra preservation premium). That is exactly MECH-454's gate: preserve reachable options MORE when the foreclosing forecast is uncertain, and NOT AT ALL when it is confident. Confidence is mapping-fidelity-weighted; held below the cost-anchor because this is an economics formalism about value-of-information over time, a domain transfer into an ethics-engine action-selector, and it supplies the GATE but not the reachable-option representation.
failure_signatures: Quasi-option value is positive only when the uncertainty is RESOLVABLE by waiting (information actually arrives). If the agent's forecast uncertainty is irreducible -- no learning is possible before commitment -- the quasi-option-value justification for option-preservation collapses; MECH-454's gate must therefore be conditioned on resolvable forecast uncertainty, not uncertainty per se, or it will over-defer.

The result is an expected-value optimization under a known probability model; it does not by itself tell you how to estimate the forecast uncertainty an E3 selector would gate on. Mis-estimated uncertainty (over- or under-confident PE) would mis-set the gate -- the 'collapsing an unknown future distribution into a confident point' failure MECH-454 was surfaced by.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical real-options text: it shows that the value of waiting before an irreversible commitment RISES with both irreversibility AND uncertainty, and that exercising an irreversible option 'kills' the option value of waiting -- an opportunity cost that must be charged against the commitment. This reinforces, with the most-cited treatment of the principle, MECH-454's uncertainty-gating: the cost of foreclosing reachable options should scale with forecast uncertainty. It anchors the SAME (gating) half as Arrow & Fisher 1974, so it is weighted to add robustness, not an independent component. Held below the Arrow-Fisher entry to avoid double-counting the gate; the reachable-option REPRESENTATION half is still absent.
failure_signatures: Real-options waiting-value is positive only when deferral is feasible and informative; if the agent cannot defer or no information will arrive, the option-value-of-waiting argument does not license preserving options, and an E3 cost built naively on it would over-defer (the chronic-indecision pole).

The framework optimizes expected value under an assumed stochastic process (e.g. geometric Brownian motion) with a known volatility; it presumes the uncertainty is correctly quantified. An E3 gate that mis-estimates forecast uncertainty would mis-price the foreclosure cost, the same point-collapse failure that surfaced MECH-454.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the strongest single anchor for MECH-454's foreclosure-as-COST framing: it operationalizes a PENALTY for reducing the set of reachable states relative to a baseline, added to the agent's objective -- structurally the same move MECH-454 proposes for E3 (a residual cost term for foreclosing reachable-option space). It maps better than empowerment onto the cost framing AND onto INV-026's reachable-state-space language, and the paper explicitly engineers the penalty to avoid pathological over-preservation (the same failure pole MECH-454 names). It still lacks MECH-454's uncertainty-gating: the reachability penalty is not scaled by the agent's forecast confidence. Confidence is the highest in this pull because the cost-term mapping_fidelity is high; it is held below 0.8 by the missing gate and by the AI-safety-gridworld to ethics-engine transfer.
failure_signatures: The reachability penalty is applied unconditionally against a fixed (inaction) baseline; it is not modulated by how uncertain the agent's forecast is. So it cannot implement MECH-454's confident-vs-uncertain distinction -- it would penalize a confidently-justified irreversible action and an unjustified one identically, the 'deranged gating' (cost present but not uncertainty-scaled) failure mode.

The paper documents that naive reachability/side-effect penalties create a perverse incentive to PREVENT any irreversible change, including other agents' actions; this is the over-preservation pole, and MECH-454 must avoid re-importing it. The authors' stepwise-relative-reachability fix mitigates but does not remove the tension, and the SELF-scoped REE version would need its own guard.

Reachability is computed over an explicit, enumerable state space with a defined baseline; an E3 self-foreclosure cost over high-dimensional latent reachable futures has no such clean baseline, so the operationalization does not transfer turnkey.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-replicated demonstration that a perceived object is a persisting FILE that is actively re-linked and updated across time, motion, and occlusion -- not a fixed one-shot binding. This grounds MECH-456's core premise ('binding is maintained-not-intrinsic'). Held below 0.7 because object-file reviewing establishes the UPDATABILITY / maintained-correspondence half of the claim strongly but speaks only obliquely to the SWITCHING half (a competitor world-configuration overtaking and forcing a re-bind); and because it is a 1992 visual-attention psychophysics result whose transfer to a latent self<->world-config binder is analogical, not measured.
failure_signatures: Object-file reviewing shows correspondence is maintained and updated across a gap, but the paradigm does not force a competitor to OVERTAKE the current file -- it is largely evidence for continuity, the opposite pole from rebinding, so it under-tests the switch trigger MECH-456 asserts.

The 'object' is an attended visual token over a brief display (hundreds of ms); MECH-456's bound thing is a self-anchored world-configuration in a trained latent architecture. Equating the two is a formal import, not a measured equivalence.
No prediction-error / competitor-support variable is manipulated; the mechanism that decides WHEN to keep vs re-link the file is not isolated here.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A computational + model-based-fMRI account in which endogenous perceptual switches are DRIVEN by prediction errors accruing from residual evidence for the currently-suppressed interpretation, outperforming classic adaptation/noise models and localising the PE signal to frontal cortex. This is the closest mechanistic analogue of MECH-456's asserted trigger: the competitor overtakes when the current configuration accrues prediction error. The predictive-coding framing is also architecturally congenial to REE. Held below 0.8 because bistable perception switches between two fixed interpretations of a CONSTANT ambiguous stimulus with no ground-truth winner, whereas MECH-456 requires an exogenous ground-truth overtake -- the trigger transfers cleanly, the 'which is correct' semantics do not.
failure_signatures: Bistable perception has no ground-truth correct percept -- switching is endogenous and either interpretation is 'right'. MECH-456's rebinding must track a TRUE competitor that genuinely becomes better-supported by the environment; the paper's mechanism explains switching-on-PE but not tracking-the-true-winner (that is DV1 of the functional test, un-addressed here).
The PE signal was localised to inferior frontal gyri / anterior insula via model-based fMRI regressors -- correlational, and in a perceptual-report task, not a self<->world-config binding.
Model comparison favoured predictive coding over adaptation+noise, but bistable dynamics are notoriously fit by multiple models; the win is evidential, not decisive.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A rigorous meta-analysis establishing that perception is systematically biased toward the recent past (serial dependence), tuned by time, space, feature-similarity, and attention. For MECH-456 this is genuinely two-directional: it is strong evidence for the STABILITY COUNTERWEIGHT that a rebinding mechanism must overcome, and therefore for the DESIGN choice of a threshold (rebind only when a competitor decisively overtakes, not on every fluctuation) rather than free chatter. But on its own face serial dependence is a persistence/hysteresis phenomenon -- the force OPPOSING rebinding -- so it does not directly support that rebinding occurs, only that if it does it must clear a hysteresis band. Marked mixed for that reason.
failure_signatures: Serial dependence is, at face value, evidence for perceptual STICKINESS -- the opposite of rebinding. A skeptic could read it as showing the system resists switching, i.e. as pressure AGAINST MECH-456's re-bind-on-overtake dynamic rather than for it.

The phenomenon is characterised on low-level continuous features (orientation, numerosity, face identity) in human psychophysics, not on discrete self<->world-configuration bindings; the 'threshold/hysteresis' transfer is a design analogy, not a measured property of any binder.
Meta-analysis of many small-N studies with heterogeneous paradigms; individual differences are large, so the magnitude of the hysteresis a binder should emulate is not pinned down.

failure_signatures: The options framework is silent on option DISCOVERY; its speedups are shown with hand-specified options, so it does not by itself close a floor->competent gap without a source of good options.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical biological evidence that the brain propagates reward backward along a just-experienced trajectory via reverse replay -- the exact operation a novelty bonus lacks and the archetype of REE's existing backward_credit_sweep. Grounds the credit-assignment lever; indirect (observational, not an RL benchmark).
failure_signatures: A per-step novelty bonus has no mechanism to propagate a terminal reward backward along the trajectory that earned it; reverse replay is that missing operation.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Biological instantiation of the options-framework primitives (learned start/stop bracketing = initiation/termination of a chunked sequence). Grounds temporal abstraction as a real learned mechanism the brain uses to consolidate practised behaviour; neuroscience, not an RL benchmark.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the closest thing found to INDEPENDENT support for MECH-459's specific mechanism, and its independence is what gives it value: unlike DreamerV3 it was not the source the claim was authored from, and it targets the exact operator MECH-459 indicts -- per-batch advantage standardisation -- rather than return normalisation one level up. It reports that normalised advantage is harmful DESPITE its near-ubiquity in advantage actor-critic methods, and names two mechanisms, both of which map onto REE: division by a small standard deviation causing gradient spikes when advantages are small early in training, and per-mini-batch variance in the estimation of the normalisation parameters. The first is MECH-459's noise re-amplification form almost verbatim. Confidence is capped at 0.62 by source status and by a residual extraction limitation: this is an unreviewed preprint, and the fetched text confirmed the qualitative claims and mechanisms but did not yield verbatim effect sizes or the benchmark table, so the MAGNITUDE of the reported harm is not independently verified here. The direction is well supported; the size is not.
failure_signatures: Dividing advantages by a per-batch standard deviation produces disproportionately large gradient updates when that standard deviation is small, which is precisely the early-training and low-reward-variance regime.
Normalisation parameters estimated per mini-batch are themselves noisy estimates, so the normaliser injects estimator variance into the policy gradient in addition to whatever it removes.
A widely-adopted default operator can be harmful without being noticed, because it is inherited as boilerplate rather than ablated.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the deliberate counterweight in the pull and the most decision-relevant entry for calibrating what a probe-K result will mean. It is the only paper found that directly tests whether DreamerV3's normalisation machinery TRANSFERS to a different algorithm, which is exactly the inferential step MECH-459 makes when it imports Hafner's prescription into REE's model-free raw-view actor-critic. The finding is explicitly negative on the general question -- the tricks 'do not transfer as general improvements to PPO' across more than 10,000 compute-hours of experiments -- while positive on a narrower one: PPO with the tricks performs comparably to PPO WITH reward clipping and significantly outperforms PPO WITHOUT reward clipping. Peer-reviewed at a top venue with a large compute budget, so source quality is high and the null is well-powered rather than an underpowered miss. Confidence 0.71 reflects solid quality and clear relevance, discounted because the paper tests DreamerV3's normaliser as a BUNDLE on dense-reward Atari, so it cannot isolate the specific sparse-reward, near-zero-return regime in which MECH-459 locates REE's pathology.
failure_signatures: Normalisation machinery that is load-bearing in one algorithm can fail to produce any general improvement when transplanted into another, even at very large compute budgets.
The measured benefit of DreamerV3-style normalisation in PPO was substitutive rather than additive -- it recovered what reward clipping already provided rather than adding gains on top of it.
Evaluating a bundle of tricks jointly cannot attribute effect to any single component, so a bundle-level null does not license a component-level null.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: This is the source MECH-459 explicitly cites, and the three prescriptions the claim attributes to it are confirmed verbatim: the one-sided denominator max(1, Per95 - Per5) that scales large returns down and never scales small returns up; the explicit rejection of running-statistics normalisation as injecting non-stationarity; and discrete/twohot regression for the critic motivated by bimodal return distributions under sparse reward. High source quality (flagship model-based RL result, now peer-reviewed in Nature, very broad domain sweep). Confidence is held below 0.85 for a mapping reason, not a quality one: DreamerV3's normaliser sits on RETURNS inside an imagination-based actor-critic over a learned world model, whereas MECH-459's target is a per-episode ADVANTAGE standardiser in a model-free raw-view actor-critic. The design rationale transfers cleanly; the quantitative claim that removing it moves REE's foraging floor does not follow from this paper and is exactly what the sanctioned knock-out probe must decide. Confirmatory-citation risk is real here (the claim was authored from this paper), so this entry should not be treated as independent corroboration.
failure_signatures: A two-sided normaliser whose denominator has no floor divides out magnitude information by construction, so any experimental axis that acts purely through reward or advantage MAGNITUDE cannot move the resulting policy gradient -- eliminations along such axes are confounded rather than informative.
Under a bimodal sparse-return distribution a scalar MSE critic converges toward the mean of the two modes, a value never actually observed, producing systematically miscalibrated advantages.
Normalising targets by running statistics makes the optimisation non-stationary because the target moves whenever the normaliser moves.

Canonical, heavily replicated theoretical synthesis (high source quality) whose central construct -- a single scalar gain term that cannot by itself specify WHICH option is chosen, only how sharply the choice is drawn -- is structurally the same object MECH-463 names. Discounted for mapping: AGT's gain is the slope of a sigmoid on unit activation, not a softmax temperature over K candidate scores, and AGT asserts the scalar DOES produce a behavioural regime change (exploration), which is in tension with the argmax-invariance half of MECH-463.
failure_signatures: Adaptive gain theory attributes a genuine behavioural mode switch (exploit -> explore) to a scalar with no per-candidate structure, which -- if true as stated -- would mean a global scalar CAN change realised behaviour and not merely its sharpness. MECH-463 must therefore locate the differentiation in the sampling step, not in the score geometry, or it is under-specified.

The theory is silent on the covariance between the scalar channel and the per-candidate channel, which is exactly the quantity MECH-463's variance decomposition needs; AGT cannot arbitrate F-share vs arousal on its own.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Well-executed human pupillometry showing that baseline pupil diameter -- an indirect index of the global arousal scalar -- predicts exploratory vs exploitative choice both within and between individuals. Cuts against MECH-463's strong reading (a scalar that tracks realised behavioural differentiation) while being fully compatible with its weak reading (the scalar changes sampling sharpness, not score ordering). Held at 0.5 because the design is correlational and pupil is a doubly-indirect proxy for the quantity MECH-463 names.
failure_signatures: Baseline arousal predicted WHICH choice class was made (exploratory vs exploitative), not merely how sharply it was made. Taken at face value that is behavioural differentiation attributable to a global scalar, which is what MECH-463 says a uniform scalar cannot deliver -- unless the differentiation is entirely in the sampling draw rather than the score ordering.

The same correlation is produced by the reverse causal arrangement: a control state that changes both the choice and the arousal level, with the scalar as consequence rather than cause. Correlational pupillometry cannot exclude this, so the entry cannot be treated as a causal counterexample.

Directly contradicts the causal null of the same group's reboxetine study (Jepma et al. 2010) in apparent direction; the correlational and causal literatures on this exact question do not agree, which is itself a reason to distrust either as a governance input.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: A double-blind placebo-controlled causal manipulation (N=52) that raised tonic NE pharmacologically and found NO change in task disengagement or exploratory behaviour, despite confirmed drug action on central and autonomic markers. This is the cleanest available causal test of 'does a global scalar, moved on its own, change behavioural strategy?' and the answer was no -- which is what MECH-463 predicts of a channel that cannot re-rank candidates. Held below 0.7 because it is a null result with the usual power caveats, and because absence of a strategy shift is consistent with several mechanisms besides argmax invariance.
failure_signatures: Raising the global scalar in isolation produced no behavioural differentiation at all -- not a weaker version of the predicted effect, but no effect -- while the drug demonstrably reached the CNS. A scalar channel can therefore be pharmacologically live and behaviourally inert simultaneously, which is the failure mode MECH-463 predicts and MECH-359 also predicts.

The authors note the manipulation may not test exploration that exceeds the current task context; a scalar could still act on task-set switching while being inert within a task. MECH-463's argmax-invariance argument is scoped to within-decision candidate sets and inherits exactly this boundary.

This null cannot discriminate MECH-463 (scalar entrenches the incumbent) from MECH-359 (scalar is too weak to steer) -- both predict the observed absence of differentiation. The discriminating measurement is the commit gate, which this paradigm does not instrument.

MECH-466.confidence_rationale: exp=1 entry(s), lit=2 entry(s), exp_conf=0.242, lit_conf=0.686

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Included primarily as a CONTROL-DESIGN template rather than for its neuroscience: it is the cleanest worked example in this pull of discriminating genuine cross-timescale organisation from structure trivially implied by the components' own rates. The lag gradient across networks appeared consistently across eight distinct stories and was ABSENT both at rest and under a scrambled-story stimulus -- a control that preserves low-level input statistics and destroys only the nested event structure. That is structurally the discriminator Q-081's Outcome A vs B needs and the alignment statistic MECH-466 needs. Held at 0.61 by GOV-ANALOGY-1, by the haemodynamic confound on any lag measure in fMRI, and because cross-stream lag is a weaker notion of shared organisation than homologous transition motifs.
failure_signatures: The lag gradient was absent for scrambled stories and at rest. A cross-stream statistic that survives destruction of the system's event structure was measuring the input or the wiring, not the organisation -- so REE's run must include the analogous structure-destroying arm, not only a shuffle surrogate.

Inter-subject cross-correlation isolates stimulus-driven coupling by correlating ACROSS subjects, removing within-subject noise-driven correlation. REE has no across-subject axis; the nearest analogue is across-seed, and using it changes what is being estimated (shared across seeds is not the same as shared within a run).

Lags were on the scale of several seconds in a haemodynamically filtered signal; regional HRF differences alone can produce apparent lags. Any lag-based cross-stream statistic needs a control for rate-induced apparent lag -- in REE, the fact that E3 updates every 10 steps guarantees an apparent lag relative to E1 with no shared organisation whatever.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: The best available external test of MECH-466's premise -- that event boundaries function as shared temporal landmarks across processes running at different characteristic timescales -- and it reports the PARTIAL sharing that MECH-466 and INV-091 jointly predict rather than the total sharing that would be uninteresting or the absence that would refute. 85% of searchlight pairs share boundaries above chance while nesting is explicitly imperfect, which is the band shape INV-091 asserts. Held at 0.58 because the transfer is brain-to-REE (GOV-ANALOGY-1), because it never compares event-locked against clock-locked alignment -- MECH-466's actual falsifier -- and because the boundaries are detected by the analyst's algorithm rather than broadcast by the system, which is the reverse of REE's situation.
failure_signatures: Nesting was imperfect: relative boundary overlap between regions fell short of its theoretical maximum of 1.0. Regions at different timescales genuinely disagree about where boundaries are -- so a REE analysis that requires all streams to agree on a boundary set would fail on a system behaving exactly like this one.

State durations spanned 4.5 s in sensory cortex to 27.2 s in prefrontal cortex -- roughly a factor of six, comparable to REE's 1:10 E1:E3 ratio. Boundary sharing therefore has to be assessed across unequal timescales, and a fixed tolerance window would bias toward the fast streams.

The authors state it is 'not yet clear what a distinct neural state might represent' in transmodal regions -- the states are statistically robust but semantically opaque, so recurrence of states is not by itself evidence that anything functional is being shared.

MECH-467.confidence_rationale: exp=0 entry(s), lit=3 entry(s), exp_conf=0, lit_conf=0.782

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Goal neglect is defined as ignoring a task requirement while remaining able to describe it -- which is MECH-467's leg 3 (behavioural capture with the rule intact) as an established, replicated human phenomenon with a fifty-year literature and a tight relationship to psychometric g. That makes the dissociability the claim asserts a documented fact rather than a conjecture, which is the strongest thing literature can do for a claim of this shape. Held below 0.8 because Duncan's own mechanistic account complicates rather than confirms MECH-467's three-way carve-up: he attributes neglect to task-model components being LOST under representational competition, which is closer to rule corruption than to the rule-survives-but-action-is-captured reading MECH-467 gives leg 3.
failure_signatures: MECH-467's PASS criterion is rule drift at floor while wrong-target selection is elevated. Duncan's account predicts this exact pattern can arise from plain rule corruption whenever the drift measure reads a STORED or reportable rule rather than the representation actually driving selection -- neglect is defined by the gap between describable and operative. So a battery that instruments rule state at a storage site rather than at the point of action selection cannot distinguish leg 2 from leg 3, and a PASS would be uninterpretable.

Neglect is driven by the complexity of the task model, and increasing the real-time demands of one component does NOT promote neglect of another. A distractor battery that manipulates moment-to-moment perceptual load while holding the rule set small may therefore fail to elicit behavioural capture at all, and return a floor result that is a property of the design rather than of the substrate.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: About as close as the human literature gets to a direct measurement of MECH-467's leg 3. Participants hold an intact, reportable task set -- find the target shape, ignore the salient distractor -- and their FIRST EYE MOVEMENT still goes to the distractor on a substantial fraction of trials. Overt action selection is captured while the rule is intact, which is the failure rule-state protection cannot catch. The paradigm does not observe that -- capture occurs while the task set is intact and even introspectively monitored -- but it never independently measures task-set integrity per trial, so it constrains the alternative rather than eliminating it.

Awareness of having been captured did not prevent subsequent capture. Any REE mechanism that proposes to close leg 3 by DETECTING wrong-target selection and feeding that back into rule maintenance is predicted by this result to be insufficient: the detection signal exists in humans and does not fix the behaviour.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Supports MECH-467's separation of sensory capture from downstream failure modes -- capture is not obligatory, and a salient distractor can be suppressed BEFORE it captures -- with converging psychophysics, eye-tracking and ERP evidence. The guard can therefore discard a battery in which the distractor WAS registered and the substrate handled it correctly -- a false substrate_not_ready, and the most expensive kind of error because it looks like a clean self-route.

Suppression efficacy varies with task demands and with lapses of cognitive control. A battery reporting a single aggregate sensory-capture rate across a block will average over trials where the distractor was suppressed and trials where it captured, and may report a mid-range value that describes no trial that actually occurred.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily replicated demonstration in ARTIFICIAL learners -- the correct machine class for REE -- that an ungated competence update destroys unrelated prior competence, and that a per-parameter importance gate largely prevents it. The remedy is explicitly a GATE: learning is selectively slowed on the weights important for prior tasks. Without such a gate, a single successful update propagates across the whole parameter set -- MECH-471's named failure mode, stated in machine terms.

EWC provides bounding WITHOUT provenance or rollback: the Fisher-weighted penalty records only that a parameter matters, not which experience made it matter, and offers no operation to revert a specific update. A system can therefore satisfy the bounding property and still fail the other two.

The formulation's quadratic-penalty derivation was subsequently challenged in a PNAS comment (Huszar, 10.1073/pnas.1717042115) arguing the multiple-penalty scheme is not the correct Bayesian recursion -- the discipline is real but this particular instantiation is not settled.

Optical shrinkage of the potentiated spines DISRUPTED the acquired motor learning, establishing that the competence is causally carried by an identifiable, addressable subset of the substrate rather than being merely correlated with it.

The disruption is SPECIFIC: the identical manipulation applied to spines evoked by a distinct motor task in the same cortical region did NOT affect the first learning. Absent that specificity, any rollback operation would itself be a catastrophic-interference event.
Synaptic remodelling was confined to a small subset of neurons, i.e. a single learning episode's write is naturally narrow -- which is the property an ungated competence-update rule would forfeit.

Mapping fidelity is discounted because the setting is supervised image classification with i.i.d. train/test SAMPLES, not an agent generalising across CONTEXTS; MECH-472's held-out CONTEXT notion is stronger than a held-out sample split, so the paper supports the principle but not the specific held-out-context construct.

High source_quality (canonical, widely replicated benchmark from a strong group) and high mapping_fidelity (RL agent, held-out CONTEXT, not merely held-out samples); the only discount is that CoinRun measures generalization at test time rather than gating a PROMOTION-to-durable decision, which is REE's specific framing.

The reversal was shown on continuous-control gym benchmarks with dense reward; REE's regime is sparse-ish foraging with a critic that is flat on the policy's own state distribution, so the magnitude of achievable reversal is not licensed by this paper.

Its benchmarks are dense-reward continuous control where a well-fit state-value baseline is achievable; it says nothing about regimes (like REE's) where the critic is flat ON THE POLICY'S OWN STATE DISTRIBUTION, which is a harder failure than a merely imperfect fit.

A build that computes both arms' reliability with one shared estimator departs from the fitted model.

Arbitration acts by SUPPRESSING the model-free valuation pathway, with no reciprocal effect detected on the model-based pathway. A symmetric gain-sharing arbitrator is not what the connectivity data support.
A bias term favouring habit (lower cognitive effort) is required in the fitted transition dynamics; an unbiased arbitrator over-recruits the model-based arm.

recent_entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical review by the lab that defined reality filtering; the phenomenon (preconscious OFC/reward tagging of whether an evoked memory pertains to now and can be acted on; failure -> confabulation) is exactly the provenance-guard requirement MECH-487 must satisfy. Confidence held below 0.8 because it maps the GUARD requirement, not a retention BUFFER, and the mapping is human-clinical to computational.
