Review-level synthesis of the canonical mechanism MECH-333 invokes: maturation of parvalbumin inhibitory interneurons (gated by Otx2 transfer and perineuronal-net assembly) triggers critical-period onset, and the same machinery controls closure. Supports the inhibitory-maturation-opens-the-window premise but is a review (not primary data), so confidence is held below the empirical entries.
failure_signatures: Critical-period onset is triggered specifically by parvalbumin-interneuron maturation and perineuronal-net consolidation; before that maturation the window does not open. A REE plasticity window keyed to a diversity/inhibitory element predicts no plasticity until that element reaches a threshold maturity -- a falsifiable timing prediction.

Perineuronal nets that consolidate around mature PV cells act to CLOSE the window and stabilize the circuit; disrupting them can reopen plasticity. The same structure that opens the window later enforces winner-take-all stabilization -- consistent with MECH-333's 'before winner-take-all capture' framing but implying the closing mechanism is an active brake, not mere decay.

entries.confidence_rationale: Supports the existence and tunability of a time-bounded plasticity window (MECH-333's core), but WEAKENS the specific E/I-balance-centric mechanism MECH-333 invokes: the authors show silent-synapse (glutamatergic) maturation governs critical-period duration largely INDEPENDENT of inhibitory tone. Included deliberately as the disconfirming-mechanism counterpoint.
failure_signatures: Ocular-dominance plasticity here was 'largely independent of the inhibitory tone' -- contradicting the strong reading of MECH-333 that the window is opened/closed by E/I balance and GABA maturation specifically. A REE implementation that pins the plasticity window solely to an inhibition/diversity-weight knob may be mechanistically incomplete.

Loss of PSD-95 reinstated silent synapses and REOPENED juvenile-like plasticity after normal closure -- the window's closure is reversible and tied to a postsynaptic glutamatergic maturation marker, not an irreversible E/I set-point.

entries.confidence_rationale: Causal genetic dissociation: VGAT-null transplanted interneurons migrate and mature normally but FAIL to induce a critical period, while control interneurons do. Directly supports MECH-333's premise that GABAergic (inhibitory) maturation is the trigger that OPENS a time-bounded plasticity window. Mapping fidelity moderate -- biology evidences the opening mechanism, less so REE's specific 'suppress dominant scoring pathway update magnitude' phrasing.
failure_signatures: Transplanted interneurons unable to load GABA into vesicles integrate into the host circuit but do NOT open a plasticity window -- the opening of the window is gated specifically on GABAergic transmission, not merely on the presence of inhibitory cells. The REE analog: simply adding a diversity/inhibitory element is insufficient; it must be functionally transmitting to gate the window open.

Timing of the induced plasticity is dictated by the maturation state of the transplanted GABAergic cells -- the window is yoked to a developmental clock of the inhibitory element, supporting MECH-333's 'time-bounded' framing.

entries.confidence_rationale: Causal lesion + electrical-perturbation evidence (J Neurosci) that a dedicated basal-ganglia pathway is the source of the behavioral variation that downstream selection acts on. Maps onto MECH-341's structural argument (a diversity-generating circuit must hold parity with the deterministic pathway) but at the motor-output / proposal stage rather than strictly at a value-scoring step, so mapping fidelity is moderate.
failure_signatures: Lesions of Area X (song-specific basal ganglia) permanently eliminate rapid within-syllable fundamental-frequency variation; without that variation, reinforcement-driven song learning loses its substrate. The REE analog: if the diversity circuit is ablated or down-weighted, the candidate pool collapses to a single deterministic class and there is nothing for E3 scoring to discriminate among.

Earlier Area X lesion studies found NO lasting effect on several measures of vocal variability -- the diversity contribution is specific to a particular variability channel (rapid within-syllable FF) and is easy to miss with the wrong readout. Cautions that measuring 'candidate diversity' at the wrong granularity can falsely conclude the diversity circuit is inert.

entries.confidence_rationale: Single-unit LMAN recordings show the diversity signal is a state-gated variable -- the same neurons switch between precise single-spiking (low variability) and variable bursting (high variability) with social context, while the average song-locked signal is preserved. Directly evidences MECH-341's 'signal weight amplified to competitive parity' as a real, rapidly tunable knob. Indirect on the scoring locus; lower mapping fidelity.
failure_signatures: When the diversity channel is in its low-variability (directed-song) state, LMAN fires precise single spikes locked to song and trial-to-trial variability is minimal -- behaviour is near-deterministic. If a REE diversity circuit is left in a low-weight state, the candidate pool will not be carved into distinct classes at selection.

Different LMAN neurons in the same bird show distinct firing patterns, suggesting subsets jointly encode song features -- a single scalar 'exploration temperature' would under-describe the diversity signal, which is distributed and structured.

entries.confidence_rationale: Single-unit recordings in RA plus pharmacological inactivation of LMAN show the basal-ganglia-forebrain pathway adds variability to a developing motor program, and that its relative contribution wanes as the circuit matures. Strong mechanistic support for a dedicated diversity channel held in balance against a precision channel; the developmental decline also bridges to the MECH-333 plasticity-window framing. Mapping fidelity moderate (proposal-stage variability vs MECH-341 scoring-stage diversity).
failure_signatures: Pharmacological inactivation of LMAN during singing makes RA firing adultlike in its stereotypy -- the variability channel can be switched off, and when it is, the motor program is deterministic. The REE analog: if the diversity-circuit signal weight is driven to zero, the selected trajectory class is fixed regardless of latent proposal diversity.

Removing HVC (the premotor/precision input) abolishes stereotypy entirely -- diversity and precision are carried by SEPARATE inputs whose balance sets the variability of the output. A single combined pathway cannot reproduce the controllable diversity-vs-precision trade-off.

Definitive optogenetic + electrophysiological + tracing study establishing the CeA -> ventrolateral PAG inhibitory pathway that produces freezing by disinhibition of vlPAG excitatory outputs to medullary premotor targets, plus the interaction of this freezing pathway with circuits mediating flight. This is the direct biological substrate for MECH-279 (PAG-analog freeze gate driven by amygdala input). High confidence (0.80): Nature, gold-standard causal methods, conserved circuit. The caveat that keeps it below 0.85 is that the paper is about defensive RESPONSE SELECTION (freeze vs flight execution), and only indirectly about avoidance LEARNING -- the topic this review was commissioned for.
failure_signatures: If freezing and flight were produced by a single undifferentiated defensive output rather than dissociable CeA->vlPAG and flight-mediating circuits, MECH-279's design as a distinct PAG freeze gate (separate from active escape) would be unsupported.

The PAG circuit described here is an OUTPUT selector for innate/conditioned defensive responses; it does not by itself acquire avoidance. If REE wires MECH-279 (freeze gate) as the avoidance-LEARNING driver without an instrumental-action and reaction-suppression layer, the substrate will produce defensive freezing but still fail to LEARN to avoid -- precisely the 603g G_H 0/3 signature.

entries.confidence_rationale: Directly diagnostic for the 603g failure shape and the most decision-relevant entry in this review. It establishes that signaled active avoidance is a TWO-component problem -- Pavlovian freezing reactions and instrumental avoidance actions are mutually exclusive competing responses -- and that learning to avoid REQUIRES infralimbic prefrontal cortex to inhibit central-amygdala-driven freezing. Marked MIXED (not supports): it supports wiring the amygdala as an avoidance-learning driver, but it simultaneously shows the current REE substrate (SD-035 salience + MECH-279 freeze gate, with NO prefrontal reaction-suppression / instrumental-competition layer) would reproduce the un-trainable avoidance signature. Confidence 0.78: strong primary causal lesion study with clean statistics, conserved circuit; mixed direction reflects that the most important content is a missing-mechanism warning.

entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical review (Sullivan group) establishing that mammalian hazard-avoidance learning is NOT present at birth but emerges gradually across postnatal development, gated by amygdala maturation (~PN10) and modulated by parental buffering of the HPA/corticosterone axis. Strong, mechanistically detailed rodent study with a developmental-window dissociation (P0 inflammation permanently sensitizes adult pain; P14 inflammation does not). It cuts two ways for ARC-046: it confirms the failure mode ARC-046 is designed to prevent is real (unprotected early harm produces permanent, catastrophic sensitization -- 'residue saturation' that survives into adulthood), and it confirms a developmental WINDOW exists (supporting progressive removal of protection). But it also pressures the optimistic half of ARC-046 -- the assumption that early harm exposure can be reliably educative-without-damage -- by showing that timing alone determines whether identical insults are benign or permanently damaging. Hence mixed.
failure_signatures: Early (P0) nociceptive insult produces lasting adult hyperalgesia + central sensitization (Fos up-regulation in dorsal horn) -- i.e. harm exposure WITHOUT protection causes exactly the catastrophic residue saturation ARC-046 posits.
The benign-vs-damaging outcome depends entirely on developmental timing (P0 damages, P14 does not), so an infant-protection mechanism that mis-times the protection window would fail.
If REE's residue_scale_factor attenuation were applied uniformly rather than within a critical window, it would not match the window-specific biology this paper documents.

entries.confidence_rationale: Authoritative review (Levine-lineage) of the stress hyporesponsive period (SHRP), a well-replicated developmental window in which the neonatal HPA corticosterone stress response is actively attenuated while sensory and learning systems function normally. This is a near-direct biological precedent for ARC-046's core architectural commitment: harm/stress signals fire but their damaging downstream accumulation (corticosterone <-> residue) is held low during infancy, with caregiver presence providing 'imperfect protection'. Confidence held below 0.8 because the mapping is by analogy (HPA glucocorticoid load vs REE residue field is a translation, not an identity) and the evidence is predominantly rodent.
failure_signatures: If the SHRP were shown to also blunt the sensory/learning response to threat (not just the glucocorticoid load), it would weaken ARC-046's requirement that z_harm_s/z_harm_a fire normally while only residue accumulation is attenuated.
If maternal buffering were shown to be all-or-none rather than graded/partial, it would undercut the INV-043 'imperfect protection' framing ARC-046 invokes.
If attenuated infant stress reactivity were purely passive immaturity rather than an actively regulated adaptive set-point, the 'designed protection mechanism' reading would be weaker.

entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical, peer-reviewed (ICML 2020) precedent for exactly SD-055's design move: replacing CEM's non-differentiable top-k / argsort elite-selection step with a temperature-controlled soft aggregate so gradients flow back through candidate selection to upstream parameters, and applying it to continuous control / planning. SD-055's softmax-weighted candidate mean (with temperature T) is a specific instance of DCEM's smooth top-k. High confidence: the mapping is structural and direct, the venue is strong, and the method is exactly the one SD-055 implements. Held below 0.9 because DCEM uses a more general smooth top-k (LML projection) whereas SD-055 uses the simplest softmax-mean special case, so DCEM validates the family but not the specific tightness of SD-055's approximation.
failure_signatures: If the soft-selection gradient were shown to be too biased/high-variance to improve learning over the non-differentiable baseline, it would weaken SD-055's premise that restoring gradient to cue_action_proj is beneficial.

DCEM still relies on the objective being meaningfully differentiable w.r.t. the candidates; if SD-055's score->action_bias path through E2 rollouts has near-zero usable gradient, the differentiable selection would restore a path that carries no signal.
DCEM reports the soft relaxation helps in some control settings but is not uniformly better than vanilla CEM; a null or negative result in REE would be consistent with that variance.

entries.confidence_rationale: Directly relevant methods paper that situates SD-055's design choice within the wider differentiable-selection literature and exposes its main weakness. It supports the general premise (the discontinuous top-k/argsort selection blocks backprop and admits differentiable relaxations), but it argues that DENSE relaxations -- the softmax-weighted family SD-055 uses -- lack sparsity and therefore approximate true top-k elite selection less faithfully than the sparse operators it introduces. Mixed: it validates SD-055's direction while implying the specific softmax-mean is the loosest, least elite-preserving option. Confidence 0.68 -- strong venue and on-point, but the critique is indirect (it does not test SD-055 itself, and sparsity's benefit in REE's small-candidate CEM is unestablished).
failure_signatures: A dense softmax-weighted mean over all candidates can wash out the elite signal, so SD-055's aggregate may track the candidate-set centroid rather than the best trajectory -- weakening the 'gradient reaches cue_action_proj usefully' premise if the centroid gradient is uninformative.
If sparsity is required to preserve top-k semantics (as this paper argues), SD-055's non-sparse relaxation would be a biased surrogate for the argsort elite-mean it replaces.
The paper's advantage is demonstrated on large-scale selection (MoE routing, ViT, pruning); its relevance to REE's small candidate pool is unproven, so the critique may not bite at REE's scale.

entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical, founding empirical source for the construct MECH-045 names verbatim ('object-file-like buffers'). It directly demonstrates the three properties the claim requires -- a per-object stable buffer, integration of information across TIME, and (critically) identity maintained across MOTION via shared relative position in a moving frame rather than via the object's features. The object-specific preview benefit is a token-instance signature (this object, not this type). Confidence high (0.82) for mapping fidelity -- this IS the construct -- but capped below 0.9 because it is human psychophysics, not a substrate/algorithm, so it grounds the FUNCTION REE must reproduce without prescribing the mechanism.
failure_signatures: The object-specific preview benefit can be carried by LOCATION continuity rather than by a label-free identity token (cf. Mitroff & Alvarez 2007, 'integration by location'); if REE's data-association KEY collapses to 'nearest cell last tick' it would reproduce the benefit vacuously without true cross-motion re-identification -- the precise non-vacuity hazard the experiment precondition must rule out.

Object files in this paradigm reset / fail to update when motion is too fast or the object is fully occluded for too long; a REE buffer that never drops a token would over-bind and lose the falsifiable signature.

entries.confidence_rationale: Object-trace cells are the closest neural correlate of the PERSISTENCE half of MECH-045: LEC neurons that fire at the location where an object USED TO BE after it is removed. That firing-in-the-object's-absence is the single-unit signature of an entity buffer that outlives perceptual contact -- precisely 'minimal entity persistence across time'. Combined with LEC's role as the 'what/content' stream (vs MEC 'where'), it grounds the identity-content side that object-vector cells (MEC) do not. Confidence 0.72: a clean, on-point persistence signature, discounted because trace cells code a remembered object-PLACE (still partly location-bound) rather than a label-free token followed through motion, and because it is rodent single-unit data.
failure_signatures: Object-trace cells encode where an object WAS (object-place memory), so persistence here is still partly anchored to a remembered LOCATION; a REE buffer that only remembers last-seen position would reproduce trace-cell firing without re-identifying the object once it has MOVED -- the exact cross-motion gap that separates persistence-through-absence from token tracking.

Only a small subset of LEC cells show the trace property; the signal is sparse and the mechanism by which experience-history is written is not resolved -- so the paper licenses 'a persistence buffer exists' but not its update rule.

LEC object firing reflects higher-order experience history, not pure stimulus drive; disentangling genuine identity persistence from slow sensory adaptation requires the kind of ablation/shuffle control the REE experiment must build in.

entries.confidence_rationale: Object-vector cells are the strongest single-unit evidence that the mammalian brain has a dedicated, object-anchored coding scheme that GENERALISES across distinct objects irrespective of their location -- a real neural substrate for object-relative representation, supporting the premise that entities are a first-class representational primitive (ARC-006). But the mapping to MECH-045's TOKEN-INSTANCE buffer is only partial and partly adverse: object-vector cells code a vectorial RELATION (distance + direction) to objects and are tuned 'equally to a spectrum of discrete objects', i.e. they are object-GENERIC and allocentric, NOT a per-token identity store that re-identifies THIS object across motion. Mixed, 0.66: confirms the brain reserves machinery for objects, but the specific cell type is closer to the ANCHOR/where axis (SD-039 lineage) than to the token KEY MECH-045 needs.
failure_signatures: Object-vector cells are tuned EQUALLY across discrete objects irrespective of identity -- they encode 'an object is HERE relative to me', not 'this is object #7 again'. Modelling MECH-045's token KEY on object-vector coding would yield a where-signal with no instance identity, reproducing the ANCHOR-keyed gap (SD-039) rather than closing the token gap.

The code is vectorial/allocentric (egocentric distance + allocentric direction to a confined object); REE's z_world is not an explicit spatial-vector code, so the substrate analogy is structural, not mechanistic -- the same 'structural-analogy-no-mechanism' failure mode flagged for the 641a coherence diagnostic.
Rodent foraging in open fields with discrete physical objects; no demonstration that a single object's IDENTITY is tracked through occlusion or relabelled after it moves.

entries.confidence_rationale: Pylyshyn's FINST / visual-index theory supplies the part of MECH-045's specification that the object-file literature leaves implicit: the KEY. A visual index individuates and tracks ~4-5 objects 'preconceptually' -- without encoding their identities or any conceptual label -- which is the cleanest available statement of MECH-045's 'WITHOUT symbolic/type labels'. The multiple-object-tracking paradigm it spawned is the direct behavioural test of tracking-through-motion. Confidence 0.78: high theoretical mapping fidelity, discounted because it is a framework + paradigm rather than a single decisive experiment, and because the index is a pure pointer (no feature buffer) -- it grounds the KEY but not the per-token feature store.
failure_signatures: Visual indexes carry NO feature content -- they are bare pointers. A REE buffer modelled too literally on FINSTs would track identity but store nothing to bind, defeating the 'per-token feature buffer' half of MECH-045; the design must add the feature store the index theory deliberately omits.

The ~4-5 index capacity limit is a hard cap; MOT studies show tracking collapses when objects coincide/occlude or move too fast. A REE buffer with unbounded tokens would not reproduce the human capacity signature and would have no principled token-eviction policy.

Pylyshyn argues indexing is bottom-up and stimulus-driven, partly DIVORCED from attention; this is in mild tension with ARC-006/MECH-045's 'attention-gated' commitment, so the attention coupling REE proposes is an addition, not a borrowing.

entries.confidence_rationale: DeepSORT is the engineering blueprint for MECH-045's token KEY: it maintains per-object tracks across time and occlusion by DATA ASSOCIATION combining a motion gate (Kalman/Mahalanobis spatiotemporal continuity) with an appearance embedding, assigning persistent track ids with NO category label. This is exactly REE's proposal -- spatiotemporal-continuity data-association over z_world features -- with z_world standing in for the appearance descriptor. It supplies the concrete update rule (predict -> gate -> match -> birth/death) the biological sources leave unspecified, and the identity-switch metric is the natural quantitative readout for the experiment. Confidence 0.7: high mechanistic mapping fidelity, discounted because it is engineering (not evidence the brain does this), relies on a SUPERVISED person-reID appearance metric REE does not have, and assumes a detector REE lacks.
failure_signatures: DeepSORT's appearance metric is a SUPERVISED descriptor pre-trained on a large person-reID dataset; REE has no labelled identity data and must use unsupervised z_world. If z_world is not discriminative enough (the dim=32 ceiling), the appearance term degenerates and association falls back to motion-only -- which is the location-collapse vacuity mode in disguise.

It assumes an external object DETECTOR proposing bounding boxes each frame; REE has no detector, so the 'what counts as a trackable entity this tick' step (figure-ground / candidate proposal) is an unsolved upstream dependency the buffer cannot assume away.

Pure tracking-by-detection has no notion of value, attention-gating, or precision-weighting; it associates everything uniformly. MECH-045's attention-gated, precision-weighted continuity is an ADDITION to the DeepSORT recipe, not part of it.

Causal rodent behavioral-tagging study: exposure to a NOVEL context around encoding converts an otherwise-decaying weak memory into a persistent one, and this is causally dopamine/VTA-dependent (VTA NMDA stimulation mimics novelty; VTA muscimol inhibition abolishes both the persistence and the hippocampal dopamine rise). Provides the CELLULAR/causal substrate for a novelty-gated write and confirms the dopaminergic conjunction at synaptic level. Held to 0.6 for the operationalisation verdict: it demonstrates that NOVELTY (an external contextual event) gates persistence, but does not arbitrate novelty-vs-PE nor address the goal/value-anchor specificity -- it is mechanistic grounding, not adjudication. | 2026-06-24 tag-join: DEV-NEED-006 (the developmental WRITE-gate sub-need of MECH-189 -- high-salience benefit contact written to a durable super-ordinal goal anchor) added to claim_ids_tested. This paper evidences that WRITE gate as faithfully as it does MECH-189; the addition joins existing prior art to the DEV-NEED-006 experiment tag (v3_exq_588e) and clears a false novel_discovery quadrant flag that arose only because the experiment was tagged to the gate id while the literature was tagged to the parent claim.
failure_signatures: Persistence of a weak memory required a dopaminergic novelty/salience event around encoding (behavioral tagging and capture); a write gate lacking any such modulatory-event term would let load-bearing-but-weak contacts decay -- the INV-075 self-extinguishing-signal failure mode.
VTA inhibition abolished both the novelty-induced persistence and the hippocampal dopamine increase, confirming the write gate is dopaminergically mediated and not a passive similarity computation.

entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily-cited mechanistic review that directly establishes a novelty-gated write into long-term memory -- the exact function of the MECH-189 WRITE gate. Strongly supports the existence of gate (b) as a real biological control point. Counts as 'mixed' rather than 'supports' for the operationalisation question because the biology it describes diverges from the self-contained novelty-vs-anchors proxy in two ways: (i) the novelty signal is a hippocampal comparator mismatch against the FULL long-term store, not against a small goal-anchor subset; (ii) VTA firing (and hence the dopaminergic plasticity gate) is an explicit CONJUNCTION of novelty WITH salience and goal information, so complexity and salience are not orthogonal channels. | 2026-06-24 tag-join: DEV-NEED-006 (the developmental WRITE-gate sub-need of MECH-189 -- high-salience benefit contact written to a durable super-ordinal goal anchor) added to claim_ids_tested. This paper evidences that WRITE gate as faithfully as it does MECH-189; the addition joins existing prior art to the DEV-NEED-006 experiment tag (v3_exq_588e) and clears a false novel_discovery quadrant flag that arose only because the experiment was tagged to the gate id while the literature was tagged to the parent claim.
failure_signatures: If the write gate measures novelty only against the goal-anchor set (super_ordinal_complexity_mode='novelty'), it computes mismatch against the wrong reference: the biological comparator detects information 'not already stored in long-term memory', i.e. mismatch against the whole stored model.

Treating salience (gate a) and complexity/novelty (gate b) as independent multiplicands departs from the biology, where the same VTA dopaminergic signal integrates novelty, salience, and goal information into a single gate.

Corbetta's account of infant reaching is the closest verifiable analogue to MECH-329's mechanism. She describes goal-directed reaching as originating, around 3-5 months, from a CASUAL CONTINGENT EVENT -- 'when the hand happens to contact a target' -- which 'provides new behavioral value', 'reinforces the motor action, and intrinsically motivates infants to attempt to reproduce the behavior.' This is structurally MECH-329's seeding story: an ACCIDENTAL contact, not a calibrated preference, is the originating event, and an intrinsic approach/motivation signal -- not a mature hedonic evaluation -- is what latches onto it and drives repetition. It places the seeding earlier than the 9-month third-person milestone in Behne 2005 and grounds the 'accidental benefit contact under approach drive' language directly. Confidence 0.58: it is a conceptual/review synthesis of the motor-development literature rather than a single decisive experiment, and 'intrinsic motivation' is not identical to mesolimbic incentive salience -- so it supports the accidental-contact-plus-approach-drive structure strongly while leaving the specific neuromodulatory identity open.
failure_signatures: Corbetta's 'intrinsic motivation' is a behavioural/motor-development construct, not specifically mesolimbic-dopamine incentive salience. Reading it as MECH-329's 'wanting' imports a neuromodulatory identification the paper does not make. If the infant motor-exploration drive is not dopaminergic incentive salience (cf. Opendak et al. 2025, who argue mesolimbic DA is not yet functional perinatally), MECH-329's specifically-mesolimbic framing is over-committed even though the accidental-contact-plus-approach-drive STRUCTURE survives.

The paper is a review/conceptual synthesis, not a controlled test of ordering. It does not directly measure that motivated reaching precedes calibrated preference; it asserts a developmental sequence consistent with that ordering. Treated as decisive evidence rather than as a well-grounded framework, it would overstate the case.

entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical, verifiable replacement for the unverifiable 'Keren-Portnoy & Tomasello 2021' anchor MECH-329 originally cited. Behne, Carpenter, Call & Tomasello tested infants at 6, 9, 12 and 18 months and found that from 9 months onward infants reacted with differential impatience (reaching, looking away) when an adult was UNWILLING versus merely UNABLE to give a toy -- 6-month-olds showed no such differentiation. The authors conclude infants 'first begin to understand goal-directed action at around 9 months of age.' This grounds the developmental-ordering half of MECH-329 indirectly but solidly: a proto-intentional, goal/desire-attributing capacity is operational in the first year, well before the slow, repeated-exposure calibration of a mature hedonic preference function. Confidence 0.6, not higher, because the paper concerns infants' reading of OTHERS' intentional action (third-person goal attribution), not first-person approach-drive seeding of the infant's own goals, and it says nothing directly about wanting-vs-liking neural ordering. It establishes that goal-directed/intentional structure is early, which is the temporal premise MECH-329 needs; it does not by itself establish the mesolimbic-wanting-first mechanism.
failure_signatures: The paper measures third-person goal attribution (how infants interpret an adult's intentional action), not the first-person approach-drive that MECH-329 says seeds z_goal anchors. Using it as the ordering anchor imports a mapping step: early goal-directed COMPETENCE is taken as a proxy for early approach-MOTIVATION operability. If the two dissociate developmentally, this anchor would be weaker than it looks.

Goal-directed action understanding emerging 'around 9 months' is a first-year milestone but is not the perinatal/Phase-0 window MECH-329's 'earliest accidental benefit contacts' language implies. If MECH-329's seeding is meant to begin at birth, this anchor places the verifiable onset later than the claim's strongest wording.

entries.confidence_rationale: This developmental reward-circuit review both supports and stresses MECH-329. SUPPORTS: it argues the reward system must be understood through developmental TRANSITIONS, with age-specific circuitry that supports reward learning early -- i.e. functional reward/approach behaviour is operational in infancy before the mature adult circuit is in place, consistent with MECH-329's 'wanting operational early, calibrated evaluation lags' framing. STRESSES (the important half): it directly complicates MECH-329's specifically-MESOLIMBIC-DOPAMINE framing for early infancy. The authors note dopaminergic projections 'exhibit late functional maturation' and are 'likely not functional in supporting learning in the perinatal infant', when reward learning instead relies on locus-coeruleus NOREPINEPHRINE flooding the olfactory bulb. They warn that 'behavioral similarity does not imply circuit continuity' across development. So the ORDERING half of MECH-329 (approach/reward before calibrated hedonic evaluation) is supported, but the MECHANISTIC attribution to mesolimbic dopamine in the earliest window is weakened -- the earliest 'wanting' may be NE-driven, with mesolimbic DA arriving later. Confidence 0.55: high-quality multi-author review, high mapping relevance, but mixed direction and a rodent-perinatal-to-REE transfer step.
failure_signatures: Mesolimbic dopaminergic projections 'exhibit late functional maturation' and are 'likely not functional in supporting learning in the perinatal infant' -- early reward learning relies on locus-coeruleus norepinephrine, not mesolimbic dopamine. MECH-329's literal mechanism ('mesolimbic dopamine wanting seeds the FIRST anchors') is therefore over-specified for the earliest window: the first approach/seeding signal may be a different neuromodulator, with mesolimbic DA coming online later.

'Behavioral similarity does not imply circuit continuity' -- infant approach/appetitive behaviour can look adult-like while being driven by different circuitry. Inferring an adult-style mesolimbic-wanting mechanism from early goal-directed BEHAVIOUR (as the Behne and Corbetta entries do) is exactly the inference this review cautions against.

The strongest mechanistic ontogeny data here are rodent (olfactory-bulb NE, perinatal odor conditioning). Mapping the rodent perinatal reward-learning circuit onto the human-infant 'wanting' MECH-329 invokes both a species and a developmental-window transfer.

failure_signatures: CGRP -> CeA is shown to carry interoceptive (taste-aversion/malaise) signals AND, in the companion literature, exteroceptive innate threat -- so a single shared CGRP channel may argue against a fully dissociable interoceptive z_harm input, weakening the separability half of MECH-282.
Demonstrated for taste-aversion / visceral malaise; hypoxia and hypoglycemia (also named in MECH-282) are not directly tested in this study.

entries.confidence_rationale: A cell-type-aware review that explicitly deconstructs parabrachial-to-extended-amygdala signalling into interoceptive and exteroceptive components, arguing PBN -> CeA modulates innate response to physical stimuli while PBN -> BNST modulates unpredictable distress. This is the most direct literature support for MECH-282's architectural framing of the PBN as a relay that segregates alarming interoceptive vs exteroceptive stimuli before handing them to the extended amygdala. Confidence moderate because it is a synthesis/hypothesis review, not primary data, and its interoceptive/exteroceptive split is drawn along a CeA-vs-BNST axis rather than the within-z_harm separability axis MECH-282 specifies.
failure_signatures: The review's interoceptive/exteroceptive dissociation is mapped onto PBN -> CeA (physical/innate) vs PBN -> BNST (unpredictable distress), and it notes the two circuits are partly intertwined and reciprocal -- so the segregation MECH-282 wants is real but leakier and routed differently than the claim's CeA-centric statement implies.
As a review it inherits the rodent-dominant primary literature and provides no new causal test of an interoceptive z_harm channel separable from external-threat z_harm.

entries.confidence_rationale: This is the canonical statement of the sleep-wake flip-flop switch (VLPO mutually inhibitory with ascending arousal nuclei) and of orexin as the stabilizer that biases the switch toward wakefulness and prevents unwanted transitions, with homeostatic, circadian, AND emotional inputs explicitly named as drivers. It is the direct biological referent MECH-286 invokes by name (Saper/Scammell flip-flop). Confidence high for grounding the architecture but capped because it is a conceptual review and does not test REE's specific override_signal formulation or the V_s-residual-staleness recruitment logic.
failure_signatures: The flip-flop switch stabilized by orexin is a wake-stability mechanism; MECH-286 additionally asserts that the SAME override_signal gates sleep ONSET and recruits a replay-priority readout -- the recruitment/replay-consumption half is not addressed by this review.

Emotional and homeostatic inputs are named as bias signals but not formalized as a single scalar override of the kind SD-037 supplies; the mapping from REE's override_signal to these distributed biological inputs is an abstraction.

entries.confidence_rationale: Human polysomnography evidence (n=63) that hypocretin deficiency predicts a significantly higher frequency of sleep-wake transitions and of transitions to/from REM, with the authors explicitly positioning narcolepsy as a human model of the sleep-wake and REM flip-flop switches. This is the strongest non-rodent, quantitative confirmation that the orexin gate MECH-286 invokes actually controls state-transition stability in humans. Confidence moderate because it demonstrates loss-of-gate destabilization, not the positive override-gates-onset-and-recruits-replay mechanism MECH-286 asserts.
failure_signatures: Demonstrates that removing orexin destabilizes transitions (loss-of-function); it does not show that an override signal positively gates onset timing or recruits a replay-priority readout -- the constructive half of MECH-286 is inferred, not measured.

Cataplexy and hypocretin deficiency dissociate (cataplexy predicts wake transitions; deficiency predicts REM transitions), suggesting the 'gate' is at least two-dimensional rather than the single override scalar MECH-286 models.

entries.confidence_rationale: Directly supports the metabolic-demand arm of MECH-286: orexin neurons stabilize the sleep-wake switch WHILE driving both wakefulness and foraging for food, integrating sleep with feeding and energy state. This is the biological basis for MECH-286's claim that override (sustained drive under metabolic demand) suppresses sleep onset. Confidence moderate because it is a short conceptual review and the feeding/metabolic coupling is framed as wake-promotion for foraging rather than as a formal gate on offline-mode entry with replay recruitment.
failure_signatures: Orexin's metabolic coupling here promotes wakefulness/foraging under negative energy balance; MECH-286 instead emphasizes high metabolic *demand* (with drive+threat) suppressing sleep onset -- compatible in direction but the review's emphasis is foraging-drive wake-promotion, not threat-gated onset suppression.
As a brief review it provides no causal dissociation isolating a metabolic-demand override on sleep onset from the general orexin wake-drive.

Directly addresses the CRF's open lit question: persistent delay firing waxes and wanes with current task relevance and is often absent while the memory is demonstrably retained, so working memory must be held in a latent ('activity-silent') substrate -- short-term changes in synaptic connectivity -- and read out by probing input. This is the strongest single source for the autopsy's fork B and for the claim that crf_frac_active ('active fraction every tick') is the wrong persistence readout. Supports ARC-063's maintenance requirement while redefining how maintenance should be measured. Review (not primary data) -> source_quality capped below the empirical anchors.
failure_signatures: If a memory can be retained while its neurons are silent (no persistent firing), then a readiness metric that counts only ticks on which a rule is actively firing (crf_frac_active) will report a maintained rule as absent. The metric conflates 'currently being read out' with 'currently maintained'.

Activity-silent maintenance is read out by probing (the context recurs and reactivates the latent trace); a rule that is silently maintained but whose context has not recurred is invisible to any activity-based readout even though it is fully available.

entries.confidence_rationale: The explicit adjudication of the fork. Lundqvist, Herman & Miller argue the standard 'persistent spiking' picture is largely an artifact of averaging spikes across time and trials; single-trial activity occurs in sparse transient gamma bursts, and information is carried BETWEEN spikes by short-term synaptic plasticity ('impressions left in the network'). Delay activity is a WM mechanism, but it is sparse, not persistent. Resolves the autopsy's A-vs-B fork toward B (with sparse bursty reactivation), and underwrites both CRF prescriptions: activity-decoupled maintenance + a non-per-tick-firing readout.
failure_signatures: Trial-and-time-averaged firing creates an ILLUSION of continuous persistent activity that disappears on single trials (sparse bursts). A maintenance readout built on smoothed/aggregate activity (or on per-tick active fraction) inherits this artifact and misreads sparse-but-maintained as either continuous or absent.

If information is carried between spikes by synaptic 'impressions', then any activity-based availability accounting necessarily under-counts maintained-but-silent rules -- exactly the crf_frac_active 0.016 collapse in the differentiated regime.

entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, replicated single-unit demonstration that dorsolateral PFC neurons hold a selective representation across an input-absent delay by sustained firing -- the existence proof for the rule/task-set-cell maintenance class ARC-063 instantiates. High source quality. Marked supports (not fork-deciding) because it establishes that maintenance of the CURRENTLY-RELEVANT item is carried by persistent delay activity; it does NOT speak to holding several differentiated, currently-unselected rules at once, which is the CRF's actual bottleneck. mapping_fidelity is moderate: the CRF needs a maintained POOL, this paper shows one engaged memorandum.
failure_signatures: Persistent delay-period firing is demonstrated for the single item currently held in memory (one cued location per trial); the paradigm does not require, and does not show, simultaneous sustained maintenance of multiple distinct task rules. Read literally it licenses sustained activity only for the engaged/selected rule, not for an available-but-unmatched pool.

Memory fields are spatially tuned and the delay activity is for an item that was just cued and will imminently be acted on -- i.e. the attended/selected item -- so it cannot be cited as evidence that an UNSELECTED rule must keep firing across long context-absent gaps.

entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical recurrent-attractor ('bump attractor') mechanistic model of how persistent delay activity is sustained: strong recurrent excitation (NMDA-dominated) balanced by inhibition holds a self-sustaining activity bump with no external input. Strongly supports fork A as a MECHANISM for maintaining the engaged item. Marked mixed for ARC-063 because the same model exposes fork A's ceiling for the CRF's problem: an attractor network holds ONE bump (a few items at most), is metabolically expensive (tonic high-rate firing), and is prone to drift/interference -- it does not scale to silently holding a differentiated POOL of 10-16 sparsely-matching rules, which is exactly the CRF regime in V3-EXQ-666 ARM_2.
failure_signatures: A continuous-attractor (bump) network sustains a single localized activity packet; capacity is small and adding more simultaneously-active memoranda causes bumps to merge or compete. It cannot maintain a large pool of distinct currently-unselected rules by persistent firing.

Persistent-firing maintenance is metabolically costly (all maintained items fire tonically at elevated rates for the whole delay) and the bump drifts over time and is disrupted by distractors -- arguing against per-tick sustained firing as the maintenance substrate for an availability POOL that must persist across thousands of ticks.

entries.confidence_rationale: The decisive mechanistic model for fork B and the most directly IMPLEMENTABLE answer for the CRF. Working memory is maintained by calcium-mediated short-term synaptic FACILITATION on recurrent connections: a memory leaves a synaptic trace that persists for ~1 s WITHOUT any spiking, can be refreshed by sparse activity at a low rate, and is read out when input arrives. Gives the CRF a concrete maintenance primitive: a non-firing, slowly-decaying, sparsely-refreshable availability trace decoupled from per-tick activity. Supports ARC-063's maintenance need and supplies the exact mechanism. Slightly below ceiling because it is a model, and the biological time constant (~1 s) is far shorter than the CRF's thousands-of-ticks horizon -- the principle transfers, the constant does not.
failure_signatures: Facilitation-based maintenance has a finite decay time constant (calcium kinetics, ~1 s); a trace not refreshed within that window is lost. A pure synaptic-trace CRF availability with too-fast decay reproduces the 666 collapse; the maintenance horizon must be set deliberately, not inherited from the biological constant.

The synaptic trace is capacity- and interference-limited: many overlapping memories compete for the same synaptic resources. A differentiated CRF pool is the favourable case (distinct, pinned directions -> low interference), but the model warns that maintenance is not free and unbounded.

entries.confidence_rationale: Authoritative primate-electrophysiology defence of the persistent-firing (pole A) account, co-authored by the Goldman-Rakic/Arnsten lineage. High source quality. It SUPPORTS the existence of a maintained prefrontal rule/cue representation across the delay (the ARC-063 rule-cell class is real) but it argues AGAINST the activity-silent / synaptic-only reading that the V3-EXQ-666 autopsy leans toward -- hence 'mixed' relative to the substrate fork. Mapping fidelity is moderate: their object is delay-period spike rate to a remembered cue, not availability of a sparsely-matched differentiated rule, which is the regime where even they concede single cells are not continuously active.
failure_signatures: If the CRF abandons any sustained-availability term and relies purely on a fast synaptic trace, this camp's data (selective delay-period elevation of firing in PFC rule/cue cells) is the evidence it would be ignoring -- a pure activity-silent fix risks under-modelling the genuine sustained component.

Their critique that synaptic-plasticity-only and rhythmic-only models are 'inconsistent with the neurophysiological data' is a caution against a CRF fix that maintains rules ONLY between matches with no above-threshold readout ever -- the truth is a hybrid, not either pole exclusively.

entries.confidence_rationale: The most direct bridge from the hunger-drive circuit to the SEEDING-of-learning function MECH-306 is about. Berrios et al. confirm three AgRP regulation timescales (rapid cue, slow nutrient, slowest energy-balance) and show that disrupting the rapid cue-driven inhibition specifically impairs LEARNING of a food-acquisition task (but not a water task), proposing the cue-driven drive reduction increases incentive salience of food cues and thereby facilitates learning. This is the closest biological analogue to 'drive state at contact seeds goal-relevant learning'. Nature, causal circuit dissection; discounted because the operative variable is the rapid (not sustained) component, sitting in mild tension with MECH-306's emphasis on the sustained trace.
failure_signatures: The learning deficit is produced by disrupting the RAPID cue-driven inhibition, not by removing a sustained drive trace -- which suggests the fast component, far from being merely a collapse to be worked around, may itself be the teaching signal that seeds goal learning. This complicates MECH-306's framing that the instantaneous signal is the problem and the sustained trace is the solution.
The incentive-salience interpretation is proposed, not directly measured; the paper shows a learning deficit and infers the salience mechanism.

entries.confidence_rationale: Directly establishes the two-timescale decomposition MECH-306 leans on: a rapid, transient sensory-driven inhibition of AgRP at food cues PLUS a slower, sustained, calorie-proportional inhibition driven by post-ingestive nutrients. The existence of a separable slow/sustained component is exactly the biological substrate that makes 'slow-trace the drive' a principled choice rather than an arbitrary fix. High-quality photometry + gut-signal manipulations; discounted because the paper frames these as inhibitory components of satiation, so the mapping to a positive sustained DRIVE requires sign-inversion reasoning.
failure_signatures: The sustained component the paper identifies is a calorie-dependent INHIBITION (satiation), the mirror image of sustained hunger drive; reading it as evidence for a sustained drive trace requires assuming the hunger axis is the negative of the satiation axis on the same slow timescale, which the paper does not test.

The rapid sensory inhibition is shown to be trainable in a single trial by nutritive value -- meaning the fast component is itself plastic; a REE drive model with a fixed fast-collapse term would mis-model the learned anticipatory inhibition.

entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical theoretical anchor for the 'wanting' construct MECH-306 instantiates. Berridge's central claim -- that incentive salience ('wanting') is computed by integrating Pavlovian associative cue information WITH the animal's current physiological/drive state -- is exactly the multiplicative drive x benefit_exposure structure MECH-306 uses for effective_benefit. High mapping fidelity to the principle; confidence held below the empirical AgRP papers because it is a review/theory and the drive-state modulation is argued across studies rather than isolated in one experiment.
failure_signatures: Incentive salience in Berridge's framework is dynamically RE-COMPUTED at the moment of cue encounter by combining cue memory with current physiological state -- this is a multiplicative gate, not an additive or threshold-crossing one; if MECH-306 implements seeding as a hard threshold on a summed quantity it may mis-model the graded, state-multiplicative character the theory describes.

The theory attributes wanting specifically to mesolimbic dopamine and explicitly dissociates it from 'liking' and from learning; a REE drive-multiplier that conflates wanting with hedonic benefit or with reward learning would violate the dissociation this review is built on.

entries.confidence_rationale: This is the single most direct biological anchor for MECH-306's central paradox. Chen et al. show that AgRP hunger neurons are inhibited within seconds of food detection (the 'instantaneous drive collapses at contact' problem) yet drive feeding because a brief pre-meal burst produces sustained appetitive and consummatory behaviour persisting for tens of minutes WITHOUT continued neuron activity, mediated by a long-lasting potentiation of food's rewarding value. That is precisely the sustained-drive-trace mechanism MECH-306 posits. Gold-standard optogenetics + behaviour, top venue; small discount for the mouse->REE-scalar transfer and for the fact that the persistence here is a reward-potentiation memory rather than a literally floored drive variable.
failure_signatures: The persistence mechanism is a long-lasting potentiation of FOOD REWARD VALUE triggered by a transient drive burst, not a continuously elevated drive_level signal -- so MECH-306's 'floor or slow-trace the drive' framing is one of at least two viable implementations; the biology realises the trace on the benefit/reward side, not necessarily on the drive variable itself.

AgRP inhibition at food contact is near-complete and rapid; if REE's drive_level mirrors AgRP activity faithfully, then any seeding that depends on drive being HIGH at the moment of contact will fail unless the trace is explicitly engineered -- the paper confirms the failure mode EXQ-536a observed (threshold never crossed under instantaneous drive).

entries.confidence_rationale: Supports MECH-319's functional intuition that replay can EXERCISE candidate trajectories (an internal cognitive search of past and future possibilities) as a process distinct from committing to behaviour -- the conceptual basis for 'exercise rule-arbitration without overwriting active weights from non-realized data'. Shows forward replay supports prospective planning and reverse replay retrospective evaluation, with a learning shift between them. Strong methods; confidence held lower because the paper shows replay DOES drive learning gradients (it writes), so it supports the exercise-without-commitment framing only by analogy, not by demonstrating a write-block.
failure_signatures: Replay here exhibits LEARNING gradients (it shapes prediction of past and future paths over training) -- it is write-active, not write-gated; this supports the 'simulate to plan' role but is evidence AGAINST a literal suppression of all updates during internal-search replay.

The 'internal cognitive search of possibilities' is a forward/reverse real-trajectory phenomenon; MECH-319's ghost/DMN non-realized passes are not directly recorded, so the exercise-without-commitment mapping is analogical.

entries.confidence_rationale: The named substrate anchor for MECH-319. Foster & Wilson establish that hippocampal place-cell sequences replay during awake immobility in a temporally REVERSED order immediately after experience -- demonstrating that the brain has a discriminable, internally-generated replay signature distinct from real behaviour. This grounds the SUBSTRATE-AVAILABILITY premise of MECH-319 (a categorical, tag-able simulation/replay event exists). It does NOT test the REE-novel write-gating function, so confidence is set for the substrate premise only, not the gate.
failure_signatures: The paper demonstrates that replay EXISTS and is discriminable, but it explicitly proposes replay as a mechanism FOR learning (reinforcement-style evaluation of event sequences) -- i.e. replay drives plasticity. MECH-319's gate must therefore SUPPRESS updates only for non-realized (ghost/DMN) passes while permitting real-experience replay to teach; a blanket simulation-mode write-block that caught all replay would contradict the learning role shown here.
Nothing in the recording addresses whether arbitration-weight (or any synaptic) updates are categorically gated by a simulation tag; the write-gate is entirely unobserved here.

entries.confidence_rationale: Two-edged for MECH-319. On the supporting side: forward and reverse replay are categorically distinguishable and functionally dissociable event-types, which is consistent with replay carrying a discrete tag that a categorical gate could read. On the tension side: reverse replay scales its rate with reward magnitude (more replay at increased reward, less at decreased), i.e. replay of real experience is recruited FOR reward learning -- so MECH-319's write-suppression must be confined to non-realized simulation passes and cannot be a blanket replay block. Strong methods; confidence moderated by the mixed direction.
failure_signatures: Reverse replay rate increases with increased reward and decreases with decreased reward, demonstrating that this replay class is actively used for reward-based learning -- direct tension with any gate that would suppress arbitration-weight updates during replay indiscriminately.

The forward/reverse distinction is correlated with function but the paper does not show a categorical write-admit/block signal; the binary admit/block character MECH-319 posits is inferred from the dissociation, not measured.

entries.confidence_rationale: A current review establishing SWRs as a common neurophysiological signature of hippocampal-prefrontal reactivation across BOTH sleep and waking, and explicitly raising the open question of whether sleep vs awake reactivation serve similar or different mnemonic functions. This is the cleanest available substrate-machinery anchor for MECH-319 (replacing the Joo & Frank review named in the claim notes) AND it frames the very distinction MECH-319 operationalises: that different reactivation contexts may warrant different write policies. Review-level, so confidence is for the substrate/framing, not a specific gate measurement.
failure_signatures: The review documents that SWR reactivation drives memory consolidation and prefrontal communication -- i.e. SWRs are write-ENABLING for consolidation; MECH-319's claim that a simulation-mode tag should SUPPRESS arbitration updates is the inverse-context case (non-realized data) and is not evidenced here.

Whether sleep and awake reactivation have different functional consequences is posed as an open question, not resolved -- so the review supports the plausibility of context-dependent write policies without confirming the categorical simulation-tag gate.

Retrograde-tracer + c-Fos mapping shows avoidance RETRIEVAL is signaled by prelimbic projections to basolateral amygdala (and to a lesser extent ventral striatum), while extinction recruits IL->BLA/VS and PL->VS. This supports SD-059's architectural premise that a positive avoidance pathway runs through amygdala->ventral-striatum credit projections, distinct from the suppression/extinction route. Correlational (c-Fos), so confidence is moderate.
failure_signatures: Avoidance retrieval did NOT activate IL neurons; the IL route was selective to extinction -- a caution that mapping the SD-059 escape-credit pathway onto IL specifically (as opposed to PL->BLA->VS) would mis-assign the substrate.

entries.confidence_rationale: A computational model of active avoidance/omission in which the prospect of punishment is RECAST as an opportunity to approach safety, with accumbens dopamine transients tracking that reframing at discriminative cues. This is a near-isomorph of MECH-358's threat-gated approach bonus toward credited escape-affordance classes. Strong mechanism-level mapping; held below 0.8 because the model targets dopaminergic control, not REE's pure-arithmetic per-action EMA table.
failure_signatures: The model treats reframing as a deliberately deployed cognitive-control instrument; if REE's bridge bonus fires non-selectively (not threat-gated) it would diverge from this account, which makes the threat-context gate a load-bearing guard.

entries.confidence_rationale: Human fMRI dissociating active avoidance from yoked extinction: instrumental control engages the striatum at shock-omission and PERSISTENTLY diminishes threat, including transfer to novel stimuli. This is direct human evidence for a response-produced safety/relief credit attached to a SPECIFIC avoidance action -- the MECH-358 safety half and the SD-059 'response-produced safety' wiring. Human data (preferred over rodent), within-paradigm contrast; confidence held below 0.8 because BOLD-at-omission is a correlational read of 'credit', not a per-action-class table.
failure_signatures: Yoked extinction (matched shock, no instrumental control) did NOT confer the persistent threat reduction -- absent an action-contingent credit signal, mere safety exposure fails, matching SD-059's prediction that a global 'avoidance works' scalar without an affordance-indexed action credit is insufficient.

entries.confidence_rationale: DIAYN formalises exactly the coupling Q-054 asks about: a discriminator q(z|s) can only separate latent classes to the extent the policy produces discriminable (diverse) behaviour, via the objective I(S;Z)=H(Z)-H(Z|S). This supports the EXISTENCE of a diversity->discriminability dependence (ARC-062 = the discriminator, ARC-065 = the diversity generator). It does NOT, however, quantify a minimum entropy FLOOR, which is the specific numeric Q-054 poses (is 0.497 nats enough?). Framework-level support, not a threshold measurement.
failure_signatures: DIAYN couples diversity and discriminability bidirectionally (the discriminator reward shapes the policy), so a fixed upstream entropy is not strictly required -- a caution that Q-054's 'static floor' framing may be ill-posed if the ARC-062 discriminator is allowed to shape the ARC-065 stream rather than read a frozen one.

entries.confidence_rationale: VALOR shows that the number of behavioural modes a decoder can reliably distinguish is capacity-limited, and introduces a curriculum that grows the context count ONLY when decoder performance is sufficient. This is direct evidence that the diversity<->discriminability relation has critical structure (a moving threshold), supporting Q-054's expectation of a phase transition. It addresses the CEILING (how many modes are distinguishable) rather than Q-054's FLOOR (minimum entropy to get any cut), so the mapping is by analogy of mechanism, not identity.
failure_signatures: VALOR's evidence is about a decoder CEILING on distinguishable contexts under a growth curriculum; reading it as a FLOOR on upstream entropy is an inversion that could mislead if the ARC-062 discriminator's failure mode is capacity-limited rather than diversity-limited.

entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical paper the SD-059 title cites. It supports SD-059's premise (suppression is a distinct, real mechanism) while its own data contain no directed-escape action-credit signal -- the gap SD-059 fills. High source quality (causal manipulations, double dissociation); mapping is to the premise rather than to the added credit table, so not maxed.
failure_signatures: ilPFC inactivation increased freezing and decreased avoidance but the study provides no evidence for a positively-reinforced, action-specific escape response -- consistent with SD-059's claim that the suppression pathway alone does not compute the escape direction.

This is the closest published anchor to the source trigger for the whole cluster (the Schrodinger colour-theory completion result). It shows empirically that perceptual colour space exhibits 'diminishing returns' -- large colour differences are perceived as LESS than the sum of small steps -- which is mathematically impossible in a Riemannian (locally additive) geometry. That is direct, high-quality evidence for ARC-087's specific assertion that the perceptual manifold is 'curved, compressed, asymmetric, non-additive, unlike the raw measurement space', and for MECH-372's placement of sight at the deep-adaptor end (colour geometry must be CONSTRUCTED, not read off). Confidence just below source_quality because it reanalyses/reframes existing colour-difference datasets rather than running a new psychophysical cohort, and the additivity-violation claim has prompted active debate.
failure_signatures: The paper overturns the long-assumed Riemannian (Helmholtz/Schrodinger) model of colour space but does NOT supply a replacement metric -- so it establishes that the colour adaptor's output geometry is non-additive without telling the adaptor designer what geometry to target.

It is a geometric reanalysis of aggregate colour-difference data; an adaptor-internal mechanism (how receptor signals are transformed into this non-Riemannian metric) is out of scope, so it grounds the OUTPUT shape, not the transform.

entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily replicated foundational result (Science, 1987; re-confirmed for naturalistic stimuli as recently as 2023) that a stimulus set induces a metric PSYCHOLOGICAL space in which generalization decays as an invariant (near-exponential) function of distance. This is direct, high-source-quality evidence for ARC-087's core premise -- perception contributes a structured GEOMETRY of difference, not raw signal -- and for Q-065's learned-metric arm (the metric is recoverable from similarity/generalization statistics). Confidence held below source_quality because the mapping is one level of abstraction removed: Shepard's space is a general psychological-similarity space, not specifically a per-sense perceptual adaptor manifold.
failure_signatures: The law is a metric-recovery and generalization result, not a constructive account of HOW a sensory adaptor builds the metric -- it constrains the target geometry but does not specify the transform (so it under-determines ARC-087's adaptor stage).

Shepard's two admissible metrics (Euclidean for integral dimensions, city-block for separable) assume a locally additive metric structure; later colour-geometry work (Bujack 2022) shows perceptual spaces can violate additivity at large differences, bounding the universality claim.

entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical mechanistic account of the ventral visual stream as a deep, largely feedforward cascade that progressively 'untangles' object identity manifolds -- transforming a representation in which identity is not linearly separable (retinal/V1) into one in which it is (IT). This is the biological instantiation of ARC-087's deep visual adaptor: the adaptor IS a sequence of metric-reshaping transforms that build invariance (to position, scale, pose, lighting) BEFORE downstream read-out, not a flat feature extractor. It also concretely anchors MECH-372's deep end (sight needs a multi-stage adaptor). High source quality + high mapping fidelity; confidence below ceiling only because it is primate/human object-recognition specific and is a review/synthesis rather than a single decisive experiment.
failure_signatures: The untangling account is strongest for ventral-stream OBJECT IDENTITY; it does not establish that every visual sub-property ARC-087 lists (colour geometry, gaze salience, affordance) is built by the same cascade, so 'the adaptor' is plausibly several parallel manifold-constructors, not one.

Emphasis on a largely feedforward cascade understates recurrent/feedback contributions later work foregrounds; if the V4 visual adaptor is built as strictly feedforward on this paper's authority it may under-fit hard cases (heavy occlusion, clutter) the review itself flags as unsolved.

entries.confidence_rationale: This is the closest published anchor to the source trigger for the whole cluster (the Schrodinger colour-theory completion result). It shows empirically that perceptual colour space exhibits 'diminishing returns' -- large colour differences are perceived as LESS than the sum of small steps -- which is mathematically impossible in a Riemannian (locally additive) geometry. That is direct, high-quality evidence for ARC-087's specific assertion that the perceptual manifold is 'curved, compressed, asymmetric, non-additive, unlike the raw measurement space', and for MECH-372's placement of sight at the deep-adaptor end (colour geometry must be CONSTRUCTED, not read off). Confidence just below source_quality because it reanalyses/reframes existing colour-difference datasets rather than running a new psychophysical cohort, and the additivity-violation claim has prompted active debate.
failure_signatures: The paper overturns the long-assumed Riemannian (Helmholtz/Schrodinger) model of colour space but does NOT supply a replacement metric -- so it establishes that the colour adaptor's output geometry is non-additive without telling the adaptor designer what geometry to target.

It is a geometric reanalysis of aggregate colour-difference data; an adaptor-internal mechanism (how receptor signals are transformed into this non-Riemannian metric) is out of scope, so it grounds the OUTPUT shape, not the transform.

entries.confidence_rationale: Direct behavioural demonstration that an olfactory signal functions as a near-raw spatial GRADIENT that can be followed for navigation -- a single functional olfactory neuron suffices for chemotaxis up a measured odour gradient, and bilateral input improves accuracy mainly by raising signal-to-noise. This is strong support for MECH-372's placement of smell at the LOW-adaptor-depth end: orientation behaviour (follow / approach / strengthen / weaken) is recoverable with minimal transformation of the raw chemical signal, in contrast to the multi-stage construction vision needs. Confidence held moderate because the model is Drosophila larva -- the gradient-primitive PRINCIPLE transfers but the specific biology is phylogenetically distant from REE's intended agent.
failure_signatures: Demonstrated in larval Drosophila with a single odour and an externally imposed monotonic gradient; it shows a near-raw gradient is SUFFICIENT for orientation, not that biological olfaction in general stays low-adaptor (mammalian odour-identity / mixture demixing may require substantial transformation, which would complicate MECH-372's 'smell = low-adaptor' as a blanket claim).

The bilateral-comparison benefit is largely an SNR effect, not a rich spatial-geometry computation -- so it supports 'gradient primitive' but offers no evidence for any structured olfactory MANIFOLD, leaving the depth of the olfactory adaptor under-specified at its upper bound.

entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical, heavily replicated foundational result (Science, 1987; re-confirmed for naturalistic stimuli as recently as 2023) that a stimulus set induces a metric PSYCHOLOGICAL space in which generalization decays as an invariant (near-exponential) function of distance. This is direct, high-source-quality evidence for ARC-087's core premise -- perception contributes a structured GEOMETRY of difference, not raw signal -- and for Q-065's learned-metric arm (the metric is recoverable from similarity/generalization statistics). Confidence held below source_quality because the mapping is one level of abstraction removed: Shepard's space is a general psychological-similarity space, not specifically a per-sense perceptual adaptor manifold.
failure_signatures: The law is a metric-recovery and generalization result, not a constructive account of HOW a sensory adaptor builds the metric -- it constrains the target geometry but does not specify the transform (so it under-determines ARC-087's adaptor stage).

Shepard's two admissible metrics (Euclidean for integral dimensions, city-block for separable) assume a locally additive metric structure; later colour-geometry work (Bujack 2022) shows perceptual spaces can violate additivity at large differences, bounding the universality claim.

entries.confidence_rationale: Single-unit + behavioural evidence that visual and vestibular cues to heading are combined near-OPTIMALLY (reliability-weighted, subadditive linear combination) in area MSTd, with congruent-tuned neurons carrying the integration and tracking perceptual decisions. This SUPPORTS Q-065's cross-modal negotiability question by exhibiting a concrete, biologically realised common currency -- statistical reliability / precision weighting -- which is exactly what MECH-103's precision-weighted fusion presupposes. But it WEAKENS the assumption that such a currency straightforwardly solves the HARD half of Q-065: the two cues here are redundant estimates of the SAME physical variable (heading), not structurally dissimilar perceptual manifolds (smell-gradient vs colour-geometry vs body-state). Hence 'mixed' and moderate confidence -- it grounds the mechanism while exposing the unsolved part.
failure_signatures: Optimal integration is demonstrated for two cues to a COMMON physical variable (heading) living in a shared 1-D estimation space; it does NOT show how to negotiate between heterogeneous geometries (a gradient manifold vs a non-Riemannian colour manifold), which is the actual unsolved content of Q-065 part (2).

Reliability weighting requires the cues to be commensurable enough to be weighted at all -- the paper presupposes a shared estimand and so cannot answer how dissimilar sense-specific manifolds are mapped into a common currency in the first place (the unification problem, not the weighting problem).

entries.confidence_rationale: First empirical demonstration that interactive repair (latency to reparation of dyadic mismatches in the Face-to-Face Still-Face paradigm) is associated with infant psychobiological stress reactivity (cortisol), independent of maternal diagnostic category -- 'infants respond to what they experience and not to the maternal diagnostic category.' Grounds the core of the rupture-and-repair model that INV-082's safe base and LOVE-4/LOVE-5 stand on: rupture is normal and recurrent, and it is the REPAIR that regulates the infant. Held below 0.7 by small sample (46 dyads, 16 imputed cortisol values), correlational design, and the large gap from infant HPA-axis regulation to a computational self-valence channel.
failure_signatures: Small sample (n=46) with 16 imputed cortisol values and a correlational design -- the repair/cortisol association is real but the effect's robustness and direction of causation are not nailed down.

The study measures physiological stress regulation (cortisol reactivity), not the self-valence or rule-update outcomes INV-082/LOVE-4 actually care about; it grounds 'repair regulates the infant' but not the specific 'correction updates rule/harm models without self-valence collapse' separation.

entries.confidence_rationale: Direct empirical test of Bowlby's claim that the working model of self is intertwined with the working model of attachment to the caregiver: in 5-year-olds the security of the child-mother attachment representation is positively and strongly related to the positiveness (affective quality) of the self-representation, and positiveness of self predicts competence, social acceptance and adjustment. This is the cleanest available operationalisation of INV-082's central premise -- internalised care registers as a stable, personally-applicable self-valence. Confidence held below 0.8 by sample size (n~50-95), single developmental window (kindergarten), correlational design (cannot show that secure attachment CAUSES positive self-model, only co-variation), and the gap between a child's puppet-interview self-affect and REE's z_self valence channel.
failure_signatures: The association is correlational: a positive self-model and a secure attachment representation co-vary, but the study cannot establish that received caregiving causes the positive self-valence rather than a third factor (e.g. child temperament) driving both -- INV-082's causal 'care internalised AS self-valence' is consistent with but not proven by this design.

Measured at a single age (~5 years); says nothing about the STABILITY of internalised loveability under later correction or threat, which is the load-bearing part of INV-082 (safe base that survives correction).

entries.confidence_rationale: The named L3 anchor for the loveability_coupling_gain UPPER BOUND. Experimentally manipulating perceived self-other similarity (low/moderate/high) toward an injured target: moderate similarity yielded empathic concern WITHOUT personal distress (reduced disgust/avoidance), while high similarity produced empathic concern but ALSO as much personal-distress signalling as the low-similarity group -- a non-monotone, inverted-U relationship. This is the direct empirical basis for INV-082's claim that loveability/coupling is bounded ('care internalised as personally-applicable AND stable', not 'more coupling is better') and for the DEV-NEED-017 loveability_coupling_gain ceiling. Held at 0.6 by a single modest-N lab study (n=87), indirect self-other-distress measures (facial disgust as a personal-distress proxy), and the gap from inter-personal empathy similarity to an intra-agent self-valence coupling parameter.
failure_signatures: Single study, n=87, with personal distress operationalised indirectly (facial disgust / avoidance, gaze, pupil) rather than by a validated distress instrument -- the inversion at high similarity is suggestive, not a precisely-located threshold; it does NOT license the specific [0.1, 0.7] numeric bound, only the qualitative claim that an upper bound exists.

The coupling here is BETWEEN two people (observer vs injured target); INV-082's loveability_coupling_gain is a within-agent coupling of received care into self-valence -- the inverted-U may not transfer cleanly across that reframing, and the high-similarity 'personal distress' failure mode is an analogy for over-coupling, not a measurement of it.

entries.confidence_rationale: Canonical review establishing the shame/guilt distinction that INV-082's safe-base function depends on: guilt is a negative evaluation of a specific BEHAVIOUR ('I did a bad thing') and predicts reparative, approach-oriented responses; shame is a negative evaluation of the global SELF ('I am bad/unloveable') and predicts withdrawal, defensiveness, externalisation and appeasement. This is precisely the 'I erred' vs 'I am unloveable / must self-erase / must appease' separation that INV-082 makes load-bearing for correction-without-annihilation. High confidence as a conceptual grounding (the distinction is well-replicated and the review is authoritative); held below 0.8 because it is a human-affect taxonomy, not a mechanism, and the empirical adaptive/maladaptive split for guilt vs shame has known boundary conditions.
failure_signatures: The shame/guilt adaptive-maladaptive dichotomy is not absolute: the review notes guilt can become maladaptive when fused with shame or when it generalises into chronic self-blame -- so a REE design that merely routes correction to a 'guilt-like' channel does not automatically avoid self-erasure; the behaviour-vs-self locus is the actual discriminator, not the affect label.

Childhood-abuse history predicts shame-proneness: the conditions of caregiving shape whether later correction routes to guilt (repair) or shame (collapse) -- implying INV-082's safe base is not a fixed parameter but itself a developmental product (consistent with, but a complication for, treating loveability as a settable substrate term).

entries.confidence_rationale: The foundational, field-defining theory that the TYPE of causal attribution (locus, stability, controllability) determines which emotion arises -- guilt specifically follows from internal + controllable attribution, shame from internal attribution to uncontrollable/global causes. This is the closest thing in the literature to a 'typed causal attribution governs moral emotion' law, directly grounding ARC-096's typed ontology and the attribution-precondition for ARC-097's guilt routing. Held at 0.7 because it is a theory of achievement emotion (success/failure) rather than interpersonal-harm morality per se, and is a theoretical framework rather than a single decisive experiment, so the mapping is by structural analogy.
failure_signatures: Weiner's controllability and locus dimensions are conceptually entangled with 'responsibility' in ways that are not fully separable -- a typed-attribution ontology that treats ownership tags (self/controllable/intentional) as cleanly orthogonal may over-formalise a distinction the source treats as partially overlapping.

The theory is built on achievement (success/failure) attributions; the guilt/shame mapping for interpersonal moral harm is an extension, so a system importing the dimensional structure wholesale risks mis-specifying which moral attributions yield guilt vs shame.
