entries.confidence_rationale: Shumailov et al. give a rigorous, general demonstration -- theoretical plus empirical across LLMs, VAEs, and Gaussian mixture models -- that indiscriminately training a generative model on its own (or a related model's) generated output causes 'model collapse': tails of the true distribution disappear and errors compound across generations, an effect they show is close to inevitable without deliberate countermeasures. This directly corroborates the load-bearing anti-circularity requirement MECH-514 registers: 'repeated simulations derived from one episode must not become multiple independent samples,' and the raw thought's own framing that 'the central danger is that material generated or interpreted through the attractor is counted as independent evidence for it.' Model collapse is the demonstrated failure mode when that discipline is absent at the scale of generative-model training; MECH-514 proposes the analogous discipline (provenance-tagging every replay-derived item, requiring some independence in what gets selected for replay) at the scale of one system's offline counterfactual replay. The paper does not test MECH-514's specific protocol (bounded alternative-model construction, held-out validation before granting reindexing authority) -- it establishes the generic hazard MECH-514's anti-pseudo-replication requirement exists to prevent, at one remove.
failure_signatures: Model collapse is demonstrated for generative models trained across successive generations/iterations on self-generated data at population/corpus scale (LLMs, VAEs, GMMs); MECH-514's anti-circularity concern is about a single system's own online-vs-replay bookkeeping within one memory/inference cycle, a different granularity than multi-generation training collapse.

The paper's countermeasure discussion centres on preserving access to genuine, human-generated data as generated content proliferates online; it does not propose or test a provenance-tagging / replay-selector-independence mechanism of the specific kind MECH-514 requires.

No neuroscience or hippocampal-replay content: this is a pure ML/statistics paper about training-data composition over generations, with no claim about biological memory consolidation or offline replay.

entries.confidence_rationale: PASS with supporting direction

Reviews a body of work (Witt, Proffitt and colleagues) claiming that a perceiver's energetic/action-capability state -- fatigue, load, fitness -- changes the perceived properties of the SAME physical scene (hill steepness, target distance). This bears loosely on ARC-133's drive-relative claim: a bodily-state variable modulating perception of a fixed external scene. Confidence is capped, and the direction is marked mixed rather than supports, because (a) the mapping is to property perception (magnitude estimates), not object individuation, and (b) this literature has a live, substantive methodological controversy (Firestone & Scholl 2014/2016 argue the effects are demand-characteristic/response-bias artifacts rather than genuine perceptual change) that this review, being from the action-specific-perception camp itself, does not resolve.
failure_signatures: Firestone & Scholl's 'Cognition does not affect perception' critique (Behavioral and Brain Sciences, 2016) argues that several action-specific perception findings, including hill-slant and distance effects under load/fatigue, are better explained by response bias and demand characteristics (participants inferring the hypothesis and adjusting verbal reports accordingly) than by genuine changes in perceptual experience -- a direct challenge to reading this literature as evidence that internal state changes perception rather than merely changes REPORTS about perception.

entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational ecological-psychology text proposing that much of perception consists of directly detecting affordances -- what an environment offers an organism for action -- rather than first perceiving neutral physical properties and then computing usefulness. This directly legitimizes usefulness/relation-to-organism as a primary perceptual category, supporting ARC-133's general architectural stance. Confidence and direction are both tempered because Gibson's affordances are defined relative to relatively STABLE organism-environment fit (an organism's action capabilities), not to moment-to-moment interoceptive/drive fluctuation -- which cuts specifically against the RADICAL, moment-to-moment reading of ARC-133 that its own registration flags as the sharpest test, and is more naturally read as support for the CONSERVATIVE 'fourth facet' reading instead.
failure_signatures: Gibson explicitly treats affordances as invariant properties of the animal-environment relationship (a surface affords sitting for an organism of a given size and rigidity, independent of that organism's momentary state), not as quantities that fluctuate with internal drive state from moment to moment. If ARC-133's radical (moment-to-moment, drive-relative) reading were the correct extension of affordance theory, Gibson's own insistence on affordances as stable, directly-perceived invariants would need qualification that the source text does not provide -- a genuine tension the claim's registration does not yet flag.

entries.confidence_rationale: A canonical, foundational paper establishing 'alliesthesia': the SAME physical stimulus (a sip of a given temperature or a given sugar concentration) is judged pleasant or unpleasant by the same subject depending on their internal physiological state (core temperature, blood glucose/satiety), with the sign of the hedonic judgment flipping as the stimulus's usefulness for restoring homeostatic balance changes. This is direct, foundational evidence that a stimulus's motivational value is drive-relative -- a load-bearing precondition for ARC-133's individuation criterion ('usefulness relative to goals, harm, and interoceptive/metabolic state'). Confidence is capped because the paper demonstrates drive-relative VALUE remapping of a fixed stimulus, not drive-relative INDIVIDUATION (the sharper claim that the same scene is carved into a different number/boundary of objects under different drive states).
failure_signatures: If the pleasantness of a stimulus were fixed by its physical properties alone (independent of internal state), alliesthesia -- the same tepid water rated pleasant by an overheated subject and unpleasant by a cold one, purely as a function of core temperature -- would not occur. The reliable within-subject sign-flip demonstrated across thermal and gustatory (glucose) modalities is the empirical anchor showing usefulness-to-the-organism, not stimulus identity, sets motivational valence.

entries.confidence_rationale: A well-controlled factorial fMRI design (taxonomic class x threat level, crossed and balanced) shows that a perceived-dangerousness dimension organizes neural representation of animal categories along the right STS, and that this dimension becomes progressively dominant over both low-level visual and taxonomic/causal-similarity representations moving from posterior to anterior temporal cortex. This is direct evidence that a relation-to-organism (threat) dimension is a real, independent representational axis, not merely a re-description of causal/taxonomic similarity -- which is ARC-133's core architectural claim. Confidence is capped because the paradigm is passive categorical viewing, not an active individuation task, and the study does not manipulate the observer's own interoceptive/motivational state (it tests that a relevance dimension exists and is dissociable, not that it is drive-relative).
failure_signatures: If threat/relevance-to-organism were merely a downstream re-weighting of taxonomic or visual features rather than an independent organizing dimension, the STS pathway should not show threat dominance persisting after taxonomic and visual dimensions 'fall away' toward anterior temporal cortex -- but that is exactly what the paper reports, which is the finding ARC-133 needs and MECH-278's pure causal-coherence criterion does not predict on its own.

entries.confidence_rationale: A canonical, well-replicated review synthesizing violation-of-expectation studies showing that pre-verbal infants interpret goal-directed action via a non-causal 'teleological stance' (action is efficient relative to a goal and situational constraints) rather than requiring representation of mental states or of the causal mechanics of the actor. This legitimizes function/goal-relative interpretation as a genuine, developmentally early cognitive primitive rather than a late gloss on causal representation -- which is the general architectural move ARC-133 makes for OBJECTS. Confidence is capped because the paper's own object of study is agents' actions (goal attribution to others), not object individuation, so the transfer to ARC-133 is analogical/precedent-setting rather than a direct empirical test.
failure_signatures: The teleological stance is explicitly framed by the authors as NON-mentalistic and NON-causal-mechanical: infants do not need to represent HOW an action produces its effect, only THAT it is the most efficient available means to a goal given situational constraints. If functional/goal-relative interpretation required prior causal-mechanical representation to be intelligible, this developmental dissociation (teleological understanding precedes and is independent of causal and mentalistic understanding) would not be observed -- which is the precedent ARC-133 needs against the assumption that a functional criterion is parasitic on a causal one.

entries.confidence_rationale: Uses exploratory factor analysis across multiple number-limited and resolution-limited visual working memory tasks and finds a two-factor model with FULLY ORTHOGONAL factors: how many items are held (number) and how precisely each is held (resolution) empirically dissociate, with only the number factor predicting fluid intelligence. This is a clean, direct empirical demonstration that two working-memory parameters that could in principle be a single underlying quantity are instead statistically independent -- structurally the kind of dissociation MECH-521 asserts between capacity and occupancy, though the specific dissociated pair (item count vs. per-item precision) is not identical to MECH-521's pair (capacity ceiling vs. realized domain count).
failure_signatures: If number and resolution were the same underlying working-memory quantity expressed two ways (e.g. a single resource that could be spent on either more items or more precision per item, producing a forced trade-off), the two factors should load together or trade off against each other and both should predict fluid intelligence similarly. Instead the factor analysis found orthogonal loadings and the fluid-intelligence relationship was carried entirely by the number factor, not the resolution factor -- inconsistent with a single-quantity account and consistent with genuinely separable regulators of working memory performance.

entries.confidence_rationale: Shows that the number of objects successfully tracked in multiple-object-tracking (MOT) is not a fixed slot count but trades off logarithmically against target speed -- up to ~8 at slow speeds, as few as 1 at high speeds -- attributed to a flexibly-divisible attentional resource. This is structurally close to MECH-521's capacity/occupancy split: a bounded resource (capacity) from which a task-dependent, dynamically realized tracking count (occupancy) emerges. Marked mixed rather than supports because a later, direct challenge (Franconeri and colleagues' object-spacing account) argues the same data are better explained by a spatial-interference limit than by a divisible resource pool, which is a live complication for reading this as clean capacity/occupancy evidence.
failure_signatures: A fixed-slot model (a hard N-item ceiling, period) predicts a flat tracking-count-vs-speed function up to the slot limit and then a cliff; the observed smooth, logarithmic trade-off between target speed and the number of objects that can be tracked is inconsistent with a pure fixed-slot account and is the paper's central argument for a divisible resource instead.

A published follow-up line of work (object-spacing accounts, e.g. Franconeri, Jonathan & Scimeca and related studies) argues the same speed-count trade-off is largely explained by inter-object spacing/crowding rather than by a divisible attentional resource per se -- meaning the 'resource pool bounded above by capacity' interpretation this entry leans on is contested, not settled, in the tracking literature itself.

entries.confidence_rationale: A causal (not merely correlational) manipulation: transcranial alternating current stimulation (tACS) at 4 Hz vs. 7 Hz over parietal cortex CHANGES visuospatial working-memory capacity (K-values) in opposite directions, lateralized to the stimulated hemisphere's contralateral visual field. This is the strongest available direct evidence in this pull that a rhythm/frequency parameter can SET item capacity rather than merely correlating with a separately-determined count -- the exact causal direction MECH-522 needs (coupling constant as setter, not readout). Confidence is capped because the manipulated frequency band and mechanism (theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling via cortical rhythms) is a single GLOBAL parietal rhythm setting ONE capacity number, not a heterogeneous field acting differently per stream -- MECH-522's more specific and more distinctive claim.
failure_signatures: If working-memory item capacity were fixed by a slot-count mechanism independent of oscillatory dynamics, externally imposing a different theta frequency via tACS should not change K-values at all -- but 4-Hz tACS significantly enhanced K-values (and accuracy) relative to sham while 7-Hz tACS significantly reduced them (Cohen's d 0.44-0.57), which is inconsistent with a fixed, rhythm-independent capacity and consistent with the rhythm ITSELF acting as (or directly setting) the capacity-determining parameter.

entries.confidence_rationale: This entry verifies a citation MECH-522's own registration text already relies on ('the single ordered abstraction axis that Badre and Nee 2018 reports the evidence does not support'). The review's systematic synthesis of rostrocaudal prefrontal hierarchy evidence concludes against BOTH a unitary model of lateral frontal function AND a single unidimensional abstraction gradient, instead favoring separate interacting frontal networks -- confirming the citation is accurate and directly relevant to MECH-522's heterogeneity claim. Confidence is capped because this is prefrontal hierarchical CONTROL abstraction (levels of policy abstraction), not perceptual GRAIN (domain count in a settling competition), so the domain match is at the level of a shared architectural principle (heterogeneity over unidimensionality) rather than the same mechanism.
failure_signatures: If cognitive control abstraction in prefrontal cortex were organized along a single ordered rostrocaudal gradient (as some earlier unidimensional models proposed), a systematic review of the evidence should converge on that gradient as the best-supported account. Instead Badre & Nee's synthesis concludes the evidence supports neither a unitary model nor a single unidimensional gradient, but rather separate, interacting frontal networks operating at local and global hierarchical levels simultaneously -- the same qualitative shape (heterogeneous, multi-network organization rather than one ordered axis) MECH-522 claims should hold for perceptual grain regulation.

entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational formal-methods paper defining a bisimulation pseudometric between MDP states as a fixed point combining immediate-reward difference and a Wasserstein (earth-mover) distance between next-state transition distributions, with the guarantee that the optimal value function varies continuously (Lipschitz) with respect to this metric. This is a REWARD/VALUE-relevant state-similarity metric, structurally in the same family as value equivalence (Grimm et al. 2020, companion entry in this directory) -- it collapses states that differ in ways that do not affect reward or future value-relevant transition structure, which is again closer to the compression MECH-520 warns about than to the anti-collapse constraint MECH-520 proposes. Confidence capped and direction marked mixed for the same reason as the VE entry, plus reduced source-quality certainty because full-text verification of the exact metric definition was blocked by an unreadable PDF in this pull.
failure_signatures: Bisimulation metrics are explicitly REWARD-relevant: two states with identical reward and reward-relevant transition structure but different underlying features (e.g. different textures, different irrelevant background objects) are metrically CLOSE or IDENTICAL under bisimulation, by design. This is precisely the kind of compression MECH-520 warns a pure value-carving objective will produce -- discarding structure that is not currently reward/value-relevant -- rather than a demonstrated anti-collapse mechanism.

entries.confidence_rationale: The most mechanistically direct paper found in this pull: it studies self-predictive representation learning in RL (an online network predicting its own future latent, BYOL/SimSiam-style, structurally close to a predictive-obligation objective) and shows explicitly that such objectives ADMIT trivial collapsed solutions (constant representations) that minimize the loss, yet typically do not collapse in practice -- and identifies the SPECIFIC optimization-dynamics ingredients (asymmetric predictor/representation learning speed, semi-gradient rather than full-gradient updates on the representation) responsible for avoiding collapse. This directly speaks to MECH-520's central mechanism claim, but complicates rather than simply confirms it: a predictive objective's FUNCTIONAL FORM does not by itself guarantee anti-collapse (contra a naive reading of MECH-520); specific training dynamics are doing the load-bearing work.
failure_signatures: The paper explicitly identifies that trivial, fully-collapsed representations (e.g. mapping every state to a constant vector) achieve zero self-prediction loss and are therefore globally optimal for a naively-specified predictive objective -- meaning 'require the representation to be predictive across horizons' is NOT, by itself, a sufficient anti-collapse constraint in the way a literal reading of MECH-520 might suggest. Collapse is avoided only when specific optimization dynamics (a predictor network updated faster than the representation, and semi-gradient rather than full-gradient flow into the representation from the predictor) are present; absent these, the same objective's collapsed global optimum is reachable.

entries.confidence_rationale: Formalizes value equivalence (VE): two models are VE with respect to a set of policies and value functions if they yield identical Bellman updates for that set. The paper's own central theorem is the precise formal anchor for MECH-520's collapse worry: as the policy/function set considered SHRINKS, the class of models satisfying VE GROWS, admitting increasingly degenerate/under-constrained models, and only as the set is augmented does the VE-model class shrink toward a single point (a perfect, non-degenerate model). This is exactly MECH-520's claim that value-carving ALONE (a narrow, near-scalar target) under-constrains representation, formalized in the RL theory the claim itself cites. Marked mixed rather than supports because the paper's own stated purpose and empirical framing is celebratory of this property (it enables SIMPLER, more efficient models, and grounds MuZero's success) rather than diagnostic of a hazard -- the paper does not itself argue value-only compression is dangerous; MECH-520 reads the same formal fact in the opposite light.
failure_signatures: The paper's own abstract states the class of value-equivalent models shrinks toward a single (perfect) model only as the policy and function set is augmented -- meaning a SMALL policy/function set (the degenerate case closest to 'value alone') leaves a large, under-constrained space of models satisfying the VE criterion, many of which need not preserve state structure irrelevant to that narrow set. This is a precise formal statement of MECH-520's exact worry: a pure value-carving objective, formalized as VE over a minimal policy/function set, provably admits a wide space of solutions that discard everything not currently useful to that set.

entries.confidence_rationale: non_contributory -- excluded from scoring

A formal, empirically-fit computational model of exactly the phenomenon MECH-524 needs to license: a suspended goal is not erased but decays in activation and is recoverable via priming, tested against latency/error data from a task (Tower of Hanoi) that is architecturally about suspension and resumption of subgoals. Directly grounds the preserve-don't-erase framing and the need for an explicit re-priming trigger rather than passive persistence.
failure_signatures: A suspended goal's activation decays with elapsed time and with interference from intervening goals -- so a parked goal left un-reprimed for long enough, or heavily interleaved with unrelated activity, becomes progressively harder to retrieve even though its representation was never deleted. Passive persistence alone (SD-039's trace surviving) is not sufficient for reliable resumption at arbitrary delay; an explicit reactivation/priming event is load-bearing.

The model's priming constraint predicts that resumption quality depends on the availability of the right retrieval cues at the moment capacity returns -- an interruption_snapshot with no cue-bearing content (or a re-seeding trigger that does not supply the snapshot as a cue) would fail to accelerate retrieval even if the trace is intact.

entries.confidence_rationale: The sharpest available grounding for what a 'spare-compute' state should actually look like: mind-wandering here is not low-engagement idling but a co-activation of default-mode and executive-control networks, two systems normally treated as antagonistic, with the co-activation strongest precisely when the subject lacks meta-awareness of the wandering. This maps closely onto MECH-524's trigger design (reduced task-directed load, not zero cognitive resources) but the no-meta-awareness finding raises an honest, unresolved design question about how the trigger should be flagged.
failure_signatures: If MECH-524's spare-compute trigger is designed as a pure low-engagement/idle detector, it will miss the state this paper actually characterizes -- executive resources are co-recruited during mind-wandering, not simply freed up and left unused, so a trigger keyed only on 'nothing else is happening' underspecifies the state it should be detecting.

Neural recruitment (both default and executive) was strongest when subjects lacked meta-awareness of their own mind-wandering -- a re-seeding trigger that requires an explicit, agent-legible 'I am now reallocating capacity to the parked goal' signal may be modeling a state that empirically co-occurs with the ABSENCE of exactly that kind of explicit self-monitoring.

entries.confidence_rationale: Directly measures and models the cost the interruption_snapshot exists to avoid: after an interruption, resuming a task requires re-encoding ('reconstructing') context to identify the next step, and this reconstruction cost (resumption lag) is what a preserved snapshot is architecturally meant to short-circuit. The finding that interruption timing relative to subtask boundaries changes the cost is a specific, actionable design input for MECH-524's trigger.
failure_signatures: Interruptions landing mid-subtask (mid-CEM-rollout, in REE terms) cost more to reconstruct/resume from than interruptions landing at a natural subtask boundary; a re-seeding trigger that treats all interruption points as equivalent will under-predict resumption cost for mid-rollout interruptions and may need the snapshot to carry more of the in-progress CEM state precisely when the interruption is least boundary-aligned.

Without a preserved context, the reconstruction process itself consumes time and attention that could otherwise go toward resuming actual task progress -- an REE agent lacking an interruption_snapshot pays an analogous reconstruction tax even after MECH-293/MECH-285 correctly re-flag the parked goal as worth resuming.

entries.confidence_rationale: Sharpens the Wagner et al. 2004 finding to a specific sleep phase (REM, not NREM, not quiet-rest incubation), and shows the benefit is independent of item-specific memory retention -- i.e. the mechanism operates on generalized associative structure, not verbatim replay of the interrupted material. Both points are load-bearing, testable constraints for how MECH-285's re-seeding should be gated and what it should be expected to reproduce.
failure_signatures: The associative-priming benefit was specific to REM sleep and did not appear after quiet rest or non-REM sleep of equivalent duration -- an REE sleep-replay resumption pass that fires on any sleep-phase entry, ungated by a REM-analogous state signal, is predicted to under-deliver relative to one gated on the correct phase (MECH-272 state-gated routing).

The creative benefit was independent of improved memory retention for the specific tested items -- if MECH-285's re-seeding toward the interruption_snapshot is evaluated only by whether the exact snapshot content is reproduced verbatim, it may miss the intended effect, which according to this paper operates at the level of generalized associative structure rather than item-specific recall.

entries.confidence_rationale: Direct causal evidence (sleep vs. matched wake, controlled for time-of-day) that sleep actively restructures an unresolved problem representation and more than doubles the rate at which a hidden solution is discovered -- grounding the 'sleep entry' branch of MECH-524's trigger as more than a passive consolidation window. The hard precondition (sleep did not help without prior training) is a load-bearing constraint on the mechanism, not just a footnote.
failure_signatures: Sleep produced no insight benefit in the absence of initial training/exposure to the task -- an REE sleep-triggered resumption pass over a goal with no interruption_snapshot ever formed (because the goal was never actually engaged/attempted) should be expected to do nothing, not to spontaneously generate progress from nothing.

The effect required a full night (8h) of sleep in this design; a truncated or shallow sleep-analog state may not deliver the same restructuring benefit, so MECH-285's sleep-replay re-seeding is plausibly dose- or depth-dependent rather than triggered uniformly by any sleep-phase entry.

entries.confidence_rationale: Recent, open-access, pre-registered-style meta-analysis directly on point, and it forces a correction to the naive framing of the anchor task. It WEAKENS the Zeigarnik 1927 claim itself (no reliable recall advantage for interrupted tasks once the original 1927 data is excluded) but SUPPORTS the distinct, more behaviorally relevant Ovsiankina effect (a general, more reliably replicating tendency to resume interrupted tasks). MECH-524 is a resumption-behavior mechanism, not a recall-strength mechanism, so the paper's net effect on MECH-524 specifically is supportive once the correct effect is cited.
failure_signatures: Grounding an REE resumption trigger in 'interrupted goals are simply remembered better' (naive Zeigarnik) reproduces an effect that does not reliably replicate once experimenter-authority / ego-involvement / voluntary-participation moderators are absent, as they are in most modern lab settings.

Historical moderators (ego-involvement, expectation of resuming, experimenter authority, emotional stakes) that inflated the original 1927 effect have no stated REE analogue yet -- a naive port risks smuggling in an unmodeled confound rather than an architectural principle.

entries.confidence_rationale: The canonical formal derivation of why simulated/counterfactual rollouts can rationally drive POLICY SELECTION (choosing which action to take) without that use constituting a generative-model (world-model) update -- exactly the distinction ARC-092 draws between LICIT plan optimisation/counterfactual exploration and FORBIDDEN durable world-model update. Held below 0.8 because it is a normative/computational-level derivation, not an empirical demonstration that biological or artificial systems actually respect the boundary, and REE's own architecture is only loosely (not formally) an active-inference implementation.
failure_signatures: The formal separation between policy-evaluation use of expected free energy and generative-model parameter updates only holds if the implementation actually keeps them as distinct operations -- a system that lets policy-selection rollouts write back into the same parameters used for perception/world-modeling would violate the theoretical distinction this paper relies on, which is precisely the FORBIDDEN-side failure mode ARC-092 is designed to catch.

entries.confidence_rationale: A well-powered, well-cited within-subjects nap-paradigm study with a direct, specific dissociation (REM vs NREM vs quiet-rest) that maps cleanly onto the LICIT schema-integration claim's mechanism (offline restructuring of associative structure without new item-level knowledge). Confidence held below 0.8 because RAT priming is a laboratory analogue for 'schema integration', not a direct measurement of REE's internal representations, and the paper does not itself address the FORBIDDEN side of ARC-092 (durable world-model update).
failure_signatures: If REM-dependent creative integration turned out to require conscious dream recall or explicit item-memory improvement, this would weaken the claim that the effect is a non-declarative associative-network change rather than ordinary memory strengthening -- the paper's own recognition-memory control rules this out for the reported effect, which is why it counts as support rather than a confound.

entries.confidence_rationale: Master anchor for the dissociative pole: puts Janet's clinical account of dissociation as disrupted integration into a modern frame, and its own taxonomy (compartmentalization vs. detachment vs. structural dissociation) maps directly onto two structurally distinct ways MECH-524's restrictive trigger could fail, rather than the single undifferentiated 'stuck too restrictive' pole the claim's notes currently name. Confidence held at moderate because the paper's own three-level neuronal integration proposal is explicitly offered as hypothesis, not established mechanism.
failure_signatures: A dissociative agent failure mode may not be a single unitary 'trigger too restrictive' phenomenon: Janet/Scalabrini's own clinical taxonomy separates compartmentalization (content never captured or made accessible -- amnesia-like) from detachment (content present but subjectively estranged and not engaged -- depersonalization-like). If the analogy holds, MECH-524's restrictive pole should itself split into a snapshot-never-captured failure and a snapshot-captured-but-never-reseeded failure, with potentially different falsifiers for each.

The paper explicitly states the exact neuronal mechanisms leading from disrupted integration to the different dissociative symptom clusters 'remain unclear.' Grounding MECH-524's dissociative pole in this literature borrows a clinical taxonomy and a hypothesis about levels of integration, not a validated neural mechanism -- premature to treat the three-level (regional/network/global) proposal as anything more than a structural analogy.

entries.confidence_rationale: Authoritative field-wide critical review that plays the same corrective role for MECH-524's dissociative pole that Ghibellini & Meier 2025 plays for its Zeigarnik framing (see that companion entry): it weakens a naive single-mechanism (trauma-fixation-only) reading of the restrictive pole and supports a broader, multi-factor reading. Confidence held at moderate because its contribution to MECH-524 is corrective/contextual rather than direct positive evidence for the mechanism's own design.
failure_signatures: Treating dissociative loss-of-thread as evidence the restrictive-trigger pole is a single identifiable failure mode risks the same error the field spent decades making about trauma-vs-sociocognitive causation generally: multiple distinct mechanisms can converge on the same behavioral phenotype (no resumption), and a falsifier that only tests one candidate mechanism could pass despite the pole being real for a different, unmodeled reason.

This review explicitly argues dissociation is transdiagnostic and multifactorial (sleep disturbance, impaired self-regulation/inhibition, hyperassociation and attentional set-shifting, deficits in reality testing/source monitoring/metacognition). MECH-524's notes currently ground the restrictive pole with none of these factors named -- the gap this lit-pull closes is narrower than 'is there clinical grounding' and closer to 'which of several plausible clinical mechanisms, if any, does MECH-524's own trigger design actually resemble.'

entries.confidence_rationale: Closest available clinical existence-proof of MECH-524's restrictive pole read literally: a person whose stress-response capacity is intact or hyperactive, yet whose engagement with self/world content does not resume. Held at moderate-low confidence because depersonalization/derealization disorder is a tonic, global, trait-like detachment state, not the episodic per-goal reseeding failure MECH-524's trigger is specified as, and a narrative single-author review is weaker source quality than a meta-analysis.
failure_signatures: DPDR's detachment is typically tonic and trait-like across the entire self-world relationship, not an episodic per-goal reseeding failure. If MECH-524's dissociative pole in REE were similarly tonic -- a general dampening of the spare-compute trigger across ALL parked entries rather than a per-entry mis-trigger -- that would be a different, and arguably more concerning, failure mode, and the falsifier design in MECH-524's own notes does not yet distinguish 'this one entry never got reseeded' from 'the trigger itself is globally suppressed.'

The review explicitly notes DPDR's precise neurocircuit-to-symptom mapping remains incompletely resolved even for the human clinical case. Citing it grounds the EXISTENCE and clinical plausibility of a capacity-present/engagement-absent phenotype, not a specific implementable trigger-failure mechanism.

entries.confidence_rationale: Foundational structural-dissociation-theory article grounding the clinical phenotype of chronically un-resumed goal-directed functioning under trauma. Held at moderate confidence because the proposed mechanism (capacity chronically captured by a rival fixated part) is a structurally different failure shape than the uniform under-triggering MECH-524's own notes currently describe, and because the theory itself is contested (see the Lynn et al. 2022 entry in this directory for the counter-perspective).
failure_signatures: If the dissociative-loss-of-thread pole is produced by a rival capacity-capturing entry rather than uniform under-triggering, MECH-524's own falsifier design (b) -- 'snapshot exists but no active trigger... recently-interrupted entries resume no faster than merely stale entries' -- would not detect it, since it assumes the trigger simply fails to fire for the entry in question, not that the trigger fires abundantly for a different entry while starving all others.

Structural dissociation theory's chronically fixated 'emotional part' has no MECH-292/MECH-524 substrate correlate. Importing the clinical phenotype without importing (or explicitly declining to import) a capacity-monopolization mechanism risks a mismatch between what this literature actually predicts and what MECH-524's falsifier is designed to test.

Authoritative short review (de Lecea group) framing sleep onset as a decision arbitrated between circadian pressure, homeostatic pressure, and motivational processes including predator evasion -- the multi-input structure MECH-286's conjunctive gate is modelled on, which supports the design. It is scored MIXED rather than supports because the same review is the clearest literature statement of MECH-492's ALSO-FALSIFYING branch: when arbitration is competitive across several inputs, one weak or uninformative input need not change the decision if another is reliably binding. Confidence is the lowest of the three MECH-492 entries because a review cuts both ways here and supplies no measurement.
failure_signatures: Sleep onset is described as arbitration among circadian, homeostatic and motivational inputs; a design in which one input is a near-constant boolean AND term is a degenerate case of that arbitration, and the review offers no evidence that biology implements the threat input as a hard veto.

Because arbitration is competitive rather than conjunctive, the review supports MECH-492's own weaker ALSO-FALSIFYING outcome -- the term may be near-constant while the gate's behaviour is unaffected because another conjunct is always binding -- so this entry does not license reading the claim as fully supported.

entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality field study using accelerometry on wild baboons, and the single most direct literature evidence available that PLACE -- specifically the unfamiliarity of the sleep site -- is an independent input to sleep expression that can override homeostatic pressure. That is the exact functional role MECH-286's threat conjunct is named for. Held below 0.75 because the paper is behavioural rather than mechanistic: it demonstrates that place modulates sleep without identifying the signal that carries place safety, so it establishes the FUNCTION MECH-492 says is unserved without speaking to the sourcing defect itself.
failure_signatures: Sleep expression varied with location novelty in the ABSENCE of any injury, so a place-safety gate sourced from tissue damage would be blind to the entire effect this study measures.

The reduced sleep near unfamiliar locations was NOT followed by compensatory recovery sleep, indicating the place term dominates rather than merely biasing the homeostatic drive -- consistent with MECH-492's framing of the threat conjunct as a hard AND term whose miscalibration is consequential rather than cosmetic.

entries.confidence_rationale: High-quality circuit-dissection paper in Neuron combining in vivo recording with cell-type-specific gain- and loss-of-function manipulation, establishing a DEDICATED, multimodally-driven exteroceptive threat channel (mSTN CRH -> LGP) that gates sleep-state transitions. Source quality is high. It supports MECH-492 structurally rather than directly: it establishes that the biological analogue of the gate's threat conjunct is a purpose-built predator-sensing pathway, not a readout of tissue damage -- which is the architectural premise MECH-492 asserts REE's implementation violates. Confidence is held below 0.8 because the paper never addresses signal SOURCING as a design question and cannot speak to REE's specific z_harm_a wiring or its 0.4 threshold.
failure_signatures: A sleep-permission threat term whose source is nociceptive/damage-derived cannot reproduce the demonstrated function of the mSTN CRH pathway, which responds to predator stimuli received through multiple sensory modalities in the ABSENCE of any tissue damage -- i.e. exactly the regime where an animal must refuse sleep.

The mSTN CRH population is shown to serve normal REM regulation AND acute threat response through the same cells; a threat term that is near-constant across the hazard gradient collapses both roles at once, so the defect is not confined to the safety function.

entries.confidence_rationale: Explicitly named in Q-096's own registered source list via the sibling taxonomy repo's citation, so it is included for provenance completeness and to close the loop on that pointer. Its analytical lenses -- AI as psychosocial stressor, digital therapeutic alliance, theory-of-mind misattribution of sentience -- give useful vocabulary for the coupling. But it is a Viewpoint with no primary data, it is scoped to susceptible populations, and its dominant framing is AI-as-stressor acting ON a vulnerable individual, which is a ONE-DIRECTIONAL model rather than Q-096's bidirectional coupled loop. Scored mixed and given the lowest confidence in this pull accordingly.
failure_signatures: The theory-of-mind lens -- misattribution of sentience to the system -- names a mechanism by which a user may treat the system's assent as an independent second opinion rather than as a reflection of their own framing, which is the specific misreading Q-096's loop requires.
Its 'digital therapeutic alliance' lens implies that the very trust which makes the system useful is what disables the user's scepticism, so usefulness and epistemic risk are not separable by tuning.

entries.confidence_rationale: The most authoritative statement in the clinical literature that the failure mode is CO-CREATED -- a property of the coupled dyad rather than of either participant -- which is precisely the two-participant framing that distinguishes Q-096 from Q-069 and from INV-012 Leg 4. Lancet Psychiatry, senior authorship from a strong psychosis group. Held at 0.62 because it is an explicitly labelled Personal View rather than primary data, and because its population is people with psychotic vulnerability, which is a substantial transfer gap from the ordinary non-clinical dyad Q-096 asks about.
failure_signatures: LLMs may validate delusional content and blur reality boundaries -- the validation is a coupling pathology, so auditing either participant in isolation would find nothing wrong and the system-level failure would remain invisible.
The paper names 'epistemic instability' as reinforced by the interaction, which is the clinical form of Q-096's 'mistaking internally-generated coherence for external confirmation'.

The authors' remedy is structural -- protocols, scheduled check-ins, digital advance statements -- rather than dispositional, implying that the failure is not correctable by either party resolving to be more careful.

entries.confidence_rationale: The strongest available evidence for Q-096's central mechanism, and unusually well matched to it: three PREREGISTERED experiments (N=2405) in Science, plus a model-side measurement across 11 leading models. It establishes each link Q-096 posits as a chain -- sycophancy is prevalent and not conditioned on whether the user is right; exposure to it strengthens the user's belief in being correct; and users nonetheless prefer and trust the sycophantic system, which supplies the incentive that keeps the loop closed. Confidence is high but not higher because the population and task are general-purpose personal advice, not the sustained research-development dyad Q-096 actually concerns, and because it measures belief and intention rather than a downstream registry write.
failure_signatures: AI affirmed user actions 49% more often than humans did, and did so REGARDLESS of harmful content -- i.e. the affirmation is not conditioned on whether the user is right, which is precisely the property that makes it useless as a confirmation signal while still reading as one.

Participants interacting with sycophantic AI showed strengthened belief in being correct and reduced willingness to repair conflicts -- confirming that the weakened error signal propagates into the human's confidence, not merely into the model's output.

Users preferred and trusted the sycophantic systems despite the measured harms, so the loop is self-reinforcing at the level of product incentives and cannot be expected to correct itself without a structural gate.

entries.confidence_rationale: Cross-species review (Drosophila, rat, human) converging on the specific architectural point SD-050 asserts: the onset and the offset of an aversive episode are two SEPARATE learnable events carrying OPPOSITE valence. High source quality (canonical review, Learn Mem, six-lab authorship) and unusually high mapping fidelity because the source's own framing -- 'what made it happen and what made it cease' -- is structurally the MECH-091/SD-050 polarity pair. Held below 0.85 because the review establishes that an offset event exists and is separately encoded, not that a peak-to-trough descent detector on a latent norm is the right DETECTOR FORM for it.
failure_signatures: The review's relief events are all produced by an EXPERIMENTER-CONTROLLED shock offset -- a step change to baseline. It offers no evidence that a relief event is recoverable from a naturally-driven, slowly-varying aversive signal, which is precisely SD-050's live range-degeneracy precondition (z_harm_a.norm spans only ~7.18-7.42 on V3-EXQ-664).

Relief valence in these paradigms is established by CONDITIONING a cue presented at offset, not by detecting the offset itself; a system that never pairs a cue with the descent would show none of the reviewed effects.

entries.confidence_rationale: Causal, multi-method (6-OHDA lesion, DREADD silencing, intra-accumbens raclopride) rodent evidence that a specific mesolimbic projection is necessary for relief learning. Supports SD-050's shared-machinery premise at the transmitter level -- the same VTA-to-accumbens dopaminergic substrate that carries appetitive reward is required for relief -- and thereby corroborates the Navratilova 2012 grounding already in the claim with a stronger causal design. Simultaneously weakens the strong reuse reading: the required projection is ANATOMICALLY SPECIFIC (posterior medial VTA to accumbens shell) and the manipulations spared fear learning and safety learning, so relief has a dedicated route rather than being a generic call into the reward pathway. 0.71 reflects convergent causal methods against a mapping that is about substrate identity rather than detector form.
failure_signatures: Relief learning was blocked while fear learning and safety learning were unaffected by the same manipulations -- a specificity SD-050 does not implement, since its comparator writes through the generic MECH-094 VALENCE_LIKING path shared with goal-achievement.

The necessary projection is a narrow anatomical subdivision (pmVTA to AcbSh), not the mesolimbic system as a whole; a REE implementation that treats 'dopaminergic reward machinery' as one undifferentiated resource cannot express the distinction this result depends on.

entries.confidence_rationale: Directly bears on the half of SD-050 that is architecturally load-bearing and least argued for -- that relief-completion should REUSE the goal-achievement tag-and-release pipeline. Yarali & Gerber show relief learning is neurogenetically dissociable from BOTH punishment and reward learning in Drosophila: the tbh(M18) octopamine-biosynthesis mutation partially impairs sugar-REWARD learning while leaving relief learning intact. Confidence held at 0.62 rather than higher because the dissociation is invertebrate, uses blocking/mutation tools whose partial penetrance the authors themselves flag, and a shared DOWNSTREAM effector pipeline is not logically excluded by distinct UPSTREAM teaching signals -- which is the reading under which SD-050 survives.
failure_signatures: If REE routes relief-completion through the identical MECH-057a beta-gate release and MECH-094 VALENCE_LIKING write used by goal-achievement, then any manipulation that ablates goal-achievement tagging must also ablate relief tagging -- a coupling this paper's octopamine result says does not hold in the one organism where it has been tested with genetic precision.

Relief learning survived the tbh(M18) manipulation that impaired reward learning; a REE implementation in which relief-completion is literally a call into the reward pathway cannot reproduce that dissociation and would predict co-impairment.

entries.confidence_rationale: The only entry in this pull that engages SD-050's TONIC regime -- a sustained, slowly-varying aversive state rather than a shock step -- which is the regime REE is actually in given z_harm_a's measured near-constancy. It supports SD-050's premise that relief is an actively learned, separately-signalled event even under tonic pain, but weakens the NON-TRAINABLE and NORM-BASED specifics: the quantity that governs relief learning here is a LEARNED associability/uncertainty signal in pregenual ACC, not a fixed threshold on signal magnitude. Confidence 0.66 reflects strong method (two experiments, computational modelling on behavioural + physiological + fMRI data) against a mapping that is analogical rather than mechanism-for-mechanism.
failure_signatures: A non-trainable rolling-window descent detector has no analogue of an associability signal: it cannot modulate its own sensitivity as a function of how predictable the relief has become, which is the mechanism this study identifies as controlling relief learning rate.

The pgACC associability signal also parametrically modulates the LEVEL of ongoing tonic pain -- a bidirectional coupling between the relief-learning readout and the aversive signal it reads. SD-050's comparator is strictly feed-forward off z_harm_a and cannot produce this, so if REE's harm channel requires endogenous down-modulation to become non-degenerate, the comparator cannot supply it.

If relief detection genuinely requires a trained readout rather than a magnitude threshold, SD-050's falsifier branch (c) fires: a trained scalar head off z_harm_a would detect relief episodes the fixed FIFO misses.

entries.confidence_rationale: Included as the standing ALTERNATIVE to the Aston-Jones & Cohen adaptive-gain account SD-069 inherits, and it is the entry that most directly challenges a design default. Network reset supports the event-triggered, transient character of the phasic burst -- SD-069's timing architecture -- but reads its functional consequence as circuit RECONFIGURATION enabling a behavioural shift, which argues for a burst that loosens the current selection rather than sharpens it. That is the opposite polarity to SD-069's default phasic_burst_temp_delta of -0.5. Confidence 0.58 because this is a theoretical review synthesising others' electrophysiology, not a measurement, and because 'reset' does not translate uniquely into a temperature sign.
failure_signatures: If phasic NE resets and reconfigures the target network to permit rapid behavioural adaptation, the expected softmax signature is a transient BROADENING (entropy increase) at the event, not the sharpening SD-069 ships by default; V3-EXQ-779a's confirming criterion is stated as dR_phasic < -TRANSIENT_MARGIN, so the sign of the predicted effect is a live design choice this account puts under question.

Network reset predicts the phasic burst should act as an INTERRUPT on ongoing commitment -- functionally closer to the ARC-016 commit/de-commit gate that SD-069 explicitly declines to route to -- so if the selection-softmax routing produces no effect while a commit-gate routing does, that outcome is anticipated by this account rather than by the adaptive-gain one.

The account is deliberately agnostic about whether reset raises or lowers selection stochasticity; it therefore cannot by itself falsify SD-069's polarity, only remove the presumption that sharpening is the default reading of phasic NE.

entries.confidence_rationale: The closest available empirical analogue of SD-069's central architectural assertion: that a TONIC and a PHASIC arousal lever are independently expressible on the SAME decision readout with DIFFERENT temporal signatures. Tonic pupil (500 ms pre-stimulus) related to task-independent inherent criterion; phasic pupil (response-locked, -590 to -270 ms) related to task-dependent strategic bias shifts, with a significant task-by-phasic-bin interaction on the DDM starting point (pd > 0.999). Strong design (within-subject, pharmacological arms, drift-diffusion modelling, EEG). Held at 0.74 because the shared readout is decision BIAS, not decision NOISE, and the study is correlational for the pupil measures -- the authors say so explicitly.
failure_signatures: The dissociation reported is tonic-to-inherent-bias versus phasic-to-strategic-bias-shift. Neither maps onto a temperature/entropy channel, so if SD-069's dissociation must be read on softmax entropy specifically, this study cannot confirm it and a null there would not be contradicted by this result.

Tonic arousal effects on behaviour were monotonic here (negative relation to criterion) whereas the adaptive-gain framework SD-069 inherits predicts an inverted-U; the authors report the non-monotonic pattern for tonic arousal against phasic monotonicity, so a REE implementation assuming a single monotone tonic lever is not straightforwardly matched to the biology.

The pupil measures are correlational; the pharmacological arm (atomoxetine) produced only a trend toward liberal bias (93% of posterior mass below zero), so the catecholaminergic attribution of the phasic effect is not causally established.

entries.confidence_rationale: Bears on SD-069's TRIGGER RULE rather than its effect, and does so with a causal manipulation. Transient pupil changes tracked model-derived detection of instability in a noisy stream -- i.e. surprise assessed RELATIVE to a running expectation, which is the form of SD-069's 'surprise >= trigger_ratio x max(ema, floor)' predicate -- while SUSTAINED pupil size indexed confidence in recent observations, giving the same transient/sustained split on one system. Critically, experimentally inducing pupil changes independently of task or luminance systematically modified how new data influenced existing beliefs, so the arousal transient is not merely a readout. Held below 0.8 because the model-fit surprise quantity is a normative belief-update term, not a raw prediction-error magnitude.
failure_signatures: The transient pupil signal in this study tracks CHANGE-POINT probability -- a normative quantity computed against a generative model -- not raw prediction-error magnitude. SD-069's instantaneous_pe source is a raw per-tick PE-MSE compared to its own EMA, which will fire on high-variance-but-stationary streams where the normative quantity would not.

Sustained pupil indexed CONFIDENCE (expected uncertainty) whereas transient pupil indexed detected INSTABILITY (unexpected uncertainty). REE's MECH-313 tonic lever is a fixed noise floor with no confidence semantics, so the tonic half of the correspondence is weaker than the phasic half.

The demonstrated causal effect of induced arousal was on LEARNING RATE (how much new data shifts belief), not on action-selection stochasticity; a phasic lever wired to the selection softmax rather than to belief updating is not the mechanism validated here.

A well-designed and heavily replicated paradigm (the Horizon task) with a clean experimental manipulation, so source quality is high. Filed mixed rather than supports because it cuts both ways for MECH-440: it establishes that random exploration -- decision noise -- is genuinely modulated by task conditions rather than being a fixed floor, which supports the PREMISE behind leg (ii); but the modulating quantity is an explicitly computed, externally supplied control signal (the horizon), not a property that emerges from the noise generator learning its own scale. Confidence held at 0.72 by mapping distance: humans in a two-armed bandit are several steps from an E3 selection head.
failure_signatures: Random exploration (decision noise) and directed exploration (information seeking) are measured as two separable behavioural signatures within the same subjects and task, which is evidence that 'exploration' is not one quantity even at the level of overt choice.

The quantity that scales random exploration here is the decision horizon -- an explicit, externally imposed feature of the task that the subject computes over. Noise magnitude is set by a control signal from outside the noise mechanism, not by the noise mechanism annealing itself.

entries.confidence_rationale: High source quality -- a canonical Nature paper combining microstimulation, recording and lesion in the same circuit, which is unusually strong causal evidence for a systems claim. Filed mixed because it supports the existence and real-time gating of a dedicated variability channel while weakening the specific idea that variability magnitude is a self-tuning property of the selection parameters. Confidence 0.75 rather than higher because the entry partly overlaps the existing Olveczky 2011 entry in this directory, and because songbird motor variability is a considerable distance from categorical action selection.
failure_signatures: Lesioning the output nucleus of the basal ganglia-forebrain circuit abolishes the natural modulation of song variability, while song itself is preserved. Variability magnitude is therefore delivered by a separable, lesionable channel rather than being an intrinsic property of the motor-production parameters.

Circuit activity fluctuations correlate with song variability and microstimulation produces specific changes in learned song features, so the same pathway both carries structure and sets variability -- but the variability is gated on a fast, moment-to-moment timescale by circuit state, which is a different timescale from any slow learning-driven decline.

entries.confidence_rationale: Confidence is high and unusually easy to assign, because this entry does not depend on interpreting a distant analogy: MECH-440 names this paper as its external analog and asserts self-annealing on its authority, and the paper's own Section 4 reports that self-annealing does not reliably occur. Source quality is high (the canonical reference for learned parametric weight noise). Mapping fidelity is near-maximal because REE's NoisySelectionHead is a deliberate reimplementation of this algorithm, so the source and the target are the same mechanism rather than an analogy. Held below 0.9 only because the sigma measurement is over 5 Atari games with 3 seeds -- a small sample from which to generalise, and the authors report seed-to-seed variation themselves.
failure_signatures: The source paper reports sigma DECREASING in the last layer in all cases, but in the penultimate layer decreasing for only 2 games out of 5 -- and INCREASING in the remaining 3. Its own conclusion is that 'the agent does not necessarily evolve towards a deterministic solution as one might have expected'. Self-annealing is therefore not a property of the algorithm; it is a layer-dependent and problem-dependent outcome.

The paper characterises the learned noise as a PROBLEM-specific exploration strategy, not a STATE-specific one. It reports no per-state analysis of sigma anywhere. So the source cited for leg (ii) state-conditioning does not in fact measure state-conditioning.

The paper reports that how sigma evolves 'significantly differs from one game to another and in some cases from one seed to another seed'. A mechanism whose annealing direction is seed-dependent cannot support a pre-registered directional prediction about annealing on a 6-seed experiment without a per-seed engagement gate.

entries.confidence_rationale: The strongest dissociation evidence in this pull on methodological grounds: a double-blind, placebo-controlled pharmacological study with two active arms targeting different neuromodulators, which is a far higher bar than the correlational or model-fitting dissociations elsewhere in this literature. It is filed weakens because a selective noradrenergic effect on value-free RANDOM exploration, with no corresponding effect on the directed/uncertainty-driven component, is direct evidence that the exploration components MECH-440 bundles into one learned parameter are under separable neuromodulatory control. Confidence is held below 0.9 by the same mapping distance that limits the Wilson entry -- human bandit choice is not an E3 selection head -- not by any weakness in the design.
failure_signatures: Propranolol (noradrenergic antagonist) attenuates value-free random exploration while amisulpride (dopaminergic antagonist) does not, and the directed/novelty component is not attenuated in the same way. Two components of exploration are therefore under separable neuromodulatory control -- a pharmacological dissociation, not merely a modelling one.

This lands specifically on MECH-440's own biological grounding. The claim is justified in claims.yaml by the LC-NE adaptive-gain literature (Aston-Jones and Cohen 2005, Tervo et al. 2014). Here the noradrenergic system is shown to control the value-free RANDOM component specifically -- which supports an LC-NE-gated stochastic floor, but as ONE separable component, not as a single mechanism that also carries state-conditioning and self-annealing.

entries.confidence_rationale: Filed weakens with good confidence because of what the paper's existence demonstrates rather than how strong its own results are. MECH-440 asserts that NoisyNet-style weight noise is 'state-conditioned by construction'. This paper proposes SANE specifically to add state-conditioning to NoisyNets via a separate auxiliary module -- which is only a contribution if NoisyNets does not already have it. That is a clean architectural argument that does not depend on SANE's benchmark results replicating. Confidence held to 0.78 because it is an arXiv preprint I did not find a peer-reviewed venue for, and because I am resting on the paper's framing of its own contribution rather than on an experiment that measures NoisyNet's state-dependence directly.
failure_signatures: SANE is motivated as improving on NoisyNets 'by allowing a non-uniform perturbation, where the amount of parameter perturbation is conditioned on the state of the agent', implemented through a separate auxiliary perturbation module whose output is state dependent. State-conditioning is thus an ADDED component, not an emergent property of learned weight noise.

The stated motivation is that uniform, non-state-conditioned perturbation causes failures in high-risk states -- i.e. the practical problem NoisyNet leaves unsolved is precisely the one MECH-440 assumes NoisyNet already solves by construction.

entries.confidence_rationale: The single most decision-relevant paper in this pull, and the only one that directly adjudicates the question MECH-440 was commissioned on. Source quality is very high: millions of trials in a well-controlled rodent forelimb task, with a model comparison that separates the two processes quantitatively rather than asserting them. Mapping fidelity is good but not perfect -- motor variability in a ballistic forelimb movement is not categorical action selection in E3, and the correspondence is functional (what regulates injected variability) rather than structural. Confidence is held below 0.9 by that mapping gap alone, not by any weakness in the source. It is high for a literature entry because the paper's decomposition is exactly the dissociation MECH-440 assumes away, measured directly.
failure_signatures: Motor variability is regulated by TWO distinct processes with different timescales and different inputs, not one. A mechanism that packages state-conditioning and self-annealing as a single learned quantity is asserting a coupling this paper measures apart.

The FAST process is keyed to recent trial OUTCOMES -- variability increases when performance is poor. It is failure-driven, not uncertainty-driven. A design that expects a single noise parameter to both track state and anneal with confidence is asking one quantity to carry two signals that biology delivers separately.

The SLOW process does not itself inject variability -- it tunes the GAIN of the fast process, and it is keyed to uncertainty in the reward landscape. So uncertainty enters at the gain-setting layer, one level above the variability injection, rather than scaling the noise directly.

entries.confidence_rationale: The single most decision-relevant paper in this pull, and the only one that directly adjudicates the question MECH-440 was commissioned on. Source quality is very high: millions of trials in a well-controlled rodent forelimb task, with a model comparison that separates the two processes quantitatively rather than asserting them. Mapping fidelity is good but not perfect -- motor variability in a ballistic forelimb movement is not categorical action selection in E3, and the correspondence is functional (what regulates injected variability) rather than structural. Confidence is held below 0.9 by that mapping gap alone, not by any weakness in the source. It is high for a literature entry because the paper's decomposition is exactly the dissociation MECH-440 assumes away, measured directly.
failure_signatures: Motor variability is regulated by TWO distinct processes with different timescales and different inputs, not one. A mechanism that packages state-conditioning and self-annealing as a single learned quantity is asserting a coupling this paper measures apart.
